At DUV Tables, we work at the point where precision begins and where it is redefined. 

Within the Process Technology team, one of our key focus areas is a central aspect of our technology: qualification. This is where we determine whether a product not only functions, but also meets the highest standards. 

What you measure, analyze, and further develop is more than just a process—it is the key to technical excellence and sustainable quality. 

As a Process Engineer - Interferometry at the Berlin Factory, you bring high precision directly into manufacturing and set the benchmark for it. 

At the core of your role lies interferometry - not merely as a tool, but as a key to the future.

As a Process Engineer - Interferometry, your responsibilities will include: 

Managing and optimizing our in‑process metrology and product‑qualification measurement systems, with a focus on interferometry. 

Systematically implementing new measurement methods at the interface between development and manufacturing. 

Selecting and procuring suitable measurement systems. 

Creating production‑relevant documentation such as work instructions and training materials. 

Conducting systematic process analyses and monitoring critical process parameters. 

Planning, executing, and evaluating Measurement System Analyses (MSA). 

Actively contributing to improvement projects within Process Technology and Manufacturing. 

Qualifications

Job Description - German

Bei DUV Tables arbeiten wir dort, wo Präzision beginnt – und wo sie neu gedacht wird. 

Im Team Prozesstechnik liegt unter anderem der Fokus auf einem zentralen Aspekt unserer Technologie: der Qualifizierung.

Hier wird entschieden, ob ein Produkt nicht nur funktioniert, sondern höchsten Ansprüchen genügt. Was du misst, analysierst und weiterentwickelst, ist mehr als ein Prozess – es ist der Schlüssel zu technischer Exzellenz und nachhaltiger Qualität.

Als Prozessingenieur:in Messtechnik – Interferometrie in der Berlin Factory bringst du Hochpräzision direkt in die Fertigung und machst sie zum Maßstab.

 Im Zentrum deiner Stelle steht die Interferometrie – nicht als Werkzeug, sondern als Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Du bringst diese Hochpräzisions-Messtechnik direkt in die Fertigung, entwickelst sie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Präzision nicht nur erreicht, sondern neu definiert wird.

Im Detail wirst du als Prozessingenieur:in Messtechnik -Interferometrie folgende Aufgaben haben: 

Betreuung und Optimierung der prozessbegleitenden Messtechnik sowie der Messtechnik zur Produktqualifizierung mit Schwerpunkt Interferometrie.

Systematische Implementierung neuer Messverfahren an der Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung und Fertigung.

Auswahl und Beschaffung geeigneter Messsysteme.

Erstellung produktionserforderlicher Dokumente wie Arbeitsanweisungen und Schulungsunterlagen.

Durchführung systematischer Prozessanalysen und Überwachung kritischer Prozessparameter.

Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Messsystemanalysen (MSA).

Aktive Mitwirkung an Verbesserungsprojekten innerhalb der Prozesstechnik und Fertigung.

Deine Qualifikation

Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes natur- oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium.

Du bringst fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in der Messtechnik mit, insbesondere im Bereich optischer Verfahren.

Du hast Erfahrung darin, messtechnische Verfahren direkt in produktionsnahe Prozesse zu integrieren.

Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrung in Methoden wie Six Sigma (insbesondere Messsystemanalyse), SPC, FMEA und PDCA oder Continuous Improvement (CI) mit. Es ist wünschenswert, dass du diese Kenntnisse bereits in einem Fertigungsumfeld angewendet hast.

Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.

Du musst nicht alles mitbringen - aber Neugier, Mut und den Wunsch, echte Expertise zu entwickeln. Bei DUV Tabels begleiten wir dich - mit Tiefgang, Teamgeist und Raum für neue Perspektiven.

Deine Kompetenzen

Du arbeitest selbständig und strukturiert – auch bei komplexen Aufgabenstellungen.

Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und handelst mit Sorgfalt.

Du bleibst belastbar und flexibel, auch in herausfordernden Situationen.

Du kommunizierst klar und sicher – mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen.

Du bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.

Du denkst lösungsorientiert und findest pragmatische Wege zum Ziel.

Du trittst souverän auf und arbeitest gerne im Team, um gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen.

The Application Engineer supports customer node projects, new product introductions, and the evaluation of new functionalities. (50%)

In addition, this role serves as the local project lead for customer node projects, driving workstreams and managing internal and external reporting. (50%)

Role and Responsibilities

Node Projects

Support engineering activities for node transition projects and act as the local project lead.

Drive workstreams, coordinate schedules, and manage reporting for both internal and external stakeholders.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

Introduce new products and demonstrate the value of ASML solutions.

Conduct product evaluations and ensure successful adaptation in HVM environments.

General Responsibilities

Understand customer needs and develop clear problem descriptions aligned with customer use cases.

Study new products and functionalities, and support evaluation activities.

Take ownership and act proactively; respond promptly to issues as they arise.

Lead engineering work and coordinate with ASML experts (ABS, DE, GSC), serving as the engineering interface to the customer.

Collaborate closely with internal departments including Sales, Marketing, and Product Management.

Apply strong problem-solving skills to drive issue resolution.

Provide engineering support for DUV, YS, and VCP.

Execute project management tasks as the local project lead.

Education and Experience

More than 2 years of experience in the semiconductor industry.

More than 2 years of experience in project-related roles.

Skills

Strong capabilities in data analysis, reporting, problem solving, and driving workstreams for node transition projects.

Awareness of cost of ownership and the ability to maximize value delivered by ASML products.

Ability to create clear and user-friendly technical documentation using commonly understood terminology (avoiding ASML-specific jargon when possible).

Troubleshooting skills and proficiency in data analysis.

Software skills: Excel, PowerPoint, MATLAB.

English requirement: TOEIC 600+ with daily conversational ability.

Ability to deliver presentations and lead technical discussions in English both internally and externally.

Japanese requirement: JLPT N1 or native-level proficiency.

Ability to lead technical discussions in Japanese during customer meetings.

Project management skills, including preparation of internal and external management reports.

Other Information

As a Field Service Engineer (FSE) of ASML Semiconductor equipment (Lithography), You will support the customer with operational equipment support, performance monitoring, mechanical/pneumatics/electrical/optical repairs/servicing, and maintenance. 
In case complicated issue happen, need escalate to upper line to get suitable help in proper timing to secure committed performance to customer.
FSE need to be onsite support by 24hx7days coverage. To do it, we should expect to spend more than 50% of the time inside the clean room working with mechanical and electrical equipment and can work shift working (12 hours Day/Night by 3days work/3days off rotation).

Main Responsibilities

Analyze applicability, accuracy, and adherence to design specifications.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs.

Collaborate with co-workers and customers in isolating and solving problems.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Perform administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports.

Provide appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML or local personnel, as necessary.

Perform complex adjustments, perform upgrades, diagnose, and solve problems with limited support.

Take lead to maintain the local SOP/SPS/BKM WOW in Fab Team

Language Proficiency

Excellent English language skills (verbal and non-verbal). Reference is TOEIC Score >550 points.

Can speak Mandarin or/and Japanese are welcome!
 

Personal Skills

Initiative-taking and flexibility

Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines.

Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency, and professionalism.

A good collaborator who is committed to the success of ASML.

Strong analytical ability and focus on problem solving.

Working experience in tsmc Fab is welcome.

Introduction to the job

As a Finance business process expert, you help shape the next generation of ASML’s finance processes. You will contribute directly to ASML’s mission by designing scalable, automated and future-proof service accounting flows that support global growth. In this role, you will work on the foundation in SAP S/4HANA and the finance data model, ensuring our systems and processes keep pace with ASML’s fast-expanding business.

Role and responsibilities

As a Finance business process expert, you act as the hands-on specialist who defines, builds and improves finance processes with a strong focus on service accounting. You take ownership, lead decisions and collaborate closely with finance, IT and architecture teams to ensure successful transformation.

Your responsibilities include:

Design and build end-to-end finance processes for SAP S/4HANA, with a strong focus on service accounting.

Drive improvements in performance management using best practices in processes, data structures and technology.

Work with finance teams, business process owners and business and IT architects to translate business needs into system designs.

Lead and support adoption of new processes by explaining, testing and validating solutions with end users.

Embed internal controls in process designs and support automation initiatives.

Ensure alignment between finance processes, master data and the finance data model.

Contribute expert knowledge during ERP migration activities and help shape future standards.

Education and experience

You bring a strong background in finance operations, service accounting and SAP-based process design.

You have:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

8–10 years of experience in finance process design, service accounting or financial operations.

Deep knowledge of SAP finance solutions (SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).

Experience with complex business processes, preferably in the service order flows, contracts and billing domain.

Familiarity with automation tools such as RPA.

Experience with ERP migrations and finance transformation initiatives.

Knowledge of SAP revenue accounting (RAR) is a plus.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Communicate complex finance and -system topics in a clear and structured way.

Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across finance, IT and business teams.

Take ownership and lead decisions with confidence.

Show a proactive and curious mindset, always seeking process improvements.

Adapt quickly to change and guide others through transformation.

Apply strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Stay focused on delivering results in a dynamic environment.

Other information

You will join the Transformation & Digital Finance department and report to the Team Lead Business Process Experts. This position is based in Veldhoven and may require limited travel. Introduction

ASML is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of chipmaking equipment and the global technology and market leader in semiconductor lithography. By enabling the production of smaller, more powerful, and more efficient chips, we help drive the advancement and accessibility of semiconductor technology across a wide range of products and applications. ASML is widely recognized as a key force shaping the world’s digital transformation.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, ASML is a global company with more than 44,000 employees and is among the most valuable publicly listed companies in Europe by market capitalization. Our success is rooted in a distinctive culture reflected in our brand DNA: a relentless drive to innovate, combining deep customer insight, a passion for technology, and a can‑do attitude; a collaborative mindset built on integrating diverse perspectives; and a founder’s mentality defined by ownership, accountability, and a results‑driven approach.

Mission

Our global Communications team is committed to engaging our audiences and shaping ASML’s reputation among key stakeholders. In Taiwan and Southeast Asia, we focus on enabling the business and strengthening ASML’s position with employees, prospective talents, ecosystem partners, journalists, and other opinion leaders.

Description

As a senior member of ASML’s regional Communications team in Taiwan, you will lead integrated communications programs across Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and India to support our business growth. You will act as a strategic communications partner to key stakeholders in the region, understanding their needs while translating global Communications priorities into effective regional strategies spanning internal and external domains.

Geographical distance from headquarters creates both unique challenges and opportunities. This role requires high competence across all communications disciplines and a strong understanding of ASML’s business, culture, strategic priorities, and organizational dynamics. You must be able to set priorities, make sound decisions, and ensure excellence in execution. With rapid growth across Taiwan and Southeast Asia, the region requires strong strategic support in branding, reputation management, and internal strategic alignment.

Context of the position

You will serve as a trusted communications partner to key stakeholders across the region, helping shape and protect ASML’s reputation. You will report to the Head of ASML Asia Communications and may occasionally travel to other ASML sites, emerging markets within the region, and the global headquarters in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.

Role and responsibilities

You will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Serving an integrated communications strategist to strengthen ASML’s brand and reputation
With proven consulting, PR and integrated marketing communications (IMC) expertise, you will develop communications strategies that align with the business priorities of ASML’s organizational units across Taiwan and Southeast Asia, as well as global corporate directions. You will also oversee the country-level communications budget, ensuring effective investment and demonstrable impact. You are able to prioritize tasks and resources with minimal supervision while consistently delivering high‑quality results.
 

Crafting messages and telling the ASML’s story 
You excel at developing inspiring and engaging stories. You will identify compelling narratives within ASML and share them with external audiences to enhance the company’s reputation. With a strong understanding of the local media landscape, you know how to build and execute media strategies, pitch stories, and secure meaningful media coverage. You will collaborate closely with the Media Relations team at headquarters and support ASML spokespersons in the region as they communicate with media, government stakeholders, and local communities.
 

Acting as the gatekeeper of ASML’s branding in the region
You will ensure that all internal and external creative assets adhere to ASML’s brand guidelines and accurately reflect the company’s brand identity and tone of voice.
 

Leading project management and other assigned responsibilities
You will partner closely with colleagues across Sales, HR, Society & Community Engagement, ESG, and the broader Communications team to identify opportunities for ASML and to develop initiatives that enhance employee pride and strengthen ASML’s reputation among key stakeholders.

Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Communications, Journalism or Marketing

15 years proven experience in media relations and integrated marketing communications in a multinational company (preferably in high-tech industry). 

Skills

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate the following:

Strategic, business, and technology acumen 
You are familiar with industry trends and the technologies that matter to our customers. You can clearly explain corporate strategy and articulate business impact, including financial considerations. You can explain the principles of lithography to a general audience, interpret complex technologies, grasp first‑principle concepts, and help elevate messaging with clarity and precision.
 

IMC (Integrated Marketing Communications) planning and measurement abilities
You possess a strong understanding of the marketing mix and can plan, organize, and prioritize projects effectively. You know how to apply analytical tools and measurement techniques, incorporate metrics into communications plans, and use best‑practice methodologies to assess impact. You proactively propose improvement indicators and data-driven enhancements.
 

Stakeholder management and consultation capabilities
You can manage multiple stakeholders across sectors, identify cross-functional opportunities, set priorities, and deliver outcomes. You can distill issues to their essence, navigate ambiguity, and find mutually agreeable solutions. You adapt your communication style to your audience and provide communications guidance and coaching to leaders.
 

Critical thinking and analytical skills
You translate business objectives into clear, compelling, and meaningful communication programs. You recognize complexity, actively seek understanding, and assess multiple variables and interdependencies. You identify root causes, anticipate opportunities and risks, explore what‑if scenarios, and propose well-reasoned solutions.
 

Goal orientation: assertiveness, tenacity, prioritization, and impact focus
You stay focused on achieving results that deliver clear, positive business impact. You work with confidence and guide others toward outcomes, applying agility to meet evolving objectives. You ensure strategic communications plans are aligned, targeted, and effective.
 

Strong cultural sensitivity
You adapt to cultural differences and ensure that plans, messages, and activities are appropriate for multicultural environments and aligned with ASML’s values.

Introduction to the job

As part of the strategy to advance our supply chain physical security capabilities, our Risk, Business Assurance and Security (RBA&S) team is seeking a Senior physical security specialist - logistics for our global Physical Identity team to keep ASML’s assets secure.

As a Senior physical security specialist - logistics, you bring senior expertise in physical security and are expected to build and develop a roadmap and capabilities to ensure ASML’s logistics are protected. In this role, you will define, develop and implement policies, controls and capabilities in alignment with stakeholders and security architectures.

Role and responsibilities

The Senior physical security specialist - logistics reports to the Manager physical security logistics and is part of the RBA&S 2nd line Physical Identity team. The 2nd line Physical Identity team currently consists of 8 people spread across various regions and is expected to grow to around 20 people in the coming years. This team operates in the 3 lines of responsibility model. In this model, the 1st line is responsible for managing risk (e.g., physical security operations), the 2nd line is responsible for setting requirements and challenging/verifying control effectiveness (e.g., physical security policy framework and physical security assessments), and the 3rd line provides independent assurance (e.g., internal audit).

In this position, you will:

Define, develop and execute on a physical security logistics roadmap in order to mature this field of expertise in ASML

Define, develop and implement controls and capabilities to increase ASML’s resilience to new and existing internal and/or external physical security threats related to logistics business processes (e.g. transportation, warehousing)

Provide expertise and advice to internal and external stakeholders on physically securing ASML’s logistics processes, in line with business and security requirements

Connect the logistics and physical security spaces and develop synergies and holistic, innovative solutions that seamlessly integrate

Develop and maintain relationships with relevant internal and external stakeholders

Education and experience

Master degree in innovation/technology/security management or equivalent

5+ years of experience with a focus on logistics/warehousing processes and security

5+ years of experience with auditing and assurance

Demonstrable experience in program/project management and developing innovative capabilities

Sound understanding of security technologies, techniques and best practices, with a focus on (physical/digital) identity and security

Skills

To be successful in this position, you will have excellent business, influencing and interpersonal skills. You have a self-starter mentality, and you are highly-motivated, with a strong work ethic and entrepreneurial mindset.

Able to understand business and business processes and how physical security concepts can be optimally integrated in these

Able to strategize, develop and implement new concepts and technologies

Able to translate (local) risk and threat profiles to definition of controls and execution, taking into account different cultural implications

Able to convince others, change management savvy and deal with resistance

Able to summarize and communicate technical data to a non-technical audience

Ability to build strong, trusting relationships with internal stakeholders, customers and suppliers

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

You will be a technical expert who will work with coworkers, customer & field support in isolating and solving problems to maintain and optimize equipment on a daily basis enhancing functionality and prevent problems. You will act as a resource for users on routine malfunctions and will be responsible for the necessary transfer of know-how to the customer.

Role and responsibilities

Install equipment at customer’s locations, including equipment with new features, unload components, inspect for damage, assemble, align and test.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs, escalating when necessary.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Advise users of appropriate actions to correct malfunctions and may recommend changes in user procedures.

Perform administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports. Prepare written technical reports on an independent basis.

Introduction

ASML is committed to sustainability, quality, and efficiency in its operations. Within ASML, reuse and quality initiatives play a key role in enabling circular economy goals while safeguarding system performance and value.

Reuse‑ and Quality‑driven projects rely heavily on clear KPIs to assess value, risks, and impact. Ensuring alignment, consistency, and transparency across these KPIs is essential to effective project and portfolio steering.

By joining these initiatives, as an intern you'll actively contribute to fact‑based decision making, improved reuse effectiveness, and stronger quality insights across multiple projects.

Your assignment

This internship focuses on supporting reuse‑ and quality‑related projects through KPI analytics and structured insight generation, with a strong emphasis on translating data into business‑relevant and decision‑ready insights. As an intern, you act as the analytics and insight backbone for multiple initiatives, ensuring that projects are data‑ready for steering discussions. The intern does not lead projects or make decisions, but enables the Project Leader to steer based on facts, value impact, and cross‑project patterns rather than spending time on data preparation.

As an intern, you will be responsible for:

1. KPI & Reporting Consistency

Gather and align KPI data from existing BI reports (e.g. Quality KPIs, Reuse KPIs).

Identify and flag inconsistencies in KPI definitions, timeframes, or scope.

Maintain a harmonized KPI dataset that can be reused across projects.

Perform basic data quality checks and trend validation.

2. Project Value Tracking (Reuse & Quality)

For each assigned project:

Track baseline versus post‑intervention KPI performance.

Support measurement of: Quality impact (e.g. DOA, CQN, defect trends) and reuse‑related differences (New versus Reuse).

Maintain standardized project value summaries.

3. Decision‑Ready Analysis Preparation

Prepare structured KPI overviews ahead of project reviews.

Highlight deviations, risks, and notable trends.

Support comparison of multiple scenarios or options (without proposing decisions).

4. Cross‑Project Insight & Pattern Detection

Analyze data across multiple projects to detect recurring patterns.

Identify repeating failure modes, KPI behavior, or reuse signals.

Summarize insights in periodic overviews for the Project Leader.

5. Communication & Material Support

Prepare clear figures and charts, one‑page summaries, and standardized slides for steering meetings.

Ensure consistent messaging and visuals across reuse and KPI topics.

Expected Deliverables

Unified dashboards

Harmonized KPI datasets

Project value one‑pagers

Decision‑ready dashboards or summaries

Cross‑project insight snapshots

Documented KPI assumptions and notes

This is a master internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 3-4 days per week. The start date of this internship is as of September 2026.

Have strong analytical skills (Excel required; Power BI, Spotfire, or Azure analytics tools are a strong plus).

Are able to translate data and KPIs into clear business‑relevant insights.

Have an affinity with quality, reuse, and value‑driven decision making.

Are structured, curious, and comfortable working with imperfect or evolving data.

Possess good communication skills in English (verbal and written).

Introduction

Do you have the charisma to lead, inspire, develop and empower a team of qualified leaders and professionals in a region where we see growth an many key projects in parallel? Would you like to drive the Supplier Operations department to entirely new levels of operational excellence by standardizing and growing our regional footprint? Are you enthusiastic about optimizing the added value of the teams by excelling operationally and balancing tactical activities while being a reliable and trustworthy leader? And do you have the communication and relation-buildings skills that can create powerful, end-to-end networks that will help you and your team to achieve high-reach targets?

Job Mission

You will be leading a team of ~5 managers, who in turn are leading a team of >60 talented supply chain professionals over 3 different regions (Linkou, Tainan, Korea) and multiple ERP systems (SAP and Oracle) during a time with high projected future growth in a matrix organization.

Driving for collaboration to capture synergies over the different functions and regions is vital. You are an integral part of the SS&P Northeast Asia staff and represent the operational performance of the suppliers. Additionally you are the sparring partner for the staff team in process improvement. Together with the Global Supplier Operations management team, you create, enrich and execute the vision to further optimize local operations in all locations and drive global standardization regardless of ERP system.

Your goal is to align the teams support to the stakeholders within the SS&P clusters, Supplier Collaboration and our regional teams. Additionally you are the bridge to the factory planning teams for material availability. Together with the clusters you drive material availability and supplier escalations and with the Group Sourcing manager you drive the cost down through Cost of Goods negotiations by your team, through driving efficiency in the supply chain and improved ordering processes.

You represent the voice of operations in the regional staff and secure the required support for the teams to be successful. Furthermore, you take ownership as SS&P NEA staff-member and drive results beyond the scope of your team.

Your team enables material availability from our suppliers at the right quality and cost for our factory and field customers. You will drive effectively, timely and compliant execution of the Requestion to Pay process and contribute to ASML’s supplier performance with direct influence on output growth by balancing the teams’ priorities with supplier management activities. Additionally, Supplier Operations Asia is responsible for managing the relationship and performance for >200 (smaller) supplier accounts.

You do this will keeping operational cost and efficiency targets in mind.

Creating a positive and productive work environment is key. Searching for solutions and assuring a certain level of flexibility also under pressure are required to make your job a success. You need to be able to balance between hands on problem solving and zooming out to connect to the long term strategy.

With the focus on development of the Operational Supplier Coordinators and Tactical Buyers in your team, and planning and supporting this development in close collaboration with the Clusters, we aim to be the talent pool for Sourcing and Procurement professionals. This includes actively engaging in the development of individuals by coaching conversations and orchestrate stretch assignments including the required development support.

You will facilitate optimal personal development of all team members and coach them in their short- and long term challenges and career steps. Alongside driving the activities of your team you will work closely together with the other managers of SO in the rest of the world to actively contribute and further develop our Global Supplier Operations department roadmap and participate in structural improvement projects further optimizing our processes and performance.

You are vital to create a safe environment where speak up is valued and appreciated, and where we constructively challenge each other on the content to drive growth in our performance and people, whilst caring for the well-being of our people and teams.

Job Description

You are responsible for managing a team and drive people and process performance and development and secure continuous service for internal and external customers (eg factories, suppliers, SS&P sectors, CS, Planning & Delivery, re-use, QNI/PLM, Senior Account Leads, LSM and QSM)

You drive change and functional integration over multiple locations

You will coordinate and manage operational annual plans

You will build and maintain a network of in- and external stakeholders/partners and represent the organization

You will evaluate organizational design for own functional discipline, (work)processes and systems and initiate and implement changes and improvements

You coach and continuously develop employees

Education

MSc degree preferred

Experience

8-12 years relevant experience in a complex supplier oriented environment

Knowledge of ERP systems like SAP and Ariba are a pre

People management and previous procurement or supply chain management experience is a must

Excellent social and communication skills and demonstrated ability to coach & develop employees

Strong data analysis and problem solving abilities

Proven cultural awareness and sensitivity in global organization

Knowledge of lean principles and continuous improvements methodology

Track record of change management in a complex international stakeholder field

Driving cost down is in your DNA

Personal skills

Leadership skills, drive for results, act under high pressure

Able to find synergies in E2E collaboration over multiple regions

You get energy from working with others on their individual growth and team growth

Translate the priorities of customers to the team while carefully managing workload and wellbeing

Balance between deep content and process knowledge with helicopter view

Being self-propelling, pro-active attitude, goal oriented, flexible

Context of the position

Supplier Operations, a department of Strategic Sourcing & Procurement, represents ASML’s operational logistics & commercial interface to its supply base and is responsible for material availability for ASML’s factories and field. In today’s complex multi-tier supply chains, this is only possible by creating full transparency in the chains and flexibility at suppliers. The department must handle the increased complexity of ASML’s systems while reducing cost of ownership for customers. To do this, SS&P professionals work with suppliers to continuously reduce cycle time for components, modules and assemblies, increasing supply chain flexibility and create customer value.

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement is an industry-leading supply-chain management organization, responsible for ensuring material availability to ASML’s factories and customers in the field. Our DNA contains customer focus, concurrent engineering, virtual integration plus the ability to thrive in a volatile market, accelerate the supply chain and deliver creative solutions. The department plans up to four years ahead while customer requirements and system bill of materials can change at any time. Any break in material availability can have an unacceptable impact for our customers. So we must proactively identify and solve potential issues by working closely with our technical departments and customers, and actively managing an extensive supplier base.

Senior Manager of Returnable Packaging Supply Chain

Position within the sector Planning & Delivery – Department Delivery

Planning & Delivery introduction

Planning & Delivery (P&D) supports ASML’s growth trajectory, resolving challenges caused by strong growth in volume and complexity in our systems.

Within ASML, Planning & Delivery is an unbiased party, balancing demand and requests from customers against a stretched, however realistic view on our capability while also facilitating all good flows in a compliant and cost-effective way. This is done transparently and in close collaboration with all internal P&D interfaces, including all ASML factories worldwide. 

The Delivery team oversees replenishment (inbound), order management and fulfillment and returnable packaging supply chain logistics

This role of Senior Manager of Returnable Packaging Supply Chain sits in the Delivery team.

Purpose of the Job

The purpose of this role will be to ensure that all returnable packaging goods within the ASML Wilton network are planned, designed, purchased and available at the right time and in the right place to support factory and service requirements, in a compliant, timely and cost effective manner. Ultimately meeting our Stakeholders and suppliers needs and agreed upon SLA's. Establishing and managing day to day week to performance for the end to end supply chain or packaging.

This will include capital and approval processes, demand and supply planning, warehousing, storage, cleaning and repair activities undertaken by 3PL (third party logistics) service providers, managing the cost control of the operating budget and service levels to requirement.

Pool management extends globally from suppliers, through manufacturing to customer locations.

Leading cross functional stakeholder and supplier communications, to drive availability and visibility of pool size, measure performance, and reduce cost. Proactively sharing demand and supply plans.

Establish daily / weekly process which seamlessly support business workflow

Manage escalation process ensuring business continuity relating to availability of returnable packaging materials

Plan and manage the Capex and Opex budgets for the short (1 year) and medium (3 year) time horizons

Manage the packaging team of 3 people to ASML performance standards

7+ years’ experience in managing global supply chain network, overseeing logistics and supply chain operations including managing 3PLs

Experience in internal and external warehouse and transportation management working with logistics providers.

Experience creating Capex investment proposals to present and secure buy in from senior global leadership

Experience managing a global returnable packaging program, including operational and strategic leadership

Experience in cost control, budgeting and reporting

Experience using SAP for inventory management and warehousing processes

Experience with complex supply chains with strong engineering focus.

Experience working in matrix organization with regional and global responsibilities

Introduction

ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Cymer is an independently operated business within the ASML group that develops, manufactures and services deep-ultraviolet (DUV) light sources. The product portfolio includes excimer lasers using argon fluoride (ArF) or krypton fluoride (KrF) gases to generate light in the deep-ultraviolet spectrum. These lasers generate the light that photolithography scanners use to image patterns on silicon wafers. The research, development and manufacturing of DUV light sources is centered in San Diego.

The Discharge Chamber is one of the core modules for DUV light sources, where the discharge plasma is generated to provide DUV light (193nm or 248nm). The development goals include extending chamber lifetime, improving energy efficiency and stability, reducing cost, etc. Achieving these goals requires extensive collaboration among plasma physics, material science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, flow dynamics, and more. If you have a passion for technology and innovation, please join us to develop this complex and challenging DUV discharge plasma chamber!

Introduction

ASML US brings together the most innovative minds in science and technology to develop advanced lithography machines that are essential to producing faster, more energy-efficient microchips. These machines enable the world’s leading chipmakers to create smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, ASML operates across 18 U.S. locations, including Chandler, AZ; San Jose and San Diego, CA; Wilton, CT; and Hillsboro, OR.

As a Master Planner at ASML, you play a key role in ensuring reliable delivery of advanced technology that powers the world’s most innovative chips. Your work helps align production plans with ASML’s mission to push the boundaries of semiconductor manufacturing. By creating robust planning strategies, you enable smooth operations across global teams and contribute to the future of high-tech innovation.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you will develop and execute planning strategies that balance business needs, costs, and risks. You will collaborate across supply chain, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to ensure delivery reliability and meet output and inventory targets.

Your Responsibilities will include:

Developing and maintaining the Master Production Schedule (MPS), balancing business opportunities, costs, and risks.

Lead end-to-end planning across all demand types and align plans across supply chain, factories, and sourcing.

Drive the monthly Demand & Supply (D&S) cycle with an 8-quarter horizon to optimize module output.

Contribute to long-term manufacturing readiness (MR) capability assessments (10-year horizon).

Execute and monitor the D&S plan, manage deviations, and control critical paths and decision gates.

Improve planning processes, methodologies, and tools.

Define and manage optimal buffer strategies across the value chain to reduce inefficient inventory.

Support reverse planning for field operations (“As-New” planning).

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

5+ years of relevant experience in a production environment, preferably in a high-tech, low-volume, discrete manufacturing environment.

Experience with Master Planning, S&OP, and MPS.

Proficiency in MS Office and SAP; financial acumen for decision-making.

Experience leading or participating in supply chain improvement projects.

Experience with NPI planning preferred

Skills and Competencies

Results-driven with strong ownership and accountability.

Proactive, assertive, and analytical with excellent organizational skills.

Strong team player with effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Customer-focused with a commitment to quality, efficiency, and professionalism.

Able to work independently and collaboratively, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Demonstrates initiative in identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This role may require working in both office and factory environments. Office responsibilities include sitting, walking, and using a computer. Factory responsibilities may include working in cleanroom environments with full protective gear, handling equipment, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Travel may be required based on business needs.

Evaluating the consequences that proposed plan changes have on the supply chain

Manage escalations across suppliers/factories/engineering — resolve bottlenecks and prevent recurrence through collaboration with the SAT and Transfer Team to find rootcauses of issues and solutions, sharing lessons learned.

Lead GEMBA walks in partnership with operational teams. 

Be a key buddy and/or mentor to Department new hires and/or EH&S Specialists as assigned or needed. 

Other EH&S responsibilities as needed.

Routine internal reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual updates). 

Conduct business with the highest ethical standards and demonstrate decision-making skills that ensure the safety of all persons associated with ASML operations.

How does it feel to work on the most advanced photolithography system in the biggest semi-con company in the world, and you’re the one who knows about it the most?

Start as a First Line Support engineer to start your journey of deep diving into the technology of the product and panorama of the company behind the veil.

• Delivers technical support for the production and installation process

Independent Work and Responsibility: Work independently according to standard work procedures and packages, and be willing to take responsibility for actions without standard procedures.

Experience

Personal skills

Language ability

• Good at English speaking and writing

• Willing and flexible to take ownership.

• Attentive to detail and logical reasoning.

• Open-minded, high potential to fulfill department growth.

The FLS team acts as the factory's firefighters, responsible for swiftly resolving emergent technical issues with our machines. We also serve as technical consultants, providing knowledge transfer and accurate technical judgment to the production line.

Introduction to the job

The Sourcing Lead is responsible for the overall relationship between ASML and a set of its key suppliers. Current suppliers will be managed for QLTCS (Quality, Logistics, Technology, Cost and Sustainability) performance, while potential new suppliers will be discovered for future business as needed. This position requires a combination of skills in strategic thinking, leadership, initiative, professional communication, financial/business analysis, and is greatly aided by a background in engineering or technology.

In this position you will manage assigned suppliers and an overall commodity/category (supply base) to ensure ASML is supported by world-class suppliers delivering on time, at spec, good quality and at the competitive total cost. You will be expected to actively pursue continuous improvement with current suppliers and potential suppliers and continually explore opportunities arising from process and product improvements, new technology, alternative materials and suppliers, enhancements in supply chain activities, cost reduction programs and any other opportunities that may present a competitive advantage.

Proactively monitors developments and trends within the supply base for Mechatronics & Mechanics and ensures ASML is prepared to react appropriately for short to long terms.

Drives supplier selection activities by leading one or more Sourcing Teams.

Prepares and presents for key decision making in executive review meetings, regarding make/buy decisions and supplier selections.

Negotiates Long Term Supply Agreements (LTSA), NPI Agreements, and associated addendums, and monitors contractual compliance of the supplier as well as ASML.

Drives continuous cost and lead time reduction.

Take lead to manage suppliers’ QLTCS performance with SAT (“Supplier Account Team”) through review processes on regular basis, eg Quarterly Business Review (QBR) and Executive Review Meeting (ERM).

Drives supply base rationalization within the categories.

Participates in supplier overall capabilities audits and drives closure of findings and improvement plans.

This Remote-US role is responsible for selling athenahealth’s revenue cycle management and clinical solutions to physician groups and healthcare organizations within an assigned territory, with a focus on building a qualified pipeline, advancing complex opportunities, and achieving or exceeding annual quota. The Sales Executive, Senior Manager applies healthcare market knowledge, territory strategy, and value-based selling to guide prospects through a consultative buying process and deliver measurable return on investment. This position is based in Remote-US and operates as a remote role with travel as needed for client and prospect engagement. This role reports to the Sales Director. 

Team Summary 
The primary responsibility of the Sales Executive is to sell athenahealth’s revenue cycle management and clinical solutions to mid-sized physician groups (16–30 MDs) and healthcare organizations within an assigned geographic territory. The Sales Executive is accountable for meeting or exceeding the assigned quota for their territory by identifying opportunities, developing relationships with physician practices and healthcare leaders, and presenting athenahealth’s solutions in a way that connects client goals to operational and financial outcomes. 

This role manages a defined territory, develops a territory plan, and maintains coverage across target accounts and active opportunities. The Sales Executive uses a structured lead development approach to evaluate sourcing opportunities, generate qualified leads, and engage prospective clients based on their business needs. The role includes outreach, discovery, in-person and virtual demonstrations, proposal development, contract negotiation, and forecast management. 

Success in this position requires strong knowledge of the economics of medical practices, the ability to communicate ROI clearly, and experience managing complex sales cycles with senior decision-makers. The Sales Executive is expected to maintain an accurate pipeline, provide timely reporting, and exercise sound judgment in prioritizing opportunities and advancing deals. The ideal candidate will reside within or near the assigned territory to support customer engagement and regional market coverage. This position requires 60% travel. 

 
 
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: 

Independently manage an assigned territory, including the Western US region 

Ensure the territory achieves or exceeds assigned quota 

Develop an integrated territory sales plan and maintain coverage across target accounts and active opportunities 

Identify prospective situations where athenahealth services can be sold 

Use leads developed through a structured lead generation process to contact potential clients, assess needs, and demonstrate how athenahealth products can address business and operational goals 

Secure meetings and presentations with physicians, physician groups, and healthcare organization stakeholders 

Present athenahealth solutions from beginning to end through in-person and virtual demonstrations using a consultative, solution-based sales approach 

Develop and submit proposals tailored to the assessed needs of prospective clients 

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date sales pipeline and forecast 

Negotiate contracts and partner with internal stakeholders to support deal progression and closure 

 

Essential Job Responsibilities 

Manage an assigned territory by prioritizing target accounts, maintaining consistent account coverage, and advancing opportunities through the sales process. 

Develop and execute an integrated territory plan that supports pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and quota attainment. 

Identify and qualify prospective client opportunities through sourcing analysis, lead development, and outreach to physician groups and healthcare organizations. 

Conduct discovery conversations, solution demonstrations, and value-based presentations that align athenahealth offerings to client operational, clinical, and financial needs. 

Prepare tailored proposals, maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data, and provide timely, accurate sales reporting. 

Negotiate contract terms and coordinate with internal partners to move opportunities through approval and close processes. 

Travel up to 60% annually to support in-person client meetings, demonstrations, and territory engagement. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our API Traffic Management team, Tech Standardization within our Internal Platform subdivision.

Our vision is to maximize network effect through secure, resilient and high-performance API traffic management, enabling seamless API integrations across our platform and ecosystem while advancing value-based care.

The API Traffic Management team is responsible for building and operating the foundational API Gateway and Service Mesh platforms that power all north–south and east–west traffic across our cloud-native architecture. These platforms are critical to enabling scalable integrations, consistent security controls and reliable service-to-service communication across the enterprise.

We empower internal product teams, partners and external consumers with highly available, observable and policy-driven traffic infrastructure, ensuring that APIs and services can evolve independently while maintaining safety, performance and reliability.

In this role, you will lead high-performing engineers responsible for the API Gateway and Service Mesh roadmap, including availability, scalability, security and operational excellence. You are a hands-on technical leader with a passion for distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and developer experience. Your work will directly enable our mission of becoming the backbone of healthcare—so clinicians can focus on patient care while the platform just works.

Job Responsibilities

· People Management & Development

Lead, mentor, coach and support the career growth of engineers through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, feedback and individualized development plans.

· Hiring & Team Building Recruit, interview and onboard top-tier platform and infrastructure engineers to scale and strengthen the API Traffic Management team.

· Platform Roadmap Ownership Own and evolve the roadmap for API traffic management capabilities, including API Gateway, service mesh, ingress/egress, routing, resiliency, security and observability.

· High Availability & Reliability Ensure the API Gateway and service mesh platforms meet stringent availability,

latency and resiliency requirements, including multi-AZ/multi-region strategies, disaster recovery and incident response readiness.

· Technical Leadership & Architecture Provide strong guidance on traffic patterns, API lifecycle management, service-to-service communication, rate limiting, authentication/authorization and zero-trust networking. Work with Architects to ensure designs are scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards.

· Execution & Delivery Drive execution, remove blockers, manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery of high-quality platform capabilities used by internal services and external consumers.

· Operational Excellence Champion best practices in reliability engineering, observability, on-call health, incident management and post-incident learning to continuously improve platform stability.

· Process Optimization Continuously improve engineering workflows, release processes and Agile practices to balance speed, safety and platform reliability.

· Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with product, security, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement and application teams to align traffic management capabilities with business and platform needs.

· Developer Experience & Adoption Advocate for a strong internal developer experience by providing paved roads, clear abstractions, documentation and self-service capabilities for API and service mesh consumers.

· Strategic Input & Innovation Contribute to broader platform and cloud strategy, evaluate emerging technologies and guide experimentation in areas such as advanced routing, policy engines and service identity.

Typical Qualifications

· 12+ Years of Software Engineering Experience Strong background in building and operating distributed systems, platforms or infrastructure at scale.

· 3+ Years of People Management Experience Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering teams.

· Deep Technical Expertise in Platform & Networking Domains Strong understanding of API Gateways, Service Mesh technologies, L7/L4 networking concepts, traffic routing, load balancing and service-to-service communication in cloud-native environments.

· Experience with Cloud & Kubernetes Ecosystems Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), including ingress, egress and service networking patterns.

· Reliability & Availability Mindset Demonstrated experience designing and operating highly available, resilient systems, with familiarity in SRE practices, SLIs/SLOs, incident management and operational maturity.

· Agile Delivery Expertise Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and experience applying them to platform teams.

· Excellent Communication & Stakeholder Management Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, influence across teams and align stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

· Hiring & Team Scaling Experience Proven track record of attracting, hiring and retaining top engineering talent and fostering an inclusive, high-trust team culture.

· Problem Solving & Strategic Leadership Ability to navigate complex technical and organizational challenges, make sound decisions and align team outcomes with business objectives.

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Related Field Or equivalent practical experience in software or platform engineering.

Nice to Have

· Experience with API Gateway platforms such as Apigee, Kong, NGINX, AWS API Gateway or similar

· Hands-on exposure to Service Mesh technologies like Istio, Linkerd, Consul or Envoy

· Experience operating large-scale Kubernetes platforms in production environments

· Familiarity with zero-trust networking, mTLS, identity-based routing and policy enforcement

· Knowledge of observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, OpenSearch, etc.)

· Experience with traffic shaping, rate limiting, circuit breaking and resiliency patterns

· Background in developer platform or internal PaaS teams

· Exposure to healthcare, regulated environments or high-compliance systems

· Experience leading or collaborating with SRE or infrastructure teams

Role summary:
 

Help restore critical services with speed, clarity, and coordination. The Incident Manager is responsible for leading incident response activities, minimizing business impact, and helping ensure service restoration happens as quickly and effectively as possible while maintaining strong communication across stakeholders. This role is based in Bangalore - Whitefield, India and follows a hybrid work model. The role also supports analysis of incident trends, identification of workarounds and resolution opportunities, and coordination of follow-up actions that strengthen service reliability over time. This position reports to the Director of Service Management.

Team Summary:

As an Incident Manager in the Cloud Engineering organization, you will be part of the Service Management team, which is focused on restoring impacted services to an operational state quickly while managing risk and ongoing business impact. The team coordinates incident response efforts, keeps teams aligned on service restoration priorities, and ensures that resolution remains the immediate focus until business impact has been addressed.

This role also contributes to the broader effectiveness of service management by reviewing historical incident data, identifying patterns, and helping define practical actions that can reduce recurrence or improve response readiness. The Incident Manager facilitates discussions across technical and business stakeholders to review incident trends, evaluate response effectiveness, and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

Success in this role requires a solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure and service dependencies, along with the ability to guide structured discussions during time-sensitive situations. Because incidents can occur at any time, this role requires schedule flexibility, including availability across nights, weekends, and holidays, based on business need.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Lead incident response coordination to restore impacted services as quickly as possible while maintaining focus on business impact and service quality. 

Manage major incident communications across technical teams, operational stakeholders, and leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent updates. 

Assess incidents for impact, urgency, and priority using established incident management practices and ITIL-aligned processes. 

Facilitate structured incident bridges and stakeholder discussions to support decision-making, escalation management, and resolution progress. 

Analyze incident records and historical trends to identify recurring issues, potential workarounds, and opportunities for service improvement. 

Partner with resolver teams, operations teams, and leadership to ensure incident records, actions, and outcomes are documented with a high level of quality. 

Drive follow-through on post-incident actions by coordinating with Problem Management and other stakeholders on remediation and prevention planning.

Additional Job Responsibilities:
 

Prepare operational summaries, dashboards, and trend reports for leadership review. 

Support continuous improvement initiatives for incident handling, escalation paths, and response procedures. 

Review standard operating procedures with resolver groups to help improve incident readiness and response consistency. 

Contribute to service management discussions related to process maturity, reporting quality, and operational effectiveness. 

Coordinate with cross-functional teams during release-related or change-related incidents when additional alignment is required. 

Assist in identifying gaps in monitoring, alerting, documentation, or communication workflows that may affect incident response. 

Participate in scheduled on-call or flexible coverage expectations aligned to incident management needs.

Expected Education & Experience:

8+ years of experience in Incident Management, Service Management, IT Operations, Site Reliability, Infrastructure Operations, or a related technology function. 

Working knowledge of Incident Management, Problem Management, and ITIL practices. 

Experience coordinating activities across multiple stakeholders in a structured and time-sensitive environment. 

Ability to communicate clearly in verbal and written formats with technical and non-technical audiences. 

Familiarity with documenting incidents, actions, decisions, and outcomes in ticketing or workflow management systems. 

Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, application dependencies, and service restoration concepts. 

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

The Position Summary: 

The Onsite Training Individually Contributing Manager (ICM) plays a key role in delivering and refining client-facing and internal training strategies. Collaborate with Product, Enablement, and Training Architects to scale content and improve training tools 

Support quarterly planning, department process reviews, and special initiatives

Deliver onboarding, upskilling, and refresher training for OT trainers

Typical Qualifications:

Lead Designer

The Opportunity

Join athenahealth’s quest to make healthcare work the way it should.

Our health is incredibly precious, and people in need of healthcare are often at their most fragile. Yet the function and experience of healthcare continue to fall far behind the innovative services we experience in other parts of our lives.

athenahealth is looking for designers who can dive into complex design challenges and create solutions that help transform the healthcare industry. If you’re a talented, innovative, and strategic designer motivated to make a difference in healthcare, we want to talk to you.

Help us reduce complexity in healthcare workflows and improve the experience of clinicians, staff, and patients across the healthcare ecosystem. From a visit to the doctor to managing chronic illness over a lifetime, your work will contribute to making healthcare simpler, safer, and more effective.

Position Summary

We’re looking for a Lead Designer to help shape the next generation of athenahealth’s electronic health record and physician practice management products.

In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define, design, and deliver complex workflow solutions that improve the daily experience of healthcare professionals. You will translate research insights, user needs, and product strategy into clear interaction models, workflows, and design artifacts that guide engineering implementation.

This role will have significant influence on the design direction of athenahealth’s scheduling and clinical workflow experiences, shaping solutions used every day by healthcare professionals across the athenahealth network.

Austin, TX

Candidates should be able to work in the office approximately one day per week as needed.

70% — Design Execution (Primary)

Identify and frame complex user-centered problems across clinical and operational workflows

Lead problem framing and solution development for complex product challenges, guiding teams from discovery through delivery

Design efficient, safe, and intuitive workflows that support high-stake clinical and operational decision making

Design and refine complex scheduling workflows that coordinate patients, providers, and operational staff in dynamic healthcare environments

Create artifacts ranging from early concepts and prototypes to detailed workflow and interaction specifications

Translate UX concepts into clear workflow and interaction specifications that support spec-driven development

Use prototypes, research, and experimentation to evaluate the usefulness and usability of product experiences

Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure delivered features meet design intent and quality standards

Apply shared design system patterns and collaborate with the design systems team to evolve components when new product needs emerge

Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate research synthesis, design exploration, and prototyping where appropriate

20% — Design Strategy and Planning

Build deep understanding of healthcare workflows through user research, client engagement, and domain exploration

Plan and execute exploratory research and experiments to inform product strategy and solution direction

Contribute to journey maps, workflow models, and product vision artifacts that guide roadmap and backlog prioritization

Partner with Product and Engineering to define success metrics and evaluate product outcomes

Use behavioral data, analytics, and research insights to inform design decisions

Help product and engineering teams build deep empathy for healthcare users and operational environments

Contribute to the design of intelligent or AI-enabled product capabilities that improve scheduling efficiency and clinical productivity

10% — Leadership & Mentorship

Guide junior designers and cross-functional team members through mentorship and design reviews

Participate in team-wide initiatives to improve design processes, tools, and ways of working

Champion modern design practices including systems thinking, design-to-engineering alignment, and data-informed design

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in design, Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Business, or related disciplines (relevant professional experience also considered) required

4–6 years of professional experience in product or UX design

Experience designing complex workflow systems within enterprise or SaaS products

Strong capability in interaction design, prototyping, and visual communication

Experience planning and synthesizing insights from user research and usability testing

Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams within agile development environments

Ability to translate UX concepts into clear workflows, interaction models, or behavioral specifications

Experience designing within established design systems and contributing feedback to improve shared components and patterns

Familiarity with modern design tools and AI-assisted design or research workflows

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Behaviors & Abilities Required

Design simple, effective, and elegant interactions for complex product workflows

Create strong problem statements and metrics to ensure design solutions achieve meaningful business and user outcomes

Build strong collaborative relationships with product, engineering, and research partners

Provide clear rationale for design recommendations to gain alignment and support

Navigate ambiguity and complex problem spaces with curiosity and structured thinking

Adapt to evolving business priorities in a dynamic product environment

Passion for improving healthcare experiences and solving meaningful real-world problems

Experience in healthcare is a plus, but a passion for improving people’s lives through better technology is essential.

The Implementation Analyst is responsible for supporting data migration and import workflows that enable seamless transitions of patient and clinical data across Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Working within athenahealth's Data Imports team, this role plays a critical part in ensuring that data from source EHR systems is accurately mapped, validated, transformed, and loaded into athenaOne. The Implementation Analyst manages a portfolio of import projects, collaborates with cross-functional teams and clients, and leverages tools such as Microsoft Excel, Salesforce, and SQL to deliver high-quality data migration outcomes.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

Managing end-to-end data import and migration projects, including data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading from source EHR systems into athenaOne.

Analyzing and mapping source data fields to target EHR data structures, ensuring accuracy and compliance with clinical and regulatory requirements.

Using Microsoft Excel for data transformation, transformation templates, and pre-import quality checks.

Leveraging SQL to query, validate, and reconcile data sets across source and destination systems.

Tracking and managing project status, client communications, and issue resolution using Salesforce CRM.

Communicating with clients, healthcare practices, and internal stakeholders to convey import project status, timelines, and data requirements.

Managing a high volume of concurrent import projects and tasks with competing priorities.

Identifying data quality issues, discrepancies, and gaps in source data; proposing and executing remediation strategies.

Developing a thorough understanding of athenahealth's data models, import tools, and EHR workflows to effectively support complex migrations.

Identifying operational inefficiencies in import workflows and contributing to the design of scalable solutions.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Client Services to resolve technical and functional challenges.

Extracting, synthesizing, and analyzing data to support project decisions and reporting.

Troubleshooting and resolving issues related to data imports, including data mapping errors, format mismatches, and load failures, escalating when necessary.

Supporting the training and mentoring of new team members on import processes and tools.

Serving as a subject matter expert for data import best practices and process-related questions.

Other duties as assigned by the Implementation Manager to help optimize and scale data import operations.

Requirements

Graduate in engineering, science, or any related field.

Fluency and comfort with both spoken and written English.

Willingness to work in any shift, including IST Night shifts.

Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively engage members of geographically distributed teams across India and the US.

Excellent customer service skills and professionalism in managing communication with external healthcare clients and partners.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data transformation techniques.

Hands-on experience with SQL for querying, filtering, and validating large datasets is an added advantage.

Experience using Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for project tracking and client communication is an added advantage.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to data accuracy and detail.

Demonstrated experience identifying and resolving data quality issues and workflow inefficiencies.

Ability to manage complex projects throughout their entire lifecycle, from discovery and data analysis through go-live and post-import validation.

Ability to operate independently and execute goals, seeking assistance when needed.

Proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Personal and professional drive to succeed, with a passion for continuous learning.

Flexibility to adapt to change in a rapidly growing company.

Enthusiasm for working in a collaborative, team-oriented setting.

0-3 years of work experience in US healthcare, health IT, data migration, or a related field.

Familiarity with Implementation/ onboarding EHR systems, healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, or similar) is a plus.

About the role we are hiring a Senior Manager, Engineering — Quality to lead and scale quality engineering for athena Collector within Core Products. You will own quality strategy, governance, and delivery for critical Collector workflows, evangelize a quality-first culture across engineering and product and manage local and remote quality teams. This role will define the roadmap for test automation (including AI-assisted automation), gating and release controls, and partner with engineering and product to raise testability, reliability, and operational readiness of the product.

Team summary:

athenaCollector is a cloud-native, AI-enabled Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform that streamlines the end-to-end claims lifecycle and downstream revenue operations for provider customers. Built on a modern, highly scalable stack, the platform combines a rules-driven claims engine to automate triage, reduce denials, and improve first-pass acceptance. athenaCollector provides sophisticated AR follow-up workflows, remittance processing, and payment posting—automatically reconciling remittances, routing exceptions, and surfacing prioritized worklists so teams can focus on high-value recovery. With real-time, explainable analytics and rigorous healthcare security and compliance controls, athenaCollector helps providers accelerate reimbursements, maximize revenue, and concentrate on patient care.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

· Define and own the quality engineering strategy, roadmap, governance and gating criteria for athenaCollector.

· Be an internal evangelist for quality — influence engineering culture and enable teams through tooling, training and playbooks.

· Establish test architecture and standards: test pyramid, CI/CD integration and test data practices.

· Design and deliver automated test suites for end-to-end, API, integration, and UI layers, and set standards for maintainability and observability.

· Drive adoption of quality best practices across teams: testability, shift-left testing, risk-based testing, code-review for tests, and release gating.

· Lead initiatives to modernize automation using AI/ML (e.g., AI-assisted test generation, flaky test detection, smart test selection) to increase coverage and reduce cycle time.

· Define QA governance: release criteria, risk assessments, defect SLAs, and quality metrics/KPIs.

· Partner with Product, Engineering, Security and Operation teams to triage production issues, analyse root causes, and implement systemic fixes.

· Manage local/distributed team of QA engineers and manual testers — set goals, measure outcomes, and ensure alignment to product objectives.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

· Practical experience applying AI/ML to testing (test generation, smart selection, anomaly detection, flaky test triage).

· Experience in revenue cycle management, healthcare domain knowledge or regulated environments.

· Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Splunk) and chaos or resilience testing approaches.

· Knowledge of test data management and security/compliance considerations in healthcare.

Position Summary:

Product Support Analyst is responsible for supporting workflows and projects aimed at improving the efficiency and growth of athenahealth’s interoperability network or ‘backbone’. This network supports the transmission of various healthcare documents including lab results, imaging results, patient demographics, charges, appointments and prescriptions between athena, clients and trading partners. Analyzing and troubleshooting interface work queues, related to lab, imaging, clinical documents, patient demographic, and charge interfaces.

Communicating with labs, hospitals, IT vendors, pharmacies, payors, and athena stakeholders to convey interface status and timelines.

Managing a high volume of tasks and maintaining priorities.

Developing a comprehensive understanding of athenahealth’s healthcare transactions and how relationships between teams and their workflows influence complex problem solving

Diagnosing, analyzing, and resolving issues related to electronic data interchange of the live lab, imaging, demographic, charges, orders, document interfaces, and electronic prescription routing.

Other duties as assigned by the Manager or SME that are necessary to help optimize and expand interface operations.

Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to ensure substantial overlap with US-based teams (Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night) shift timings.

Graduate in Engineering, Science, Computer Science, or Commerce.

1-3 years’ work experience within Health Care, Product Support, Tech Support, Customer Service.

Knowledge & Skills: 

Proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Flexibility to adapt to change in a rapidly expanding and fast-paced company.

Familiarity working with HL7 or similar interoperability standards.

Familiarity working with any CRM tools.

Fluency in both spoken and written English

Good communication skills and an ability to effectively engage with members of cross geographical teams in India and the US.

Excellent customer service skills and professionalism to effectively manage communication with external parties including vendors and payors.

30% Data Maintenance 

Support seamless flow of data from source to the front-end application

Proactively identify, research, understand, and work with feed data/programming structure to resolve issues that impact client business success

Leverage and build test plans and metrics to validate success of the team’s work

Be responsible for reconciling routine data feeds to system published data

Act as go-to resource for analysis and in-depth understanding of source data

Provide updates to internal team, Managers, and other internal stakeholders around structure of client data feed workflows in order to help others answer client questions or address requests

30% Process Improvement/Scalability

Work on projects that enhance and optimize code base to improve scalability and performance

30% Relationship Management

Proactively research and resolve data issues that impact client success

Collaborate with internal teams to improve the data integration system

Provide support and guidance to cross-functional teams a technical resource

10% Special Projects

 Assist with ad-hoc data operations needs and cross-functional projects within Population Health
