BA or BS degree

5+ years of professional experience where candidate should have worked as Data Analyst for at least 3 years with relational databases – writing queries and managing data; SQL programming experience preferred

Understanding of data management tools and analysis techniques

Understanding of healthcare data and value-based contracts preferred

Experience in analyzing complex business problems

Knowledge and understanding of athenahealth product suite and business model preferred

Knowledge & Skills: 

Meticulous attention to detail

SQL knowledge of writing simple to complex queries and troubleshooting issues through data analysis.

Excellent knowledge on ETL process.

Self-starter who can come up to speed on various technologies and methodologies with minimal training

Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity as we grow offerings with diverse requirements, stakeholders, and opportunities – and sometimes with constrained resources

Should have excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and have ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders at various cohort levels

Utilizes professional attitude and comfort working in a corporate setting populated by diverse types of people; able to maintain poise and a sense of humor in stressful situations

Proactive approach to identifying solutions to problems and to taking on work that helps collective team meet their goals

Excellent Microsoft Office skills (primarily Excel)

Ability to independently prioritize, drive results, and meet deadlines

Ability to dive deep into information and articulate core findings to the broader group

Able to expresses complex issues succinctly and logically

Able to execute multiple project work streams simultaneously and transparently, ensuring that all internal and external stakeholders understand the projects’ goals and deliverables

Senior Product Manager – Patient Health Information

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Health Information team within our Patient Experience division. Key responsibilities include: understanding the market and customer, driving to a product vision, developing business cases, ensuring a product or set of product features meets business and regulatory requirements, and driving the creation of product roadmaps and delivery of the product. This position will work daily within scrum teams defining feature requirements, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade off decisions between scope and schedule. 

 
The Team:
The Health Information & Payments Zone is responsible for empowering patients in the evolving healthcare ecosystem by helping them access and understand their health information, manage their personal information, and understand and manage their financial responsibilities. We deliver solutions through athena’s award-winning web-based Patient Portal and native mobile app, as well as standalone patient-facing financial workflows. We are a passionate team of product, engineering, UX, and analytics professionals driven to create consumer-grade, accessible, and best-in-class experiences for patients of our client practices. 

This position is based in Austin, TX.

The Opportunity:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to help guide product discovery, development, and delivery in a nimble, AI-assisted fashion.

But enough about us; let’s talk about you. You are passionate about problem-solving and always take a consumer-centric approach. You know how to energize cross-functional teams around a problem and use data to identify and prioritize solutions. You push and strive toward the best long-term solution while executing against that plan day-to-day. You can make the tough trade off decisions between scope and schedule, while maintaining true focus on outcomes. You are passionate about using AI tools to help you work smarter and faster to achieve your and the team’s goals. 

You are someone who demonstrates extensive experience with product and software design, development, and deployment; including ensuring the team has a right mix of skills and leveraging the strengths of the individual team members as well as AI. Ideally you have experience in healthcare IT and have worked to ensure adherence to the regulatory environment that surrounds healthcare. 

Job Responsibilities 

Drive ongoing backlog allocations and prioritization of patient jobs to be done to solve within area of responsibility 

Create and update a feature roadmap for your area of responsibility that drives toward business and experiential outcomes

Collaborate with UX and Engineering leads using an AI-assisted model to rapidly iterate on business and user requirements to deliver a working solution prototype that engineering can then productize for release

Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, and applicable business models; with regards to what would best serve our patients and clients today as well as in the future 

Identify and track metrics and success criteria to create transparency and visibility to program success and opportunities for improvement; requesting analyses to inform backlog 

Partner with Product Management leaders to be the voice of product decisions within the organization 

Serve as Product Owner for scrum team(s) covering assigned product area, partnering with UX and Engineering to plan work and ensure project execution tracks to that plan

Partner with Product Management leaders to drive portfolio and product strategy 

Engage with Sales, Product Marketing, and other internal partner teams as needed to determine best ways to communicate product to customers; and to assist Product Management leadership with service descriptions 

Contribute to the development of overall product management team by lending your knowledge and experience to teach others what you know 

 

Typical Qualifications 

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience is required

7+ years overall professional experience, inclusive of a minimum of 4 years of product management experience 

Understanding of product management best practices, especially AI-assisted methodologies

Understanding of healthcare / health IT environment a plus, including working within a tightly regulated problem space 

Demonstrated success at driving vision and prioritization of products in a dynamic environment 

Ability to explain your positioning to various people around the company in an effective way 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially with senior leaders and customers

About epocrates 

epocrates is a leading medical reference and point-of-care app trusted by healthcare professionals across the USA for over 25 years. As part of athenahealth, the epocrates R&D group is dedicated to delivering cohesive, end-to-end clinical experiences that provide fast, trusted, and clear clinical intelligence. Guided by the epocrates vision to be the trusted partner providing actionable insights and expert guidance for evolving healthcare needs, we simplify complex information to help clinicians make confident decisions wherever they are in their careers. 

We are seeking a UX Designer to join the epocrates UX design team to shape innovative experiences that clinicians rely on daily, enabling them to provide better patient care through smarter, streamlined interactions. 

Role and responsibilities 

As a UX Designer, you will split your focus between two dynamic product zones. On the Monetization zone, you will contribute to crafting engaging user experiences by designing tailored messaging strategies, optimizing the placement of commercial advertising, and managing the user experience for Membership. This includes creating effective upsell messaging and designing seamless subscription account management flows. Your work will directly influence how advertising and membership features integrate smoothly into our platforms while maintaining a positive and cohesive user experience. 

On the Foundations zone, you will support the design system team. You will help design, maintain, and evolve reusable design system components that promote consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the company’s products. 

Throughout both roles, you will partner with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, high-quality design solutions. This role provides an opportunity to grow your expertise in both customer-facing and internal user experiences, while contributing to the broader design culture within the organization. 

 

Role location: 

Remote 

 

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: 

75% - Design execution (primary) 

Identify and frame user-centered problems clearly. 

Develop low- to high-fidelity designs and prototypes to communicate ideas. 

Collaborate on design and upkeep of our multi-platform design system in Figma. 

Work with product, engineering, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure designs meet user needs and design intent. 

Partner with the UX team to uphold quality in workflows, interaction design, microcopy, and accessibility. 

Create diagrams, journey maps, and UX process artifacts to guide effective solutions. 

Collaborate with UX research to discover opportunities and refine designs through testing. 

Embrace a “fail fast, learn faster” mindset to encourage experimentation. 

Own the design of various cross-platform features. 

 

25% - Design strategy and planning 

Collaborate with UX leadership to define project scope and success criteria. 

Partner with product and engineering leads to guide strategic direction for key features. 

Participate in product backlog prioritization and planning activities. 

Participate in foundational user research to understand user workflows, goals, and needs. 

Use qualitative and quantitative data in ideation sessions to inform design decisions. 

Advocate for user experiences, including commercial advertising partner content. 

Support product frameworks like the Opportunity Solution Trees

​

Bachelor's or master's degree in design, HCI, or related field. 

Minimum 3 years of experience in UX or Product Design (agency or in-house). 

Expert-level skills in Figma for design and prototyping. 

Proficient in designing multiple platforms including Responsive Web and native iOS/Android apps. 

Strong collaborator, experienced working closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, marketing) and stakeholders or clients. 

Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders. 

Solid understanding of accessibility standards and UX best practices. 

Ability to advocate effectively for user-centered design principles. 

Skilled in UX ideation and design methodologies. 

Portfolio showcasing strong visual design, aesthetic sensibility, and successful UX/UI projects across diverse teams. 

​

Experience with digital advertising design. 

Experience in healthcare, health tech, or digital publishing.

Role Summary: We’re looking for a Senior Manager – HR Product Analytics. You will lead the strategy, governance, and delivery of People Analytics data models, reporting roadmaps, and vendor/tool integrations to ensure accurate, documented, and consumable workforce insights. This role reports to the Director of People Analytics.
 

Team Summary: Our HR Analytics team drives strategic and operational decisions across all levels—from the Board of Directors and Executive Leadership Team to HR Business Partners and frontline managers—by analyzing workforce data and delivering actionable insights. You’ll join a five-person analytics team spanning the US and India. In this Senior Manager position, you will be the primary steward of our HR data model and reporting products. You will work closely with teammates across People Analytics, partner with the Data Management Office (DMO), data engineering (Snowflake owners), and workforce technology teams to align architecture, ensure data integrity, and make reporting easier for stakeholders.
 

Essential Job Responsibilities

Maintain and own the HR data model: add validated metrics, ensure documentation, and represent the HR data model in enterprise data initiatives.

Define and execute data model strategy, including collaboration with internal teams or external vendors.

Partner with the Data Management Office and data engineering teams to align Snowflake architecture, data lineage, access controls, and transformation patterns.

Demonstrate strong appetite and working understanding of data engineering principles—how data is ingested, transformed, and made production-ready—and translate those considerations into product requirements.

Develop and manage the reporting and visualization roadmap across Workday, Power BI, and other tools; inventory existing reports and prioritize build vs. sunset decisions.

Audit and consolidate existing reports and dashboards; define reporting tiers (executive, CPOD, self-service, operational) and rationalize overlaps.

Collaborate with analytics, HR Product Group, and IT partners to define integration requirements, support analytics leads in solving stakeholder needs, and ensure deliverables meet expectations.
 

Additional Job Responsibilities

Serve as the subject matter expert for the data dictionary and DMO-related documentation.

Role summary:

Help keep athenahealth’s platform reliable and scalable by designing and delivering technical operations capabilities that improve resilience, speed, and operational efficiency. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore – Whitefield, India, focused on cloud infrastructure operations, automation, and platform migration work across AWS and Kubernetes environments, with strong cross-functional coordination to enable safe and frequent product releases. This role will report to the Director Engineering – Tech Ops.

Team summary:

CE SRE ensures the reliable operation of the platform hosted in a hybrid cloud environment. We partner closely with product teams to scale the platform effectively and enable faster, more efficient product feature releases. InfraOps is a sub-team within CE, focused on operating and scaling the hybrid cloud infrastructure. We are currently undergoing a large-scale migration from a self-managed AWS/Kubernetes/container-based environment to a centrally managed platform. At the same time, we continue to provide 24x7 enterprise-grade operational and user support. To drive efficiency and resilience, we leverage AI-assisted automation, Terraform Enterprise (TFE) for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and advanced monitoring and alerting capabilities to enhance productivity and operational excellence. In this environment, the team balances near-term operational needs with long-term platform modernization. Work includes improving deployment safety through CI/CD practices, strengthening observability to reduce time-to-detect and time-to-recover, and building repeatable infrastructure patterns that support consistency across services. The team collaborates across engineering, security, and product stakeholders to ensure changes are delivered with appropriate controls, clear communication, and measurable reliability outcomes.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

· Design and implement scalable infrastructure and operational patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, and hybrid cloud environments to improve platform reliability and performance.

· Develop automation and tooling in Python to reduce manual operational work and improve consistency across common workflows.

· Lead infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise (TFE), including module standards, change controls, and reusable patterns.

· Drive CI/CD improvements that increase deployment safety, reduce lead time for changes, and support consistent release practices across teams.

· Partner with product and engineering teams to plan and execute platform migration work from self-managed environments to centrally managed platforms, managing dependencies and risks.

· Coordinate cross-functionally with stakeholders to align priorities, communicate operational readiness, and ensure smooth execution of complex initiatives.

· Strengthen operational excellence through improvements to monitoring, alerting, incident response practices, and post-incident corrective actions.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

· Contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve resilience, cost efficiency, and operational scalability across the platform.

· Document operational standards, runbooks, and migration playbooks to support consistent execution and onboarding.

· Support evaluation and adoption of AI-assisted automation approaches that improve productivity and reduce repetitive work.

· Review designs and changes for operational readiness, including rollback planning, capacity considerations, and failure-mode analysis.

· Collaborate with security and compliance partners to ensure infrastructure changes align with required controls and policies.

· Facilitate knowledge sharing across teams on infrastructure patterns, CI/CD practices, and incident learnings.

· Assist with prioritization and planning by translating operational needs into scoped projects with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.

Expected Education & Experience (Required):

· 12–18 years of experience in technical operations, site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related roles supporting production systems.

· Demonstrated hands-on experience with coding, including Python, to build automation and operational tooling.

· Strong experience designing or operating AWS architecture in production environments.

· Very strong Linux Experience

· AWS/Kubernetes Enterprise grade Implementation and Management

· IaC-TFE, Harness or similar for CI/CD, Ansible , Redis as caching, Advanced Alerting and Monitoring such as DataDog, message handling such as Kafka

· Hands on Python scripting experience

· Strong experience of Generative AI Automation such as Windsurf, copilot Claude-Codex

· Proven experience with Kubernetes and container-based platforms, including reliability and scaling considerations.

· Experience with Terraform (including enterprise IaC practices such as module reuse, reviews, and controlled rollouts).

· Experience improving or operating CI/CD pipelines and release processes in collaboration with engineering teams.

· Demonstrated stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and project management experience for complex, multi-team initiatives.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Good to Have

· Understanding of object relation DataBase such as Postgres

· Loging, Monitoring & Metrics

· Dashboard

Work split

· Hands on work, coding, Design and implementation a solution, Enterprise grade operational support, might include On-Call on rotational basis

Application Configuration: Perform application configuration activities primarily in Salesforce and other supporting Force.com applications.

Salesforce Administrator certification required.

Minimum 2 years Salesforce CPQ experience required, Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification preferred.

Role Summary: 

Join athenahealth as a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst and play a key role in shaping financial insight and operational decision-making. This position is based in Chennai, India and is offered as a hybrid role. Then FP&A Analyst will support expense management, monthly close activities, vendor planning, and financial performance reporting, and will report to the Financial Planning and Analysis Manager.

Team Summary: 

Embedded in the FP&A team, this role focuses on supporting expense management, monthly close activities, vendor planning, and financial performance reporting. The Analyst partners with managers, business stakeholders, and peers to prepare clear financial presentations, deliver actionable analyses, and ensure timely, accurate reporting. Responsibilities include consolidating and analyzing financial data, maintaining budgets and forecasts, identifying variance drivers, and recommending opportunities to optimize spend and improve financial performance. The role requires cross-functional collaboration with accounting, procurement, and business unit stakeholders to translate financial results into practical next steps and to support business planning cycles.
 

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain monthly and quarterly financial reports and dashboards that summarize expense performance and key metrics.

Analyze variances between actuals, budgets, and forecasts; identify drivers and communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

Manage and execute parts of the monthly close process related to expense accounts and vendor activity.

Prepare and present financial analyses and executive-ready materials for leadership reviews and planning sessions.

Build and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (procurement, accounting, business units) to support vendor planning and expense optimization initiatives.

Support ad hoc financial requests and special projects that enhance reporting, controls, and processes.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

Assist in process improvement initiatives to streamline reporting and reduce cycle time.

Document financial policies, procedures, and assumptions used in models and reports.

Participate in system and tool upgrades, including testing and validation of finance-related functionality.

Support monthly reconciliation and review of vendor-related financial transactions as needed.

Help prepare materials for external audits or internal reviews when requested.

Support periodic finance-driven business reviews and cross-functional planning workshops.

Expected Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or a related field.

3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, corporate finance, or accounting.

Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

Proficiency in Excel and experience with financial reporting tools and ERP systems; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools is advantageous.

Strong communication and presentation skills with experience preparing materials for leadership.

Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and collaborate across teams.

Able to work 2:30pm -11:30pm IST

The Information Security group at athenahealth is looking for a security analyst to join our Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that acts as a top-tier (Tier 3) incident responder for cyber security incidents of all types, detection engineering, threat hunting, and serves as an incident coordinator during an on-call rotation for any incidents detected via automated alerting workflows or reported to the security team through several channels.

You must be someone who can debug complex problems and use methodical processes when troubleshooting a technical issue, including knowing when and how to work with team members, management, and other stakeholders in an effective and efficient manner. You must be an excellent communicator who can work with stakeholders to understand employee questions and potential concerns. You must provide strong stakeholder support and understand how and when to appropriately triage issues to completion and escalate potential issues appropriately. You are a tenacious and nimble learner who demonstrates design and engineering excellence. Being able to communicate security issues to employees in a non-technical manner is critical to success.

The Team:

The CSOC is a three-tiered structure responsible for ensuring the company's products and infrastructure are as secure as possible. The team works cross-functionally across the business with stakeholders to provide support, guidance, and technical implementations where appropriate, to include triage, containment, and remediation when applicable. Cross-functional teams in support of security threats or incidents include cyber threat intelligence, security engineering, public cloud security, risk management, and other security teams, but also dozens of technical teams in various environments.

Job Responsibilities: 

Understand that as the Tier 3 (highest level) engineer, you’re expected to handle potential incidents and act as the as a subject matter expert for all security-related tickets that come into the team's various queues (including triage, containment, and remediation when necessary).

Receive incident escalations from Tier 1 and 2 analysts, assisting with real-time advanced analysis, response, and reporting.

Mentor and assist in training Tier 1 and 2 analysts to aid in their skills development and analytical capabilities.

Proactively hunt for threats and enacting identification, containment, and eradication measures while supporting recovery efforts.

Serve as a point person for coordination with appropriate parties during a security incident – client, management, legal, security, operations, etc.

Create thorough reports and documentation of all incidents and procedures, presenting findings to team and leadership on a routine basis.

Incident Response: remote remediation when possible and working with onsite teams when necessary. Detailed documentation of events and remediation steps taken.

Root Cause Analysis: initiation and follow-through to ensure quality forensic materials are captured, writing reports with details and timelines of events with recommendations to avoid future occurrences.

Assist in the general maintenance and improvement of procedures, processes and playbooks.

Conduct research regarding the latest methods, tools, and trends in digital forensics analysis.

Conduct analysis using logs, previous alerts, etc. to identify trends to identify and prevent potential incidents.

Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure tickets are triaged appropriately and in a timely manner, according to SLAs.

Excel at documentation and detailed notetaking, including SOP writing, incident reporting, e-mail and instant messaging etiquette, and most importantly, documenting incident actions in tickets. This role is responsible for completing incident reports and forensic reports, when appropriate, so competent writing skills are necessary.

Ability to know when to appropriately escalate a potential issue to peers and/or leadership.

Desire to learn new concepts and technologies to grow and take on more responsibility over time.

Ability to communicate risk, prioritize incident response actions, and keep a cool head under pressure.

Advanced experience with security tools like Splunk, CrowdStrike EDR, Carbon Black EDR, Proofpoint tools, Microsoft Defender components, Cyberhaven DLP, Axiom Cyber and open-source forensic tools, Cylance Protect, Office 365 tools, PowerShell, and various network tools, etc.

Understanding the various stages of incident response, the importance and critical factors of an investigation, and how to contain as soon as possible.

Have experience with the incident response lifecycle, the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain, the MITRE framework, and the forensic workflows as outlined by NIST.

Work with development teams to ensure they're using best practices and company processes in their daily activities.

Drive self-organization; help determine how the team functions in collaboration with your peers

Build strong relationships with cross-functional team members between the three tiers of the CSOC.

Participate in off-hours on-call incident handler rotation, which is a requirement for this role, as incidents may be escalated outside of normal business hours by our 24/7/365 Tier 2 team. Tier 3 teammates rotate on-call responsibilities which requires each teammate to be formally on-call roughly one week a month.

Typical Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or higher in cyber security, computer science, or related field.

6-10 years of cyber security experience, including at least five years in an incident response role.

Completion of the GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or equivalent.

Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions, including a fundamental understanding of memory processes and memory management practices for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.

Information Security familiarity and training, including areas such as incident response, computer forensics (host and network-based), malware analysis, risk assessment, vulnerability testing, penetration testing, and insider threat investigations.

Experience participating in penetration tests, purple team exercises, and threat hunts, including remediation.

Experience in distributed systems and cloud-based architecture including Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, and the native security tools available in these environments (Data Explorer, GuardDuty, Log Analytics, etc.).

Experience with detection engineering for endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions such as Splunk and the Elastic Stack (ELK), and log analysis for all operating systems,

Familiarity with Unix/Linux, Windows, SQL, macOS, shell scripting, PowerShell and python scripting, and various other technologies.

Familiarity with common phishing attacks, methods, and risks to look out for from a security perspective.

Basic understanding and exposure to project management and collaborative software applications such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ServiceNow, MS Teams, etc.

Have strong written and verbal communication skills and not be afraid to ask questions or for advice.

Be a strong team member, assertive, a critical thinker, and able to collaborate often and openly.

Good communication skills to interact with clients, team members, management, and support personnel.

The ability to work independently and as part of a team, be highly self-motivated.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to prioritize work and complete tasks in a timely and complete manner with regular documentation along the way.

Work Environment:

Requires being on-call during off hours.

May require occasional weekend work.

Remote, but must be physically located within the USA.

Can reside anywhere in the USA, but must work in Eastern Standard Time (ET) (typically 8:30AM-5PM ET)

We're seeking an experienced Lead Member of Technical Staff to join our engineering team in Chennai. This hybrid role offers the opportunity to lead technical initiatives in modernizing our large-scale enterprise reporting platform, transitioning from monolithic OLTP architecture to cloud-native, self-service analytics. You'll work at the intersection of data modelling, cloud optimization, and full-stack development, directly impacting thousands of users. This position reports to the Senior Engineering Manager.

Team Summary

Our team is at the forefront of a transformative journey, modernizing athenahealth's enterprise reporting infrastructure. We're moving away from legacy monolithic systems toward a cloud-native, self-service analytics experience that empowers healthcare providers with real-time insights. The work encompasses data modeling excellence, query optimization at scale, cost and performance management, and leveraging LLMs to accelerate migration of complex SQL across dialects.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, product managers, and business analysts to deliver solutions that touch thousands of healthcare providers daily. Our tech stack includes Snowflake for data warehousing, Java and Node.js for backend services, React for frontend applications, PostgreSQL for transactional data, and AWS for cloud infrastructure. We value technical depth combined with systems thinking, and if you're passionate about transformation that requires both architectural vision and hands-on coding, we'd love to connect with you.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Design and implement scalable data models in Snowflake, optimizing for performance and cost efficiency across multi-tenant architectures

• Develop full-stack solutions using Java/Node.js for backend services and React for frontend applications, ensuring seamless integration with data platforms.

• Deep knowledge on service-service authorization mechanisms via OAuth and other mechanisms. Knowledge on how RBAC policies work on a database like postgres.

• Architect and build web-stack solutions on AWS, implementing best practices for security, scalability, and reliability

• Lead technical design discussions and code reviews, mentoring team members on best practices and architectural patterns

• Collaborate with product and UX teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term platform vision

• Drive query and cost optimization initiatives and warehouse performance tuning to support analytics at scale.

• Partner with stakeholders to establish data governance standards and implement self-service analytics capabilities

Additional Job Responsibilities

• Contribute to the migration strategy from legacy SQL systems to modern data platforms, leveraging automation where possible

• Understand and collaborate with the Cloud Engineering org for onboarding and scaling the app via EKS

• Support the integration of analytics platforms like Sigma or equivalent tools into the technology ecosystem

• Participate in on-call rotations to ensure platform reliability and performance

• Document architectural decisions and create technical specifications for complex features

• Contribute to the engineering community through knowledge sharing sessions and technical presentations

• Assist in evaluating new technologies and tools that could enhance our data and analytics capabilities

• Embrace help of AI and coding assistants and willing to work on perl based monolithic stack. Multiple coding assistants with access to Frontier models will be available for all engineers.

• Demonstrated knowledge of consistently leading a large feature that is a collection of multiple stories and tasks.

• Ability to mentor junior developers in the areas of security and privacy but not limited to this.

• Demonstrated ability of reviewing others code with empathy and yet uncompromising on security and privacy.

• Ability to balance stakeholder commitments vs code quality. Ability to articulate reality and find a way forward.

Expected Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 8-12 years of experience in software development with focus on enterprise-scale applications

• Strong expertise in data modelling

• Expertise in Snowflake or an equivalent cloud platform like Databricks - architecture, including warehouse optimization techniques

• Proficiency in full-stack development with Java and/or Node.js for backend, and React for frontend development.

• Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases in production environments

• Demonstrated knowledge of AWS services and building cloud-native web applications

• Nice to have - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration concepts

• Nice to have - Familiarity with analytics platforms such as Sigma or similar business intelligence tools

We are looking for a Clinical Content & Terminology Senior Associate to join our team within the Chief Medical Officer Organization division. Your job will include authoring new Clinical Decision Support (CDS) rules to expand and maintain a global CDS rule library that supports evidence-based, actionable guidance within athenahealth clinical workflows. 
 
You are a curious, logical thinker who enjoys breaking down complex guidance and seeing problems through to resolution. You prefer deep expertise in your area of focus while understanding how your work fits into the broader clinical and product ecosystem. You are detail-oriented, yet efficient, comfortable working independently, and proactive about identifying ambiguity or inconsistencies. You collaborate effectively with clinicians, project leaders, and cross-functional partners to ensure CDS rules are clinically accurate, technically feasible, and valuable to customers. 

The Team 

Our Clinical Content & Terminology team optimizes the client experience by curating clinically relevant content that is supported by evidence-based medicine and industry standard code sets. The standardization, management, and continuous improvement of these content assets is critical to supporting a positive customer experience that leads to exceptional patient care and contributes to the success of athenahealth’s clinical workflows. The team engages in the product development process to support content for new workflows and features. We curate content for workflows including templates, orders/results, clinical providers, patient health information sections, screening questionnaires, and care management. 

Job Responsibilities (Include but are not limited to) 

Perform clinical research to translate evidence-based clinical recommendations and guidance into structured, executable CDS rule logic 

Design logic diagrams to model rule behavior prior to implementation 

Collaborate with clinicians to validate clinical intent, scope, accuracy, and relevance of CDS rules 

Identify where required clinical information is documented within the patient chart and assess structured data availability 

Develop and maintain value sets (e.g., diagnoses, medications, labs, procedures) that support CDS logic 

Build, test, and refine CDS rules within the CDS platform or rules engine 

Develop and execute test cases to validate expected behavior, including edge cases and exceptions 

Troubleshoot rule behavior and data issues, identifying root causes and implementing improvements 

Prepare CDS rules for release, including documentation of assumptions, limitations, and intended behavior 

Respond to customer feedback and reported issues related to CDS content and rule behavior 

Coordinate with project leaders and cross-functional teams to resolve clinical, data, or technical inconsistencies 

Support continuous improvement of the CDS rule library through ongoing maintenance and enhancement 

​

Education, Experience & Skills 

Strong logical, analytical, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to translate narrative guidance into executable logic 

Ability to interpret clinical guidelines and ask effective clarifying questions of clinical subject matter experts 

Understanding how clinical data is documented in electronic health records (EHRs) 

Experience with medical coding systems and clinical terminology 

Comfort working with logic modeling tools, flowcharts, or rule authoring systems. 

Strong written and verbal communication skills 

Bachelor’s Degree preferred 

Professional experience in healthcare, health IT, informatics, data analysis, or related field preferred 

​

Behaviors & Abilities Required 

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team 

Comfort operating in ambiguity and making reasoned decisions when guidance or data is incomplete 

Strong attention to detail balanced with efficiency and the ability to manage multiple priorities 

Proactive communicator who escalates risks, gaps, or inconsistencies early 

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills 

Adaptability and willingness to learn new clinical domains and technical systems 

Passion for improving healthcare and the clinician experience, with empathy for end users 

Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment

latency and resiliency requirements, including multi-AZ/multi-region strategies, disaster recovery and incident response readiness.

Why This Role Matters 

Healthcare data sits behind nearly every clinical and operational decision, and athenahealth plays a leading role in helping providers access and use that data at scale. Imports and Migration are two of the most visible and high-stakes services within this broader data services landscape. From onboarding and data intake to ongoing imports, validation, monitoring, and support, these services must work together as a coherent whole to earn trust and scale reliably. 

This role exists to bring clarity, direction, and momentum to the seams between systems, services, and people, especially where ownership spans teams, platforms, and operational groups. You’ll help ensure that data services are not only reliable, but predictable, transparent, and increasingly proactive, so care teams can rely on them with confidence, even as complexity grows. 

When data services work well, clinicians can focus on care instead of systems, teams move faster with less rework, issues are surfaced and resolved earlier, and decisions improve across the organization. This work directly enables doctors to be doctors, making care feel closer, more human, and better supported by the systems behind it. 

 

Role Summary 

As a Lead Experience Designer, you’ll own and shape the end-to-end service experience that enables safe, reliable data migration into athenaOne, powered by our data import capabilities. You’ll set direction across seams, connecting customer experience, internal operations, and platform capabilities into a coherent service model. You’ll design how customers and internal teams request, configure, monitor, and resolve data migrations, connecting customer-facing tools with the operational and technical systems behind them. 

This is a hands-on Lead IC role focused on a clearly defined service area that plays an outsized role in onboarding success. You’ll establish experience with north stars, ground decisions in research, and use systems thinking to guide teams through complexity and ambiguity. You’ll be expected to use AI as a first-class design lever, both to accelerate design work and to improve how the service itself operates. 

Over time, you’ll apply the same service design and AI-first mindset to closely related data workflows, including population health and value-based care (VBC) data pipelines, as well as other forms of bulk data movement such as migrations or exports for analytics and reporting, optimizing for system coherence as scope and complexity expand.

Own the end-to-end service experience for data migration and imports, from initial request and setup through monitoring, issue resolution, and steady-state operation 

Design services, not just screens, by mapping journeys, defining service models, and creating blueprints across people, tools, policies, and systems 

Translate complex technical and operational workflows into clear, confidence-building migration experiences 

Partner closely with product, engineering, data, and operations teams to set shared direction, including participating in and leading visioning exercises with PMs to align on north stars, service models, and longer-term outcomes 

Collaborate effectively with engineers to explore constraints, test solutions, and ensure designs are feasible, scalable, and delivered with quality 

Design and ship high-quality UI and interactions for enterprise workflows using research, prototyping, and testing 

Apply a service design lens to population health and value-based care (VBC) data pipelines 

Contribute to experience design for bulk data movement (e.g., migrations or exports) as priorities evolve 

Use AI-powered tools to accelerate research, synthesis, prototyping, and iteration 

Help shape AI-enabled service capabilities such as guided configuration, intelligent validation, anomaly detection, and clearer diagnostics 

Define and track outcomes such as time to migration readiness, data confidence, issue resolution clarity, system coherence, and customer satisfaction

A practical point of view on how AI can improve both design practice and user experiences

Clear, inclusive communicator who can align diverse stakeholders around user needs, technical realities, and business goals

The Small Group Account Executive team is a fast-moving, high-growth organization focused on service line expansion and wallet share. Account Executives are aligned to geographically defined markets and partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to bring athenahealth’s extended revenue cycle services to clients already live on athena’s core platform. 

As a member of this team, you will gain early exposure to testing, launching, and scaling new services, building expertise in athenahealth’s expanding portfolio ahead of other sales segments. The team culture is highly collaborative and supportive—you’ll receive regular coaching from your Territory Sales Manager, collaborate with peers on complex opportunities, and have direct access to product and customer success partners when needed. 

Using virtual selling tools, data-driven insights, and a team-based approach, this group helps practices launch, scale, and succeed. Wins are celebrated collectively, losses are treated as learning opportunities, and the work you do directly fuels athenahealth’s growth and long-term impact on healthcare. 

 

Essential Job Responsibilities 

65% – Driving Bookings from New Services within Existing Clients 

Meet or exceed assigned New Services quota. 

Convert open sockets within the assigned book of business by upgrading existing clients to new services. 

Proactively generate pipeline through targeted prospecting leveraging internal resources (client performance data, CSM partnerships, and established client relationships). Lead with athena’s Extended Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) services. Partner with practice administrators, physician owners, and billing leaders to navigate buying decisions and overcome objections related to vendor change and service transitions. 

Own the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, executive presentations, total cost of ownership analysis, follow-up, negotiation, and proposal delivery. 

Rapidly ramp on and effectively sell newly launched athenahealth products and services. 

Maintain accurate, timely pipeline reporting and forecasting.

Meet or exceed assigned growth-related quota. 

Build and sustain strong relationships with key client decision makers. 

Consistently articulate and defend athena’s value proposition and total cost of ownership, leveraging growth events as catalysts to expand adoption of additional, non-departmental services.

Strong executive presence with demonstrated business acumen. 

Proven ability to influence, negotiate, and manage complex buying processes. 

Exceptional discovery, storytelling, and objection-handling skills. 

Proficiency with Salesforce, Excel (financial modeling), PowerPoint (executive presentations), Gong/Chorus, Outreach, LinkedIn, and GPT-based tools. 

Ability to build and sustain strong internal and external relationships across multiple levels. 

Demonstrated ability to independently manage a high-velocity pipeline of 25+ opportunities, driving speed and precision through the sales cycle with an average cycle time of <14 days. 

 

Experience 

5+ years of full-cycle healthcare or healthcare IT sales experience (existing-logo and/or new-logo). 

Deep expertise in end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management within ambulatory care settings. 

Experience carrying multimillion-dollar quotas with a consistent record of exceeding targets.

Role Summary

Join athenahealth as a Data Center Manager, where you will play a key role in overseeing the operational excellence and lifecycle management of our physical data center infrastructure. This position is based in Ohio and requires in-person presence to lead and support critical data center functions. You will report directly to the Data Center Director, contributing to the stability and growth of our production environments. 

Team Summary

The Data Center Engineering Team (DCEng) is dedicated to ensuring the stability, capacity, and full lifecycle management of physical devices, infrastructure, and environmental conditions within athenahealth’s production data centers. This team manages all physical aspects of server assets from procurement through decommissioning, including hardware repairs and modifications to maintain asset and infrastructure stability. DCEng collaborates closely with data center providers to maintain optimal environmental conditions, ensuring the safety and performance of our assets. Utilize Jira to manage work orders, incident tracking, and project workflows efficiently. 

Analyze operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement in data center processes. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to coordinate hardware procurement, installation, maintenance, and decommissioning activities. 

Ensure compliance with safety, security, and environmental standards within the data center facilities. 

Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement within the team, aligning with athenahealth’s core values.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Support capacity planning and forecasting efforts to align infrastructure growth with business needs. 

Participate in disaster recovery planning and execution to ensure data center resilience. 

Assist in vendor management and contract negotiations related to data center services and equipment. 

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. 

Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing to enhance team effectiveness. 

Engage in cross-team initiatives to improve operational workflows and automation. 

Support on-call rotations as part of the 24x7x365 coverage model.

Expected Education & Experience

2 to 5 years of experience in data center operations, infrastructure management, or a related technical field. 

Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage teams and drive accountability. 

Hands-on experience with Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and visualization. 

Proficiency in Jira for project and incident management. 

Strong analytical skills with experience in operational data analysis. 

Familiarity with physical data center infrastructure, including hardware lifecycle management and environmental controls. 

Ability to work effectively in an in-person role based in Ohio.

Shape product strategy through experience design

Use AI to help teams and stakeholders reason about complex systems, prototype ideas earlier, and evaluate options before they are fully built. 

Model how integrated AI can responsibly elevate design practice and help others adopt those approaches in their day-to-day work

Execute and ship high-quality experience designs

Clear, inclusive communication skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around user needs, technical realities, and business goals

Knowledge about healthcare data and clinical workflows across hospitals and/or ambulatory settings. 

Experience working with operational teams to improve service experiences

Support continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline releases. 

Document system architecture, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. 

Engage in knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team and broader engineering community. 

Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance observability capabilities. 

Participate in cross-functional projects to improve overall platform reliability. 

Support compliance and security initiatives related to infrastructure and monitoring systems.

Role Summary

We are seeking an Associate Member of Technical Staff with a solid understanding of distributed systems, API architecture, and modern platform infrastructure. This role demands technical expertise, ownership, and a growth mindset in developing scalable and resilient API infrastructure that acts as an intelligent abstraction between various consumers and athena's clinical, administrative, financial, and operational data. The position requires 1+ years of internship or working experience in software engineering with experience in distributed systems. You will focus on developing scalable, secure, and low-latent systems that meet the high bar required for healthcare: privacy, reliability, auditability, and trust.

Team Summary

The API Solutions team is part of the Data and Ecosystem Platform organization within Product Engineering R&D, advancing our external and internal facing API products including MCP (Model Context Protocol for AI-driven workflows and agentic experiences), Event based notifications, Clinical Decision Support, and GraphQL. Reporting to Senior Manager Engineering, this Bangalore-based hybrid role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to technical excellence in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-impact platform capabilities used by internal teams, partners, and external developers. The team is building the next generation of platform capabilities that enable developers, partners, and customers to safely and efficiently extend the athena ecosystem.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Technical Execution:

Develop and maintain high-performance, scalable API solutions that enable secure interactions with athena's FHIR and proprietary APIs across multiple product offerings

Implement core API capabilities including schema definition, tool/action invocation, session management, state handling, and event-driven architectures

Contribute to authentication, authorization, and data minimization frameworks that ensure safe access to healthcare data

Write, debug, and deploy code to production and deliver timely fixes

Adhere to DoD (Definition of Done) as part of the sprint, including unit tests, functional testing, code reviews, no regressions, bug fixes, documentation and adhere to best coding practices

Perform peer code reviews and follow athenahealth's processes to ensure quality standards

Produce clear technical documentation for API integrations and service components

Implement monitoring, logging, audit trails, and alerting to ensure system health, performance, and compliance with healthcare regulations

Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize API services and related backend systems in distributed cloud environments

Implement rate limiting, error handling, and observability frameworks for production-grade API interactions

Continuously enhance service reliability, scalability, and maintainability through best practices in coding, testing, and deployment

Team Collaboration:

Learn and develop understanding of API architecture, modern integration patterns, and related backend technologies

Take ownership of assigned tasks and features, emphasizing quality and operational excellence

Contribute actively to Agile ceremonies to drive continuous improvement

Volunteer for backlog tasks and collaborate across team dependencies

Support a culture of self-organization, peer reviews, and knowledge sharing

Additional Job Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Coordination:

Collaborate with product managers, architects, security teams, and backend engineers to ensure alignment of technical goals with business needs and compliance requirements

Build working relationships with cross-functional teams

Work with internal product teams to support API integrations into real athena workflows

Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Work with Legal, Compliance, and Security teams to ensure API implementations meet healthcare regulatory requirements

Behaviors & Abilities:

Ability to learn new technologies rapidly and adapt to evolving requirements in the API solutions space

Writing code that is performant, scalable, secure, and maintainable, with particular attention to healthcare data privacy

Contribute to technical decisions and effective solutions

Consistently deliver results in high-pressure, fast-paced environments

Follow and promote engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and documentation

Collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to reason about scale, performance, and failure modes

Build trust and alignment across engineering, security, legal, and business stakeholders

Education, Experience & Skills Required

Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

1+ years of internship or working experience in software engineering with experience in distributed systems

Hands-on experience with Object Oriented Languages such as Java in addition to typescript, javascript, python, perl or other similar languages a plus

Familiarity with event-driven architectures, GraphQL, AI/ML platforms, or agent frameworks a plus

Experience in an Agile environment, SDLC, deployment, and operational support of scalable services

Knowledge of core web and cloud fundamentals: HTTP, REST, APIs, Public Cloud (AWS preferred)

Understanding of API gateway patterns and microservices design

Experience with FHIR standards and healthcare interoperability preferred

Understanding of authentication models (OAuth 2.0, JWT, API tokens) and authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC)

Experience building scalable APIs and microservices in public cloud environments

Familiarity with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines

Understanding of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) and distributed tracing

Healthcare organizations depend on interoperability to function—but too often lack clarity, control, and confidence in how their data moves. athenaConnect® addresses this gap by serving as the central hub where athenahealth customers and partners configure integrations, monitor data flow, and make informed decisions about their ecosystem. As athenahealth invests in creating the connections, intelligence, and experiences that unify the healthcare ecosystem, athenaConnect is evolving into a more intelligent, actionable experience—one that turns integration complexity into visibility, insight, and better outcomes. 

We are seeking a Director of Experience Design to take end-to-end ownership of the athenaConnect experience. This leader will define and steward the experience vision and architecture, build and develop a high-performing design team, and be accountable for experience quality across the entire athenaConnect app—including work delivered by product teams beyond their direct span of control. 

 

This is a role for a design leader who can set direction and drive delivery—shaping long-term vision while ensuring high-quality experiences ship continually, and who invests deeply in growing their team’s capability and impact. You will work in close partnership with Product and Engineering to plan, learn, and iterate quickly in service of real customer and partner value. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Own the athenaConnect Experience Vision & Architecture 

Define a unifying experience of vision and architecture that brings together interoperability products and services into one user-friendly platform. 

Translate industry trends, regulatory shifts, and practice expectations related to healthcare data exchange into user-centered experiences that support critical jobs-to-be-done. 

Align stakeholders around direction and tradeoffs through clear experience narratives, prototypes, and working examples. 

​

Drive Delivery, Learning, and Iteration 

Ship high-quality experiences continuously, balancing speed with clarity, usability, and trust. 

Use behavioral analytics, qualitative research, and platform telemetry to establish fast feedback loops and adapt priorities based on real user signals. 

Apply experimentation deliberately—especially with AI—to learn faster and improve outcomes, not to explore novelty. 

​

Build and Grow a High-Impact Design Team 

Lead and develop a team of 3-5 designers, establishing clear performance standards and providing regular coaching that elevates both craft and business impact. 

Evolve the team’s contribution in an AI-first world, helping designers shift from hands-on execution to expert judgment, rationale, and influence as AI increasingly handles tactical design work. 

Create operational rigor through design critique, quality review processes, and team rituals that build accountability and continuous improvement 

Address performance gaps directly, making tough decisions about fit and capability when needed. 

Develop individual growth plans that help each designer build the skills and confidence to influence product decisions and own outcomes 

​

Own Experience Quality Across Product Teams 

Own experience quality for athenaConnect end to end, including work delivered by teams you do not directly manage. 

Define and operationalize experience standards, guidelines, and governance mechanisms that ensure consistency and coherence across the platform. 

Establish and monitor customer satisfaction and value metrics (e.g., adoption, task success, trust) and use them to inform design and product decisions. 

Partner Closely with Product & Engineering Leadership 

Co-own strategy, roadmaps, and outcomes as a core member of the Product–Design–Engineering leadership triad. 

Shape how AI-enabled capabilities are introduced, so they are understandable, explainable, and useful to technical users. 

Build a team culture grounded in shared ownership, disciplined execution, and thoughtful innovation. 

 

What You Bring 

10+ years of experience in experience design, service design, or product design, including direct leadership of designers. 

Proven ownership of platform- or system-level experiences spanning multiple teams and product surfaces. 

Deep familiarity with healthcare, health IT, or regulated enterprise platforms, with experience in interoperability, data platforms, APIs, or partner ecosystems strongly preferred. 

Established track record owning experience outcomes in technically complex environments, partnering closely with engineering leaders to deliver clarity for technical users. 

Hands-on experience designing AI-enabled or data-intelligent products, particularly where trust, explain-ability, and governance were critical. 

Strong facilitation, influence, and storytelling skills, used to align senior stakeholders and drive decisions. 

Demonstrated ability to pair strategic vision with execution discipline, ensuring ideas turn into shipped, valuable outcomes. 

Strong track record coaching designers to become more strategic and influential, with specific experience helping tactically focused designers develop business acumen and stakeholder credibility. 

Demonstrated ability to establish team standards, processes, and operational excellence in fast-moving product environments. 

Comfort having difficult performance conversations and making decisions about team composition. 

 

How You’ll Work 

You’ll be effective in this role if you: 

Own outcomes, not just artifacts 

Navigate ambiguity with structure and judgment 

Operate as a true partner across disciplines 

Design for trust, coherence, and long-term adoption 

Use AI intentionally to accelerate learning and improve decisions 

Learn through delivery and raise the bar over time 

Invest in your team’s development with the same rigor you bring to product strategy 

Hold high standards for both craft quality and business impact 

 

Why This Role Matters 

athenaConnect is foundational to how athenahealth connects customers, partners, and the broader healthcare ecosystem, and its importance will only grow as AI and interoperability reshape the industry. 

This role will directly influence how intelligence, integration, and human decision-making come together in a high-stakes, highly technical platform—and how athenahealth shows up to the ecosystem over the long term. 

 

Expected Compensation
$172,000 - $292,000
The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

Experience with Active Directory, network troubleshooting, system administration (Windows/Linux)

Experience in programing languages such as: Python, Node.js, PowerShell scripts and shell scripts

Familiar with open source tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Graylog, ELK Stack

Build and deploy IaC code for Secure infrastructure automation in Azure Cloud

Business Title
Director, Procurement

Role summary
The Director, Strategic Sourcing will play a pivotal role in driving sourcing standard practices across athenahealth by leading enterprise-wide sourcing initiatives. This high-impact results-oriented role, based in the USA as a hybrid or remote position, will focus on optimizing third-party spend and mitigating risk while ensuring the reliable delivery of high-quality goods and services. The Director will report directly to the Executive Director, Global Procurement, and will be responsible for developing and executing category strategies across key spend areas including, but not limited to, IT software, IT consulting, IT hardware, and professional services.

Team summary
The Strategic Sourcing team is responsible for acquiring critical goods and services while managing the full lifecycle of sourcing best practices. The team drives supplier selection, negotiations, contract management, and supplier reviews in support of supplier/vendor performance oversight to support cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and compliance. Through continuous process improvement and strategic supplier partnerships, the team contributes significantly to athenahealth’s operational success and financial performance.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Lead the development and execution of category strategies for IT and professional services, aligned with enterprise goals and market dynamics.

Conduct spend analysis and identify opportunities to consolidate global spend for value creation and ROI optimization.

Negotiate complex supplier agreements to secure favorable terms, reduce costs, and manage risk across IT and professional services categories.

Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) including cost savings, supplier performance, and sourcing efficiency.

Analyze market trends, technology shifts, and pricing models to recommend alternative sourcing strategies and cost-effective solutions.

Partner with senior stakeholders across IT, Finance, Legal, and business units to align sourcing strategies with organizational priorities.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine policies and processes for source-to-pay, supplier qualification, and risk management.

Oversee strategic supplier relationships and lead the annual supplier performance review process.

Manage and mentor a team of 2–5 Category Managers, fostering professional development and adherence to sourcing best practices.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support the implementation of procurement technologies and platforms.

Expected Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field (MBA, JD, or equivalent graduate degree preferred).

8–10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, with a strong focus on IT software, IT consulting, IT hardware, and professional services.

Proven success in developing and executing category strategies and managing complex supplier negotiations.

Deep understanding of procurement cost structures, market dynamics, and technology trends in IT and professional services.

Experience leading sourcing teams and managing enterprise-wide sourcing initiatives in a similarly sized or related industry.

 

Expected Compensation
$140,000 - $238,000

Technical Execution

· Develop and maintain a high-performance, scalable GraphQL federation layer leveraging Apollo GraphQL Router and other related components.

· Understand and follow coding conventions, architectures, and best practices.

· Write, debug, and deploy code to production and deliver timely fixes.

· Adhere to DoD (Definition of Done) as part of the sprint, including unit tests, functional testing, code reviews, no regressions, bug fixes, documentation and adhere to best coding practices.

· Perform peer code reviews and follow athenahealth’s processes to ensure quality standards.

· Identify and implement the right tooling and libraries required for in-house and third-party development teams to adopt.

· Produce unambiguous, precise and comprehensive technical design specifications and documentations for federation architecture, API integrations, and service components.

· Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and performance.

• Strong proficiency with CRM and renewal management tools.

We are seeking a Sr People Business Partner (PBP), an advanced People strategist and trusted advisor who operates at senior leadership altitude and brings independent judgment, enterprise perspective, and strong executive influence.

This role is designed for an experienced Senior PBP who goes beyond program execution to shape people strategy, influence leadership decisions, and proactively address complex organizational challenges. You will partner closely with Vice Presidents in a dynamic, global, and evolving business environment, helping leaders translate business strategy into sustainable organizational outcomes.

As a Sr PBP, you will be expected to think ahead of the business, diagnose root causes, frame complex people and organizational issues, and recommend integrated, forward-looking solutions. You will also represent the PBP community in strategic initiatives and help elevate how People & Places work is delivered across the organization.

This role reports to the Senior Director, People Business Partner. This position will be based in Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership & Advisory

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders (VP/SVP level), providing independent perspective, challenge, and counsel on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and talent strategy

Translate business strategy into an integrated people strategy spanning workforce planning, organizational design, leadership capability, talent, and performance

Proactively identify emerging organizational risks and opportunities, frame ambiguity and present clear options and trade-offs to leaders

Organizational Effectiveness & Change

Drive and influence established organizational interventions to support business objectives, ensuring solutions are contextually grounded and scalable

Anticipate organizational reactions to change and guide leaders through complex transitions with clarity and discipline

Partner with leaders to build operating models, structures, and capabilities that enable execution today while preparing for future-state needs

Executive Coaching & Leadership Effectiveness

Provide executive coaching and consultation to senior leaders, influencing leadership behavior, decision-making, and effectiveness

Support leaders through moments of tension, trade-offs, and ambiguity, helping turn disagreement into aligned decisions

Elevate leadership capability across performance, talent decisions, and team dynamics

Talent, Workforce & Performance Strategy

Assess current and emerging talent needs; contribute to and shape talent initiatives aligned to business priorities

Guide performance, development, and career processes to ensure leadership depth and future readiness

Ensure total rewards and recognition approaches are aligned with performance, business outcomes, and organizational values

Data, Insight & Judgment

Leverage people and business data to extract meaning, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations

Apply strong judgment in selecting the most relevant data to inform decisions without slowing execution

Connect people insights to business outcomes, including efficiency, growth capacity, and leadership effectiveness

Enterprise & Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Centers of Excellence (OE, L&D, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Inclusion & Belonging) to address complex or novel business needs

Represent the PBP community on strategic, cross-functional initiatives and influence how People & Places solutions are delivered

Collaborate with internal partners to support M&A, integration, and other enterprise initiatives as required

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required.

10+ years of HR experience, including 7+ years as an HRBP/PBP supporting senior leaders in complex, global environments

Expertise across multiple HR disciplines, including: organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, performance management, org transformation, executive coaching, employee relations, and change management

Ability to influence senior leaders, frame complex organizational problems, and recommend strategic solutions

Strong business acumen, including understanding of operating models, organizational structures, and the implications of people decisions on business outcomes

Ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions and shape leadership thinking

Comfort operating in ambiguity and fast-paced, evolving environments

Curiosity and appetite to leverage AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Organizational Development, Business Administration, Industrial/Labor Relations, or related field

Executive or professional coaching accreditation

Experience partnering with technology, engineering, or product-driven organizations

Demonstrated success operating across matrixed, global organizations

Experience influencing or representing People strategy at an enterprise or cross-functional level

The Ideal Candidate

Leaders seek you out as a thought partner, not just a service provider

Organizational issues are surfaced earlier, framed clearly, and addressed with durable solutions

Leadership capability, clarity, and decision quality improve within your client group

People strategy is visibly aligned to business outcomes and future readiness

You are recognized as a Senior PBP expert within the People & Places community

Présentation du poste

Nous recherchons un Sr People Business Partner (PBP), qui soit un stratège expérimenté et un conseiller de confiance, capable d'évoluer au niveau de la haute direction et d'apporter un jugement indépendant, une perspective d'entreprise et une forte influence exécutive.

Ce rôle est destiné à un Senior PBP expérimenté qui va au-delà de l'exécution de programmes pour façonner la stratégie des ressources humaines, influencer les décisions de leadership et relever de manière proactive des défis organisationnels complexes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les vice-présidents dans un environnement commercial dynamique, international et en évolution, en aidant les dirigeants à traduire la stratégie commerciale en résultats organisationnels durables.

En tant que Sr PBP, vous devrez anticiper les besoins de l'entreprise, diagnostiquer les causes profondes, cerner les problèmes complexes liés aux ressources humaines et à l'organisation, et recommander des solutions intégrées et tournées vers l'avenir. Vous représenterez également la communauté PBP dans le cadre d'initiatives stratégiques et contribuerez à améliorer la façon dont le travail des Personnes et lieux est mené à bien dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Agir à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs (niveau vice-président/vice-président à la direction), en fournissant un point de vue indépendant, en remettant en question et en donnant des conseils sur l'efficacité organisationnelle, la capacité de leadership et la stratégie en matière de talents

Traduire la stratégie commerciale en une stratégie intégrée en matière de ressources humaines couvrant la planification de la main-d'œuvre, la conception organisationnelle, la capacité de leadership, les talents et les performances

Identifier de manière proactive les risques et les occasions organisationnels émergents, clarifier les ambiguïtés et présenter des options et des compromis clairs aux dirigeants

Diriger et influencer les interventions organisationnelles établies afin de soutenir les objectifs commerciaux, en veillant à ce que les solutions soient adaptées au contexte et évolutives

Collaborer avec les dirigeants pour créer des modèles opérationnels, des structures et des capacités qui permettent d'agir dès aujourd'hui tout en préparant les besoins futurs

Accompagnement des cadres et efficacité du leadership

Fournir un accompagnement et des conseils aux cadres supérieurs, afin d'influencer les comportements de leadership, la prise de décision et l'efficacité

Soutenir les dirigeants dans les moments de tension, de compromis et d'ambiguïté, en les aidant à transformer les désaccords en décisions concertées

Améliorer les capacités de leadership en matière de performances, de décisions relatives aux talents et de dynamiques d'équipe

Stratégie en matière de talents, de main-d'œuvre et de performance

Évaluer les besoins actuels et émergents en matière de talents; contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d'initiatives en matière de talents alignées sur les priorités commerciales

Orienter les processus de performance, de développement et de carrière afin de garantir la profondeur du leadership et la préparation pour l'avenir

Veiller à ce que les approches en matière de rémunération globale et de reconnaissance sont alignées sur la performance, les résultats commerciaux et les valeurs organisationnelles

Données, informations et jugement

Exploiter les données relatives aux personnes et à l'entreprise pour en extraire du sens, identifier les tendances et traduire les informations en recommandations exploitables

Faire preuve d'un jugement sûr dans la sélection des données les plus pertinentes pour prendre des décisions éclairées sans ralentir leur exécution

Relier les informations sur les personnes aux résultats commerciaux, notamment le rendement, la capacité de croissance et l'efficacité du leadership

Représenter la communauté PBP dans le cadre d'initiatives stratégiques interfonctionnelles et influencer la façon dont les solutions Personnes et lieux sont mises en œuvre
