Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst to support Finance transformation initiatives, with a strong emphasis on deep knowledge of enterprise application systems and hands-on end-to-end (E2E) business User Acceptance Testing (UAT). This role is focused on understanding how Finance applications work across the landscape—ERP, upstream/downstream integrations, data flows, and reporting—and partnering with Finance stakeholders and Engineering teams to validate that releases perform correctly in real business scenarios.
 

The position plays a key contributing role in Finance UAT across Autodesk’s SAP Finance landscape, helping ensure system changes meet business outcomes, internal controls, and compliance standards. While this role does not own the overall UAT program, it is critical to planning test coverage, executing E2E scenarios, identifying defects early, and driving resolution through clear evidence and collaboration.
 

Key Responsibilities
 

Application Systems Expertise & Release Readiness

Develop strong functional and technical understanding of Autodesk’s Finance application ecosystem, primarily SAP Finance, including key integrations, master data dependencies, and reporting outputs

Perform impact analysis for changes across E2E Finance flows (e.g., Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Revenue, Billing, Payments, Intercompany), identifying affected systems, interfaces, controls, and downstream consumers

Partner with Engineering, Product, and Finance stakeholders to understand intended changes and translate them into test coverage and release readiness criteria (entry/exit)

Support environment and data readiness for UAT (test data setup, prerequisite configuration, reference data, and access), coordinating with relevant teams

Review release notes, design artifacts, and technical details (integration mappings, interface specs, data transformations) to anticipate testing risks and edge cases
 

End-to-End Business UAT (Primary Focus)

Design, build, and execute E2E UAT scenarios that reflect real business operations and validate cross-system behavior—from upstream transaction creation through ERP postings and downstream reporting/analytics

Create and maintain UAT test cases, scripts, and evidence that are auditable and traceable to business outcomes and control requirements

Validate accounting impact and system behavior including postings, document flow, tax/FX, revenue recognition outcomes, period-end processing, and management reporting outputs as applicable

Execute both positive and negative tests, including boundary conditions and integration failure scenarios (e.g., interface errors, timing issues, data quality breaks)

Log defects with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/logs, expected vs. actual results, and business impact; partner with Engineering teams through triage, fix validation, and regression testing

Participate in select PST-hour meetings during testing cycles (handoffs, triage, status) to improve collaboration and reduce cycle time

Contribute to continuous improvement of Finance UAT processes, tooling, templates, and test repositories
 

Quality, Controls & Compliance

Ensure testing aligns with internal control expectations (including SOX-relevant processes), documenting evidence and outcomes required for audit readiness

Identify and communicate risks related to testing gaps, control impacts, or deferred scope; recommend mitigation and retest plans

Support sign-off readiness by summarizing test results, open defects, residual risk, and recommended go/no-go considerations
 

Stakeholder Partnership (Focused on Testing and System Outcomes)

Work closely with Finance stakeholders to validate business scenarios, confirm expected outcomes, and ensure UAT reflects operational reality

Coordinate with US-based testing leads, Project Managers, and global teams on schedules, handoffs, and execution status

Explain system behavior and testing findings in clear business terms, helping stakeholders make informed release decisions
 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field

Professional certifications such as CA, CPA, CMA, or relevant QA/testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are preferred

8–10+ years of experience working with enterprise application systems supporting Finance processes (ERP and integrated systems), with significant hands-on involvement in business UAT

Strong hands-on experience with SAP Finance modules and processes; experience with SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) and Management Reporting (MR) is highly desirable

Proven experience designing and executing E2E test scenarios across multiple systems and integrations (APIs, middleware, batch interfaces), including defect triage and regression testing

Should have experience managing UAT'S pertaining to major system upgrades, roadmap enhancements and new application/entity rollouts

Experience working in global, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively across time zones

Strong understanding of Finance processes and accounting concepts, with the ability to validate ERP postings and reporting outputs

Position Overview

Autodesk's Technical Advisory organization is transforming how implementation expertise reaches customers. We are building a systematic capability to capture, structure, and publish innovation and implementation expertise as scalable digital content through our digital offerings.

The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge will lead the team responsible for this end-to-end knowledge pipeline — from capturing field intelligence through customer-facing publication. Reporting to the Director of Platform & Productization within Global Delivery & Solutions, you will manage a multidisciplinary team of approximately analysts and specialists who form the critical bridge between consulting delivery and the digital platform.

In the first year, you will prove the knowledge pipeline works — capturing implementation expertise from consulting engagements and publishing the first customer-facing knowledge assets through the platform. You will also establish the quality standards and lifecycle governance — capture, validate, publish, retire — that make knowledge trustworthy at scale.

This is a building role. You will define the processes, quality standards, and success metrics for a maturing capability at Autodesk. The right person brings both intellectual rigor about knowledge management and practical instincts about what consultants will actually adopt.

Responsibilities

Knowledge Capture and Curation

Own the knowledge capture process design and operation, starting with manual consultant interviews and evolving toward platform-integrated capture as our digital offering matures

Define what constitutes a useful record of implementation — the right level of contextual detail, artifact organization, provenance, and narrative that makes knowledge reusable across engagements

Establish lifecycle governance for knowledge assets: capture, validation, publication, versioning, and retirement, ensuring content remains accurate and current as Autodesk products and customer practices evolve

Partner with consulting delivery leadership globally to drive knowledge contribution adoption, designing incentives and workflows that embed capture into the natural rhythm of engagements

Knowledge Synthesis and Publication

Lead the team that synthesizes across multiple implementation records to identify patterns, create structured knowledge assets, and prepare content in the platform data model

Partner with product management to determine which knowledge assets should be productized and through which channels, providing readiness assessments and market value input

Develop production workflows for creating customer-ready content at scale, with clear quality gates and editorial standards

Define and track metrics that demonstrate maturing knowledge management capability: volume and quality of knowledge captured, reuse rates, time savings for consultants, content published and consumed through the platform

Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a new content and knowledge team, establishing role clarity and career paths for a discipline that is new within our organization

Hire and onboard new team members as the function scales

Coordinate with Architecture and Engineering on knowledge data model requirements and ingestion pipeline design — you own what knowledge looks like, they own how it's stored and served

Provide regular reporting to leadership on knowledge pipeline performance, adoption, and business impact

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of experience in information management, knowledge management, content strategy, consulting delivery, or a related field with progressive responsibility

3+ years of experience developing teams

Experience designing systematic processes for capturing and organizing expert knowledge, institutional IP, or implementation methodologies — including quality governance and content lifecycle management

Track record of building cross-functional collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong analytical skills with ability to define and measure success for ambiguous, emerging capabilities

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

The Ideal Candidate

Has worked in professional services, consulting, or implementation delivery and understands what consultants do on engagements

Has built knowledge management, information management, or content operations functions from early stage — comfortable defining process before having technology to automate it

Understands the difference between documenting procedures and capturing the contextual judgment that makes knowledge valuable — and has opinions about provenance, traceability, and what makes knowledge trustworthy enough for AI-mediated delivery

Is experienced in working with engineering and product teams to translate content requirements into platform features

Has familiarity with architecture, engineering, construction, operations (AECO), manufacturing, or media and entertainment industries

Is energized by building something new

Track assets and equipment across the entire project lifecycle, from planning to commissioning to handover. 

Customize workflows and visualize progress in the field and office. 

Integrate asset data with field collaboration tools and documents to reduce risk and improve project outcomes.

Partner with designers and product managers to deliver intuitive, visually polished experiences that solve real construction workflows

Drive technical design discussions and help shape the strategic direction of frontend architecture

Mentor engineers on frontend best practices, architecture, and scalable solution patterns

Nous recherchons un développeur web front-end principal pour rejoindre l'équipe travaillant sur Autodesk Construction Cloud Assets, un produit phare de la suite Autodesk dédiée à la construction.

Assets, en particulier, offre un suivi fiable des actifs et des équipements de construction, des flux de travail personnalisables et des outils de collaboration intégrés sur le terrain qui aident les équipes à gérer les actifs physiques, depuis la spécification jusqu'à la réception et la remise.

À ce poste, votre responsabilité sera de créer, de faire évoluer et de maintenir les applications frontales qui alimentent l'un des produits les plus influents du secteur de l'AEC, offrant des expériences essentielles aux professionnels de la construction du monde entier. Vous aurez l'opportunité d'influencer l'architecture, d'améliorer la qualité et les performances frontales, et d'encadrer d'autres ingénieurs alors que nous améliorons la façon dont les équipes de construction gèrent les actifs et les équipements dans le cadre de projets internationaux.

Autodesk Construction Cloud est un leader mondial dans le domaine des technologies de la construction. Il propose des outils étroitement connectés qui éliminent les silos de données et permettent aux équipes de livrer leurs projets dans les délais et le budget impartis.

Assets est un élément essentiel de cet écosystème. Il permet aux équipes de :

Suivre les actifs et les équipements tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, de la planification à la mise en service, en passant par la remise.

De personnaliser les flux de travail et de visualiser l'avancement des travaux sur le terrain et au bureau.

D'intégrer les données relatives aux actifs aux outils de collaboration sur le terrain et aux documents afin de réduire les risques et d'améliorer les résultats des projets.

En tant qu'ingénieur principal sur ce produit, vous disposerez de la liberté technique nécessaire pour influencer l'architecture de base, améliorer les pratiques d'ingénierie et contribuer directement au succès des clients qui gèrent des milliards de dollars d'actifs de construction dans le monde entier.

Il s'agit d'un poste entièrement à distance basé au Canada.

Responsabilités

Concevoir, développer et adapter des expériences frontales hautes performances pour Assets, utilisé à l'échelle mondiale pour le suivi, la mise en service et la remise des actifs

Diriger et étendre notre architecture micro-frontale à l'aide de Module Federation pour un développement frontal modulaire à l'échelle de l'entreprise

Créer des composants d'interface utilisateur accessibles, réactifs et réutilisables qui s'intègrent de manière transparente aux outils de terrain tels que les formulaires, les problèmes, les photos et les documents

Collaborer avec les concepteurs et les chefs de produit afin de fournir des expériences intuitives et visuellement soignées qui répondent aux besoins réels des flux de travail dans le domaine de la construction

Mener des initiatives visant à améliorer les performances frontales : optimisation de la taille des paquets, fractionnement du code, chargement différé et performances d'exécution pour les déploiements d'entreprise

Intégrer les meilleures pratiques en matière de tests, d'accessibilité et de performances au sein de l'équipe

Animer les discussions sur la conception technique et contribuer à définir l'orientation stratégique de l'architecture frontale

Encadrer les ingénieurs sur les meilleures pratiques frontales, l'architecture et les modèles de solutions évolutives

Our tools help architects, urban planners, and real estate developers find the smartest and most sustainable ways to unlock the potential of their projects. In each team, software and machine-learning engineers work closely together with product managers and designers, collaborating across functions and time zones. Autonomy also means it’s up to you to decide where you’d like to work from; we strongly believe in a hybrid working culture. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will use your technical expertise and strategic thinking to drive progress across team boundaries. You’ll work on ambitious challenges, from evolving core architecture to improving scalability and performance across the product. You’ll mentor engineers, lead by example, drive high-impact technical contributions, and help align engineering efforts with broader business objectives. You’ll be surrounded by fun, highly engaged people who are empowered to lead initiatives that make a lasting impact. In the spirit of servant leadership, we hope you will also share your knowledge and expertise with other engineers.

Operates with a high degree of autonomy and clarity in ambiguous situations 

Drives architectural and strategic decisions across squads or domains 

Recognized as a domain expert or strong generalist across multiple technologies 

Brings others along by mentoring, enabling, and fostering technical growth 

Continuously identifies areas for improvement in how we work and delivers change 

Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes 

Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful impact at scale

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Software Developer in Test (Senior SDET) to join our Trust Software development team. This role represents a full-contributor level position, requiring strong technical expertise across quality development and test automation, along with the ability to independently drive complex testing initiatives.

As a Senior SDET, you will design, implement, and evolve automated testing solutions while working closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders. You will apply sound judgment, data analysis, and best practices to solve complex quality challenges, connecting individual efforts to broader product and platform objectives.

Responsibilities

Quality Development & Automation

Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, tools, and test suites to ensure high-quality, reliable software

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, enabling rapid feedback and consistent delivery

Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts across unit, integration, functional, performance, security, and regression testing

Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams to drive timely resolution

Apply testing best practices to ensure software meets functional, performance, reliability, and security requirements

Problem Solving & Technical Contribution

Solve complex quality and automation problems by applying best practices, taking new perspectives on existing solutions, and adapting approaches based on data and outcomes

Use analysis and judgment to select appropriate testing strategies, tools, and levels of coverage

“Connect the dots” between individual testing initiatives and broader system behavior, user experience, and business impact

Contribute to improving existing test processes, tools, and frameworks to reduce manual effort and increase confidence in releases

Collaboration & Project Leadership

Lead testing efforts for features or key components within larger initiatives, owning quality outcomes for assigned areas

Collaborate closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to align quality goals with development objectives

Build effective working relationships with senior developers and peers, and actively participate in the broader quality development community

May provide guidance or mentorship to junior developers or less experienced SDETs on tools, practices, and approaches

Continuous Improvement

Contribute to the evolution of testing methodologies, standards, and best practices within the team

Stay current with industry trends, tools, and techniques in test automation and quality development

Participate in reviews and retrospectives, using feedback and metrics to continuously improve quality outcomes

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

6–9 years of experience in software quality development and test automation

Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or C++, with experience writing maintainable, production-quality test code

Experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Appium, JUnit, or TestNG

Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines and tooling, including Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, and Terraform

Experience testing systems deployed on AWS, including services such as API Gateway, Lambda, SQS/SNS, S3, CloudWatch, ECS, and databases (Aurora, DynamoDB, Snowflake)

Working knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner)

Understanding of security fundamentals, including authentication/authorization, secure transport (TLS/SSL), and common compliance considerations

Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies

Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Ability to work independently, with guidance provided at key decision points

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud-based testing environments and tools

Familiarity with security testing practices and tools

Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, and backend system testing

Certification in quality assurance or test automation (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE)

Build and maintain deep insights in how architects and engineers use geodata in their projects so our work on exploring, evaluating and integrating relevant data sets, either from open, public sources, or from third-party vendors, will maximize user value 

 

Making geo data sets available to users - both via GUIs and APIs - in the simplest and most intuitive way. 

 

Expressing and communicating data quality to users in clear and understandable ways, also when the available metrics are inconsistent, unpredictable, unknown, and/or highly technical.

Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns

Position Overview
We are seeking a research intern to explore fundamental challenges in geometry, design understanding, and relative spatial reasoning for vision-language models (VLMs). While modern VLMs have shown strong performance on captioning, semantic understanding, and segmentation, they continue to struggle with geometric reasoning, layout understanding, and precise relative positioning—capabilities that are critical for design, engineering, and creation workflows.
During this internship, you will work closely with research mentors to investigate new modeling and training paradigms that move beyond one-shot visual reasoning. The project will focus on approaches such as reinforcement learning, test-time computation, and “thinking with images,” where models iteratively attend to visual evidence, reason over intermediate representations, and verify hypotheses through visual feedback. The goal is to advance state-of-the-art methods for spatially grounded reasoning and contribute insights relevant to both the research community and Autodesk’s long-term vision for intelligent design tools.
Over the course of the internship, you will define and drive a focused research project, including model development, experimental validation, and analysis, with the opportunity to publish results and present findings internally and externally.

Responsibilities

Define and execute a research project focused on geometric reasoning, spatial understanding, and layout awareness in vision-language models

Conduct literature reviews to identify limitations of existing VLMs and relevant prior work in multimodal reasoning and reinforcement learning

Design and implement novel training or inference strategies using reinforcement learning, test-time computation, or iterative visual reasoning

Develop model architectures, training pipelines, and evaluation benchmarks for spatial and geometric tasks

Run large-scale experiments, analyze results, and iterate on model designs based on empirical findings

Compare proposed approaches against strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods

Collaborate closely with research mentors and other researchers, sharing progress and incorporating feedback

Author a research paper suitable for submission to a top-tier machine learning or computer vision conference

Present research results internally at Autodesk and externally at academic venues

Minimum Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a closely related field

Must have at least one academic remaining semester post internship

Strong publication record in top-tier ML or vision conferences (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV)

Hands-on experience training vision-language models and reinforcement learning algorithms

Strong implementation skills using modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TRL, Ray)

Solid background in machine learning fundamentals and experimental research methodology

Ability to work independently on open-ended research problems and communicate results clearly

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multimodal or embodied reasoning, test-time optimization, or iterative inference methods

Familiarity with geometric vision, spatial reasoning benchmarks, or synthetic visual datasets

Experience scaling experiments on distributed systems or large compute clusters

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Baker Hughes je přední globální energeticko‑technologická společnost, která poskytuje inovativní řešení zvyšující bezpečnost, čistotu a efektivitu energie napříč celým hodnotovým řetězcem. výroba cívek pro rotory generátorů

výroba statorových tyčí generátorů

praxe v oboru výhodou

FIELD OPERATOR II – TBL

Impulsando la excelencia operativa mediante la ejecución segura de actividades en campo, el cumplimiento de estándares QHSSE y la operación especializada de herramientas para manejo de tubulares.

Transformando el desempeño operativo a través de disciplina, precisión técnica y compromiso con la seguridad.

Únete a los mejores

Baker Hughes es una empresa global de tecnología energética con presencia en más de 120 países. Nuestro equipo de operaciones en campo desempeña un rol esencial en la entrega segura, eficiente y confiable de servicios para la industria del petróleo y gas. Con un enfoque en seguridad, calidad y mejora continua, buscamos profesionales altamente capacitados que contribuyan al éxito de nuestras operaciones.

Impulsa tu pasión

El rol de FIELD OPERATOR II – TBL es fundamental para garantizar la correcta ejecución de actividades operativas, el mantenimiento de equipos, la operación de herramientas de apriete (Power Tongs) y la aplicación rigurosa de los estándares QHSSE. Este puesto requiere habilidades técnicas, criterio operativo y un compromiso absoluto con la seguridad y el cumplimiento.

Como FIELD OPERATOR II – TBL, serás responsable de:

Asistir y completar todos los cursos obligatorios, cumpliendo con las políticas y procedimientos de QHSSE y Compliance mediante los sistemas definidos por la empresa.

Reportar actos y condiciones inseguras, y participar en el programa de tarjetas de observación (mínimo 3 tarjetas mensuales en Intelex por empleado) y en otros programas del sistema de gestión HSE.

Detener actividades utilizando la autoridad de Paro de Trabajo cuando se identifiquen actos o condiciones inseguras, conforme a las políticas de seguridad y calidad de Baker Hughes.

Maximizar la eficiencia de los recursos asignados, utilizándolos de manera racional y eficaz, y contribuir con soluciones que impulsen el desarrollo de la compañía.

Asegurarse de contar con el equipo de protección personal completo y con la documentación vigente requerida por el contrato bajo el cual se realizan las operaciones.

Informar amenazas, riesgos, hechos o conductas contrarias a las políticas de seguridad, salud y medicina del trabajo.

Mantener comunicación regular con el Coordinador y/o Supervisor de Operaciones.

Notificar de inmediato cualquier incapacidad para realizar tareas operativas.

Comunicarse de manera efectiva con clientes y personal subcontratado.

Asistir a conferencias y reuniones de seguridad en plataforma, presentando temas relevantes cuando sea necesario.

Ejecutar mantenimientos rutinarios, preventivos, correctivos, reparaciones y calibraciones de los equipos designados, siguiendo instructivos y manuales del fabricante.

Reportar oportunamente fallas o defectos en los equipos y participar activamente en su corrección.

Preparar, instalar, operar y desmantelar herramientas de apriete e introducción de tubulares (Power Tongs y equipos relacionados).

Verificar antes y durante la operación que los equipos estén en buenas condiciones y sean adecuados para la tarea.

Mantener comunicación constante con el Supervisor de Campo y el personal de la cuadrilla.

Para tener éxito en este rol deberás:

Ser Ingeniero o Técnico en Petróleos o áreas afines.

Contar con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en operaciones de campo.

Tener experiencia en el manejo de herramientas Power Tongs o llaves hidráulicas.

Driving Service Delivery Excellence Through Data‑Backed Insights and Cementing Operations

Partner with the best
Baker Hughes es una compañía global de tecnología energética que opera en más de 120 países, ofreciendo soluciones integradas para la industria del petróleo y gas. El equipo de Pressure Pumping – Cementación es responsable de ejecutar operaciones críticas en pozo, garantizando la integridad, seguridad y calidad del servicio tanto en operaciones terrestres como costa fuera. A través de estándares globales, disciplina operativa y mejora continua, impulsamos una ejecución segura y eficiente alineada con las necesidades técnicas de nuestros clientes.

Fuel your passion
Como FIELD OPER IV / V – Operador de UAP, serás un recurso clave en la ejecución de operaciones de cementación en campo. Este rol es responsable de la correcta preparación, operación y mantenimiento de los equipos de cementación, así como de la coordinación operativa en sitio para asegurar que cada trabajo se ejecute conforme a los estándares de Baker Hughes, los requisitos del cliente y las políticas de HSE. Tu experiencia técnica y compromiso operativo serán fundamentales para lograr una entrega de servicio consistente y de alta calidad.

Responsabilidades principales
Ejecutar operaciones de cementación en pozos terrestres y offshore, incluyendo cementación de TR’s, liners, tapones, squeeze y tie back.
Operar equipos y sistemas de cementación tales como UAP, Batch Mixer, silos, cabezas de cementar y equipos auxiliares de una operación de cementación.
Planificar y coordinar las operaciones en sitio, asegurando que equipos, herramientas y materiales estén preparados, probados y listos antes de la salida a campo y al arribo al pozo.
Participar activamente en el pre‑job planning y en la revisión de programas de trabajo, análisis de riesgos y planes de contingencia.
Preparar y entregar reportes completos de operación, incluyendo checklists de equipos y herramientas de cementación.
Realizar mantenimiento operativo y preventivo de los equipos y herramientas de cementación.
Gestionar y resguardar inventarios de suministros, equipos y herramientas asignadas a la operación.
Mantener comunicación constante con el representante del cliente en pozo, el equipo de perforación y el personal de apoyo en campo.
Dar seguimiento a eventos de calidad del servicio y apoyar el cierre oportuno de incidentes con acciones correctivas que eviten recurrencias.
Participar en el intercambio de conocimientos, mejores prácticas y lecciones aprendidas dentro del equipo de cementación.
Garantizar que todas las actividades se ejecuten conforme a los estándares de calidad del servicio, salud, seguridad y medio ambiente de Baker Hughes y del cliente.
Demostrar disponibilidad y compromiso con las responsabilidades del rol, incluyendo trabajo en turnos y bajo condiciones operativas demandantes.

Requisitos para tener éxito
Licenciatura, TSU o formación técnica equivalente.
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia comprobable en operaciones de cementación de pozos terrestres y offshore.
Experiencia práctica ejecutando trabajos de cementación primaria y remedial.
Conocimiento comprobado en la operación de equipos y herramientas de cementación (UAP, Batch Mixer, silos, cabezas de cementar).
Experiencia en mantenimiento operativo de equipos de cementación.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, comunicarse de manera efectiva y seguir instrucciones operativas.
Alto compromiso con HSE, integridad operativa y cumplimiento de procedimientos.

Deseable
Experiencia en roles de mayor responsabilidad operativa o liderazgo en campo.
Participación en operaciones críticas o de alta complejidad técnica.
Conocimiento de procesos de calidad del servicio y análisis de incidentes.

Supporting special projects as assigned.

Have experience supporting field operations, chemical programs, or production chemical applications.

Compiler Development

Debug and troubleshoot issues across the full stack — from compiler output to UI behaviour.

Foundational understanding of backend development — ideally Node.js.

Společnost působí ve ice než 120 zemích a kombinuje hluboké znalosti odvětví s pokročilým inženýrstvím a digitálními technologiemi na podporu výroby energie, její transformace a dekarbonizace. Rozviňte svou vášeň

Specialista materiálového plánování hraje klíčovou roli v zajištění hladkého průběhu výroby prostřednictvím plánování, koordinace a řízení toků materiálu v celém výrobním prostředí. Tato pozice převádí signály poptávky (prognózy, zákaznické objednávky, plánované výrobní příkazy) do konkrétních materiálových plánů a zajišťuje včasnou dostupnost komponent na výrobní lince. Díky udržování přesných dat, optimalizaci zásob a podpoře neustálého zlepšování přispíváte k provozní dokonalosti a dodržování termínů dodávek.

Vaše odpovědnosti budou zahrnovat:

Plánování a rozvrhování materiálu tak, aby byly splněny výrobní požadavky a nedocházelo k výpadkům.

Převádění prognóz poptávky do materiálových objednávek ve spolupráci s výrobou, dodavatelským řetězcem a obchodními týmy.

Analýzu přicházející poptávky a identifikaci výjimek nebo příležitostí k využití stávajících zásob.

Udržování přesných plánů materiálu v souladu s požadavky zákazníků a provozními potřebami.

Sledování úrovní zásob, bezpečnostních zásob, stárnoucího materiálu a materiálu v přepravě, aby byla zajištěna optimální dostupnost.

Koordinaci priorit materiálu s týmy Product Line, Sales a Service Delivery (posuny termínů, urychlení dodávek).

Provádění analýz v oblasti materiálového hospodářství, včetně trendů spotřeby a celkového stavu zásob.

Podporu iniciativ neustálého zlepšování s cílem zefektivnit tok materiálu a zvýšit provozní výkonnost.

Abyste byli v této roli úspěšní, budete potřebovat:

Středoškolské nebo vyšší odborné vzdělání v oblasti supply chain, logistiky, výroby, nebo odpovídající praxi.

Zkušenosti s plánováním materiálu, řízením zásob, výrobním plánováním nebo správou objednávek.

Základní znalost SAP, MRP nebo podobných plánovacích systémů.

Silné analytické a problémové myšlení a důraz na detail.

Schopnost spolupracovat napříč týmy a ovlivňovat klíčové partnery ve výrobě a dodavatelském řetězci.

Schopnost dotahovat úkoly do konce, pracovat s pocitem naléhavosti a převzít odpovědnost.

Plynulou češtinu v psané i mluvené formě pro efektivní komunikaci ve výrobním prostředí.

Certifikace APICS nebo podobná kvalifikace v oblasti supply chain.

Process Engineer for Energy Systems

Do you want to work on technologies at the very core of future energy systems? Are you excited by a role where you connect mechanics, process engineering, electrical systems, and controls into one functional whole?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a leading global energy‑technology company providing innovative solutions that enhance the safety, cleanliness, and efficiency of energy across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company combines deep industry expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With more than a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion

The Process Engineer for Energy Systems plays a key role in the functional integration of all mechanical and process subsystems (cooling, lubrication, sealing, auxiliary systems) into the synchronous condenser package. You will act as the link between mechanical design, electrical integration, and control logic. Your work ensures that the entire system operates safely, efficiently, and reliably.

As a Process Engineer for Energy Systems, you will be responsible for:

System integration: Defining and managing interfaces between mechanical components (pumps, compressors, coolers) and electrical/control systems. Ensuring compatibility and performance of the entire system.

Oversight of auxiliary systems: Specifying and validating auxiliary circuits such as oil systems, water cooling, and ventilation, including their safety and operational parameters.

Process design: Creating and optimizing process flow diagrams (PFDs) and piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) for the synchronous condenser and its supporting systems.

Design coordination: Working closely with electrical engineers and control system specialists to align mechanical processes with control logic and electrical constraints.

Technical risk management: Identifying and mitigating risks related to thermal performance, fluid flow, and mechanical interactions.

ITO/OTR support: Providing technical input during the inquiry‑to‑order (ITO) phase and the order‑to‑remittance (OTR) execution phase, especially for system decisions and customer technical clarifications.

To be successful in this role, you will:

Have strong knowledge of mechanical or process engineering with a systems‑thinking approach.

Bring experience with rotating machinery and auxiliary systems (lubrication circuits, sealing systems, cooling).

Understand principles of system integration and interface management between subsystems.

Be able to read, interpret, and create PFDs, P&IDs, and interface control documents.

Understand compliance requirements (TRS, HSE, cyber‑physical interfaces).

Collaborate effectively with electrical, controls, and project teams.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and works best in different ways. In this role, we can offer flexible working arrangements. Please discuss available options with the recruiter.

Project Delivery Manager 

Are you a passionate Project Delivery Manager interested to work in oil and gas sector ? 

Are you seeking a challenging opportunity for your career growth ? 

The Subsea Project Delivery Manager is responsible to ensure all aspects of contract and customer commitment is realized through out project execution, On Time Delivery, Quality, HSE, Cost Control and Risk Management as defined by the Customer’s Order or Contract, fulfilling both Customer and Business objectives. The Project Manager is the primary interface between the Company and the Customer internationally and locally with regards to the assigned scope and is responsible for developing and maintaining a good working relationship with the Customer and its representatives. 

Partner the best 

The Project Delivery Manager will lead and develop the internal project team in support of achieving the agreed project goals, ensuring all relevant procedures and processes are followed. Where appropriate, the PM will be required to support ongoing Business Development activities and provide support to tendering process. 

The PM will be a visible leader and advocate of HSE and Quality for all relevant sites for the project and will work closely with all supporting functions in the fulfilment of the project.

If applicable, and in liaison with the Commercial organization, to negotiate and agree Contract terms and conditions, including all Clarifications and Exceptions, during the Bid/Award phase. Following Award, and through the established Contract Review process, translate the agreed terms and conditions into project/sales orders and establish the internal scope of work. 

Ensure that all necessary project functions, including HSE and Quality, are established and organized in a way that ensure an effective and safe execution of the scope of work. 

Build the Project Team into a dedicated and enthusiastic unit for the task through exhibiting good management practice, leading by example, setting, and monitoring the standards expected for other team members and holding team accountable. Establish clear roles and responsibilities within the project team. 

Establish and communicate project goals and ensure that these are fully understood and met throughout the project and within own organization. 

Establish and maintain clear lines of communication within the Customer and Project Organization 

Work closely with Customers Project team and/or the SPS Project Director to build and maintain a good relationship with the Customer thereby helping to ensure the timely resolution of issues. 

Ensure that project schedule with milestones and cost budgets are established. Generate, in conjunction with the designated project Accountant, all cost control and reporting templates and reports. Continually monitor the Projects’ cost performance throughout its duration. 

Reports potential changes in scope and schedule to SPS Projects PD/ Business leaders (if applicable). 

Ensure that all the necessary technical and non-technical reviews and audits are planned and carried out. 

Monitor the project's performance in a systematic way regarding Quality, Safety, Progress, and cost and initiate the necessary corrective/mitigating actions should deviations occur. Ensure that performance is communicated to the customer and SPS Projects Project Director with respect to progress, changes, manning, forecasts to complete, all reported as agreed. 

Effectively manage internal Variation Orders and Customer instigated Change Orders, including their internal price clearance, submission and negotiation, implementation, and tracking. Consider schedule, safety, and environmental impacts of all changes (in addition to cost) and maximize opportunities for margin growth through the change process.

 Ensure Lessons Learned are capture and Implemented throughout the project life cycle.

About This Role:

As a Therapeutic Area Lead within Biogen’s Global Clinical Supply Chain, you will play a pivotal leadership role in advancing our dynamic and growing clinical portfolio. You will lead the end-to-end clinical supply chain strategy for a therapeutic area portfolio focused on late-stage clinical development while shaping the future of how clinical supply chains operate.

Beyond operational delivery, this role is central to Biogen’s transformation. You will help redefine how our clinical supply chains operates by harnessing data to yield new insights, establishing modernized planning approaches, and cementing new ways of working. You will directly contribute to the accelerating product-to-patient timelines and elevate supply chain performance across cost, quality, and service.

As a senior leader within Biogen’s West Coast Hub, you will build and grow clinical supply chain capabilities, advance critical late-stage programs toward launch, and partner closely with Clinical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, and R&D to drive integrated, forward-looking supply strategies.

This is a hybrid role (2-3 days in-office per week) to be based out of our office in San Francisco, CA.

What You’ll Do:

Lead end‑to‑end clinical supply chain planning and execution for multiple products within your therapeutic area, with a strong focus on late‑stage clinical development.

Ensure uninterrupted clinical supply through robust, risk‑based supply plans that optimize cost, minimize waste, and meet quality and regulatory requirements.

Set the strategic direction for your portfolio, influencing program decisions in alignment with enterprise and therapeutic strategies.

Build, coach, and develop a high‑performing global team, fostering accountability, engagement, and career growth.

Drive the evolution of clinical supply chain capabilities by standardizing practices, advancing Centers of Excellence, and leading continuous improvement initiatives.

Champion digital transformation that replace manual processes with integrated workflows, enhance data visibility, and enable faster, better‑informed decisions.

Manage financial planning and deliver against budget and performance targets for the therapeutic area.

Serve as a senior PO&T leader within the West Coast Hub, strengthening cross‑functional collaboration, communication and alignment.

Who You Are:

You are a strategic, forward‑thinking leader who thrives at the intersection of operations, people leadership, and transformation. You are energized by complexity and ambiguity and are motivated by the opportunity to build something better: stronger processes, smarter systems, and more empowered teams.

You are known for your ability to influence across functions, develop talent, and translate strategy into execution. You embrace change, actively seek new technologies and data‑driven insights, and are passionate about improving how work gets done to accelerate impact for patients.

People management experience and/or Cross-Functional Project Management experience.

Experience within a global and regulated environment.

Strong influencing and negotiation skills.

Ability to anticipate risks and develop contingency plans.

MBA is highly preferred.

APICS certification or Lean Six Sigma/Green Belt is considered an asset.

About This Role:
As a Senior IT Business Partner for Biogen’s patient engagement initiatives, you will play a crucial role supporting digital patient engagement initiatives within the Patient Services IT team. In this position, you will act as a techno-functional bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and understanding. You bring deep expertise in patient engagement processes and how technology supports the end-to-end patient journey. You will work closely with franchise leadership, Patient Services, Patient Access, and External Growth & Innovation teams to co-develop and execute a comprehensive digital and technology roadmap. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of patient engagement at Biogen, ensuring that innovative solutions are developed and implemented to enhance patient support and care.
 

What You’ll Do:

Serve as the patient engagement process expert: Build deep knowledge of how Biogen supports patients today, covering intake, onboarding, case management, adherence, and ongoing support. Understand pain points, data flows, and how end-users (case managers, nurses, patients) interact with technology, including Health Cloud.

Bridge business and technical teams: Translate stakeholder needs into detailed technical requirements and relay architectural considerations back to business partners. Ensure that Health Cloud configurations, integrations, and new digital tools align with patient engagement objectives and regulatory requirements.

Develop and execute the patient engagement technology roadmap: Co-lead the creation of a multi-year roadmap in partnership with Patient Services, Patient Access, and External Growth & Innovation. Prioritize initiatives such as digital onboarding, self-service portals, AI-enabled support, and personalized engagement journeys.

Drive pilot programs: Work with cross-functional teams and technical architects to plan, test, and refine pilot initiatives. Collect feedback from end-users, troubleshoot issues, and evaluate results to inform broader rollouts.

Collaborate across functions: Engage stakeholders from the Lupus franchise, Patient Services, Patient Access, and External Growth & Innovation to ensure technology solutions meet business needs. Facilitate workshops, demos, and training sessions to promote adoption and gather requirements.

Ensure readiness for launch: Track progress against critical timelines, coordinate integration with other systems (e.g., EMR/EHR, data platforms), and identify risks. Maintain clear communication with the Patient Services IT Director and senior leadership on status, issues, and recommendations.
 

Who You Are:
You are a collaborative, detail-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of business and technology. You are passionate about improving patient experiences and have a strong understanding of how digital tools can support patient services operations. You are comfortable engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and excel at translating complex needs into practical solutions.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.

 7+ years of experience in Patient Services IT. Demonstrated ability to gather business requirements and manage delivery through cross-functional teams.

Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud or similar platforms.

Deep understanding of patient support processes and familiarity with specialty therapies or pharmaceutical patient services.

Knowledge of data privacy and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA) for patient data.

Ability to communicate effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders as well as ability to influence without authority.

Are you looking to start your career within the global biotech industry? Join our 2‑year Global Customer Excellence & Operations (GCE&O) Graduate Program. The program offers a unique opportunity to apply your academic background in a global context while developing a broad set of strategic, analytical and cross‑functional business competencies through three rotations over two years. The program is designed to give recent Master’s graduates the opportunity to jumpstart their careers and develop into the next generation of leaders at Biogen.

About the GCE&O Graduate Program

Biogen’s Global Customer Excellence & Operations (GCE&O) organization spans a broad range of business functions, supporting insights generation, operational excellence, patient identification, performance management, forecasting, and analytics. While roles differ significantly across the organization, all teams share a commitment to excellence and to ensuring Biogen delivers meaningful impact for patients.

The program is designed for recent graduates to work closely with GCE&O leadership, learning from experienced mentors and building an international network of colleagues. Rotations are tailored to the graduate’s development needs and the organization’s priorities, ensuring both meaningful contribution and personal growth.

Over the two years, the graduate will rotate through three key areas within GCE&O, gaining exposure to decision support, patient finding, insights generation, performance analytics, forecasting, and local business and market dynamics.

The Role

During the 2‑year GCE&O Graduate Program, you will complete three rotations:

Rotation 1 – Customer & Market Insights (CMI)

In CMI rotation, you will support strategic insights generation related to performance, market dynamics, and reporting. You will leverage qualitative and quantitative data sources, primary and secondary market research, and advanced analytics. Responsibilities include:

Developing and automating management reporting and KPI dashboards

Supporting long‑range forecasts, scenario planning, and market assumptions

Conducting competitive intelligence and market research

Providing analysis for Brand Leads to support strategic decision‑making

Supporting business review cycles and annual operating planning

Rotation 2 – Patient Finding

In this rotation, you will focus on patient Identification, Engagement and Activation across multiple therapeutic areas, with a strong emphasis on rare diseases. This includes:

Using real‑world data and AI/ML tools to identify undiagnosed or misdiagnosed patients

Driving cross‑functional collaboration across medical, marketing, analytics, and field teams

Exploring and supporting in‑house initiatives leveraging cross-functional internal capabilities

Working with external stakeholders to advance innovative patient finding projects

Contributing to Biogen’s mission to help patients access treatment earlier

Rotation 3 – Affiliate Rotation

Your final rotation will be based within one of Biogen’s affiliates in the Europe, or Biogen International Region (BIR). This experience provides:

Firsthand exposure to local commercial operations and CE&O activities

Direct involvement in priority business projects in a relevant therapeutic area

Deeper understanding of market dynamics, customer insights, and competitive context

Opportunities to contribute to local performance drivers and strategic initiatives

This affiliate rotation is considered fundamental, enabling the graduate to connect global strategy with local execution.

Qualifications

We are looking for recent graduates holding a Master’s degree in a relevant discipline such as business management, finance, economics, marketing, or a scientific field. A demonstrated interdisciplinary background and relevant work experience are preferred.

We are seeking candidates with:

Strong academic achievements

Excellent analytical skills and an affinity for working with data

Strong MS Excel and PowerPoint skills and comfort with quantitative analysis

Extracurricular achievements demonstrating drive and capability

Eagerness to learn and willingness to challenge the status quo

An international mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity

A collaborative, proactive, and efficient team approach

Entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to bring new ideas

Professional fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

About This Role:
As a PV Scientist Quality Document Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that all documents authored by the Safety Surveillance and Aggregate reports (SSA) team, or by vendors overseen by SSA, adhere to the highest quality standards set by Biogen. You will be responsible for managing the quality of these documents, ensuring they are suitable for their intended audience. This position involves a critical eye for detail, where you will verify data accuracy, ensure stylistic consistency, and maintain compliance with Biogen's style guide. Your contributions will be key in maintaining the integrity and reliability of SSA documentation, supporting the overarching mission of Biogen to deliver safe and effective pharmaceutical solutions. By collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, you will uphold the quality of our pharmacovigilance efforts and drive improvements in our quality documentation processes.

This is a hybrid role requiring 50% weekly office attendance in Maidenhead.

What You’ll Do:

Perform source data verification to ensure consistency with source documents.

Conduct editorial, technical, and scientific reviews for grammatical and stylistic accuracy.

Identify document findings and collaborate with authors to address issues.

Review and oversee vendor work, providing necessary guidance.

Collaborate with the Senior PV Scientist Quality Document Manager on quality metrics and QC planning.

Maintain and update SSA QC checklists as needed.

Document issues with format, linking, and cross-referencing for quality oversight.

Present quality trends in team meetings and discuss standards.

Create and maintain SSA document templates.

Drive process improvement initiatives for quality documentation.

Perform administrative tasks and communicate results to stakeholders.

Who You Are:
You are an individual with a keen eye for detail and a passion for maintaining high-quality standards. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are adept at working with various stakeholders to achieve common goals. Your strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks independently make you an asset to any team. You are comfortable with medical terminology and can clearly present scientific and medical data, both verbally and in writing. Your English writing skills are exceptional. Your experience in pharmacovigilance and familiarity with drug development processes enhance your ability to contribute effectively to the team.

Required Skills:

Bachelor’s Degree in biologic or natural science, or healthcare discipline.

Previous experience in pharmacovigilance, medical writing, scientific editing and/or publishing.

Significant years of writing and editing experience, preferably in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

Comfortable with medical terminology.

Familiarity with pharmacovigilance and drug development, including knowledge of clinical trial safety regulations and post-marketing safety regulations.

Ability to interpret, analyze, and present scientific and medical data.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize independently.

In depthknowledge of common data processing software (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Word, Business Objects).

About this role

The Senior Principal Analyst, Statistical Programming leads and oversees statistical programming activities of internally and externally through vendors in the application of data standards, production of analysis datasets, analysis dataset specifications, tables, listings, figures, electronic submission components (define.xml and XPTs), and ad hoc analyses. He/She partners with Biostatistics to deliver high quality, submission ready statistical outputs.

This person is also responsible for providing input to the Statistical Programming Portfolio Lead (PL) on overall study timelines, monitoring and meeting agreed upon program(s) milestones, escalating issues as needed to their DM counterpart and estimating resources needs. He/She leads a drug program team of statistical programmers to accomplish tasks and communicate issues, as necessary, to senior management. This includes communication and quality oversight of the vendor. He/She is comfortable representing the Statistical Programming perspective to the study team or Clinical Development Team and is often the sole functional representative.

The Senior Principal Analyst, Statistical Programming helps to implement the Data and Programming Strategy, provides input to the Data Standards personnel and DM on the strategic direction of the program, partners with the PL to ensure appropriate statistical programming standards implementation and serves as reference for the study to Data Standards personnel. He/She develops and implements standard programming practices while also ensuring that they are employed across a study or program. He/She collaborates on tools and process improvement for Statistical Programming.

What you’ll do

Leads, coordinates and manages timely creation, oversight, review, completion, and delivery of statistical programming activities and deliverables of study projects via internal and/or external staff oversight.

Considered a statistical programming expert within the department. Authors CDISC ADaM (analysis data model) analysis data set specifications including the identification of potential data issues or areas of critical data examination. Works with statistics on defining and documenting programming endpoint algorithms across a study, drug program and/or contributing to TA level algorithms.

Manage the end-to-end programming of deliverables through from CRF collections through electronic submission including preparation of electronic submissions (ESUB) components (input to reviewer’s guides, annotated CRF, define and XPTs), works with SMEs to ensure compliance to eSUB standards.

Identifies process inefficiencies and lead efforts to remedy the inefficiencies and train the department on the new processes in conjunction with DVAD and PON.

Serves as the Statistical Programming Lead to achieve milestones for a drug program; evaluates task objectives, collaborates with PL and/or manager on issues or resource needs.

Verifies program consistency and usage of data, analysis and submission standards across the department in consultation with data standards, statistical submissions management and the data strategy plan.

Informs internal and external project team members of statistical programming requirements, deliverable status, and resource needs.

Who you are

You are a senior principal analyst with strong statistical programming skills to effectively lead and collaborate across functions. You pay close attention to detail and have the proven ability to manage some competing priorities. You believe in and live by Biogen’s culture essentials in pioneering, think broadly, drive results, ethical and inclusive.

Required Skills:

· Bachelor’s degree required, Masters or PhD in Statistics or Mathematics preferred.

· 10 years relevant work experience within an organization with a focus on data management and analysis.

· 10+ years SAS Base programming with 7+ years using SAS STAT, GRAPH and MACRO.

· 10+ years relevant industry experience.

· 10+ years clinical trial experience.

· 5+ years clinical database experience.

· CDISC and/or submissions experience.

· Extensive knowledge of drug development process and clinical trials.

· Extensive knowledge of drug submission requirements, relevant ICH and FDA/EMEA/ROW guidelines.

· Familiarity with UNIX as well as software development packages (R, Imaging and Genomics software packages).

· Familiarity AI and ML concepts.

Responsible for Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) operations in Biogen Japan, to ensure that all commercial products comply with relevant regulations namely Good Quality Practice, Good Manufacturing Practice and Biogen Quality Management System. Principal Accountabilities

1.Quality Compliance in Japan & GQP activities

Oversees quality related activities and operations to assure all products are compliant with Japanese regulations and Biogen procedures.

Systematically and consistently reviews quality activities to improve efficiencies and enhance compliance.

Maintains and improves Japanese Quality Management System in alignment Biogen procedures and global standards.

Oversees management of customer Complaints assuring alignment with Commercial and Marketing team.

Improves product quality through analysis of Complaints and Quality Information.

Participate to Sanyaku-kai and maintain required communication with authorities including Management of GMP submission for Biogen Product licensed in Japan and Foreign Manufacturer Accreditation (FMA)

Inspection Management for Biogen Japan licenses

Develops Quality Strategy to meet Global and Local objectives

2.Quality Assurance Supervisor (as required by PMD Act, Revised May 2025)

Acts as the designated representative of the MAH in matters related to Quality Assurance in accordance with Japanese regulatory requirements.

Holds independent and single-point accountability for ensuring the QA/QC teams operate in full compliance with PMD Act and other applicable Japanese regulations.

Is legally required to provide updates on quality compliance and GQP activities to the CPO and must submit formal written opinions when necessary.

May receive instructions or oversight directly from the Minister of MHLW, who holds authority to request changes to MAH operations concerning quality assurance.

Oversees the quality control system for drugs, ensuring all related documentation is properly maintained and submitted to MHLW in accordance with Japanese law.

This accountability is distinct and separate from senior leadership groupings such as Sanyaku-kai; the role's regulatory responsibilities exist independently of corporate hierarchy.

Ensures the alignment of internal quality systems with national regulatory requirements and serves as a key point of contact during audits, inspections, and interactions with Japanese health authorities (e.g., PMDA, MHLW, Tokyo Metropolitan Government)

3.Third Party Management (CMO/CLO) in Japan

Ensures CMO and CLO perform manufacturing and quality control as per Biogen standards

Assures strategic alliances with CMO and CLO to ensure the high-quality products are released on time.

Revise and/or update quality agreement with CMO, CLO and 3PL (Third Party Logistics) on time to comply with Japanese regulation and Biogen PRCD.

Assess CMO/CLO from QA/QC perspective to obtain the best quality and operations in the cost effectively manner when the change of the supplier is required.

4.Alliance between Japanese and Global functions

Ensure Biogen procedures are in place by constantly liaising with Global QA/QC.

Drives Global thinking while acting locally

Ensure the products are in line with Japanese quality requirement working closely with Quality and External Manufacturing Team.

Work closely with relevant functions in Japan to deploy QMS (Quality Management System) and provide key information as a QA/QC representative.

About This Role 
In the dynamic role of Sr. Materials Handler II, you will be an integral part of our manufacturing team, responsible for the efficient handling of raw materials, processing manufacturing orders, and overseeing weighing and dispensing activities. This position focuses on receiving and shipping final drug substances, ensuring a seamless flow of materials that directly supports our production objectives. Your efforts will maintain a safe, efficient, and productive environment at every stage, contributing significant value to our operational success. You'll manage the receipt of GMP items, verify inventory against specifications, and ensure the timely movement of materials using our electronic inventory system. As a trusted member of our team, you will play a crucial role in liaising with various departments, ensuring accuracy and consistency in our supply chain processes. 

What You’ll Do 

Receive all GMP items, verifying count, vendor item number, and expiration date against specifications. 

Process manufacturing and laboratory move orders in the Warehouse Management System (WMS). 

Perform quality control sample shipments according to applicable procedures. 

Safely operate powered industrial trucks. 

Conduct weigh and dispense activities using the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) according to procedures. 

Execute cycle counts as per applicable procedures. 

Complete all departmental and required GXP trainings to 100% compliance. 

Pull, pack, and ship finished products, samples, and other materials according to SOPs. 

Receive and process drug substances from manufacturing per procedures. 

Stay current on DOT and Hazmat regulations. 

Maintain cleanliness and orderly storage conditions in warehouse and dispensary areas. 

Undertake additional job duties as assigned. 

Who You Are 
You are a meticulous and organized individual who thrives in a structured environment. Your strong attention to detail ensures accuracy in every task you undertake. You are proactive in your approach to problem-solving and possess excellent communication skills, allowing you to effectively collaborate with peers and other departments. Your commitment to safety and quality standards is unwavering, and you are always ready to learn and adapt to new processes and procedures. Your team-oriented mindset drives you to take ownership of your work and contribute positively to achieving shared goals. 

 

Physical Mobility Demands 

The incumbent could stand for four (4) hours, walk for three (3) hours, sit for three (3) hours, kneel or bend for one (1) hour, is required to perform upper body twisting motions for one half (½) hour and climb steps for one half (½) hour during the normal course of performing the essential duties of the position. 

The incumbent will also be required to lift and move up to 35 pounds and occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds with assistance for up to 100 feet, occasionally push/pull more than 100 pounds 

The incumbent is required to have sufficient physical dexterity to operate a telephone, computer/electronic equipment, hand tools, forklifts, order selectors. The incumbent manipulates small objects and performs activities or operates equipment that requires flexion, extension, or movement of the wrist; grasping; manipulation using hands and/or fingers; etc. 

The incumbent is required to wear personal protective equipment, such as, safety shoes, safety glasses and/or hearing protection 

Required Skills 

High School diploma or equivalent. 

1-3 years of experience in cGMP Materials Management and warehouse operations. 

Proficient in using electronic inventory and Warehouse Management Systems. 

Knowledge of manufacturing execution systems (MES). 

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

Familiarity with DOT and Hazmat regulations. 

Preferred Skills 

Experience with Syncade or similar MES platforms. 

Prior experience with powered industrial trucks. 

Familiarity with good documentation practices and cGMP requirements.

About This Role 

Biogen studies highly complex, devastating, and burdensome diseases and there are still significant challenges in how we understand and treat them.

In the Quantitative Sciences Development Organization we aspire to transform patients’ lives by accelerating disease research using best in breed and emerging techniques. Leveraging applied machine learning and emerging technologies, we drive solutions to advance research, clinical care, and patient empowerment.

We stand with our colleagues across Biogen developing pioneering treatments. We believe that now, more than ever, biology and technology should go hand-in-hand to better meet patient needs, while enabling a shift towards more prevention-focused, affordable, and equitable care.

What You’ll Do 

As a Machine Learning Engineer, Operations and Health Systems Research, you will:

Design, develop, and implement complex end-to-end data pipelines, engineer features and disease models to understand the intersection of health systems utilization and clinical research

Explore and implement the use of Generative AI models and systems to digest domain specific documents and semi-structured narrative data, harmonize across semantic models and concepts, accelerate analysis, and improve resilience of processes and procedures

Integrate real world data sources in order to build epidemiological and disease forecasting models used to support decision-making for clinical trial operations

Generate evidence and communicate results, including at conferences and in peer-reviewed publications for audiences in the therapeutic area of interest, sensor science, machine learning and operations research.

Support integration, design and development of novel measures, models, and metrics to assess model validity and performance in both training and inference stages

Who You Are 

You are passionate about exploring and establishing new methods for looking at data across devices, applications, data streams, and diseases. You love figuring out how to create mathematical and statistical models that relate human biology, clinical development, and sensor technology to business outcomes and patient needs.

Required Skills 

>= 5 years Pharma/Biotech/Tech/Healthcare industry experience, alternatively extensive experience in academic/clinical centers of excellence

Expertise in leveraging electronic health records and other data sources derived from clinical care via state of the art methodologies, programming languages, and tools

Experience working on machine learning and data science problems using formal software development lifecycle approaches and best practices as part of a software delivery organization

Profound experience in data science, machine learning, and data engineering programming using python/R and higher-level libraries such as numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, matplotlib, Plotly, tidyverse ggplot, mlr, tidymodels or similar

Strong familiarity with large-language models and other encoder-encoder/encoder-decoder architectures, both as served and hosted endpoints and incorporated and fine-tuned for business processes

Preferred Skills

Experienced in communicating and building consensus on difficult or sensitive information with technology and business teams

Experience iterating through UI/UX patterns, data visualization, and front-end interactions and balancing across conflicting stakeholder preferences

Formal application of principles of empirical science including statistical modeling, design of experiments, and hypothesis formulation and testing

Advanced degree in public health, epidemiology, public health economics, operations research or a similar discipline

Medical Science Liaison/Neurology Field Medical

Job Overview

The MSL role is field based customer facing role, activities should be Key medical expert (KME) focused with the intent to maximize medical one on one interactions with HCPs. Over70% field-related activities (face to face and virtual) is expected in the role

Acts as a scientific expert knowledgeable of Biogen products, disease state and competitors

Establishes long term scientific/strategic relationships with leading specialists (physicians nurses, allied health), and with related medical societies and academic centers of excellence

Ensures KMEs and organizations have access to relevant scientific information

Facilitates KME involvement in educational forums and advisory boards to optimize scientific knowledge exchange

Serves as an important partner to internal stakeholders through communication of relevant information

Principal Accountabilities

1.Key Medical Experts (KMEs) Engagement

Identify KMEs in specified therapeutic area and work in collaboration with respective commercial counterparts in engaging KMEs from a medical perspective

Develop, maintain and implement KME engagement plans to build and maintain strong scientific relationships such that Biogen is recognized as an industry partner of choice

Plan KME visits and utilize the CRM database to record HCP interactions

Provide current, accurate and balanced scientific education to HCPs and facilitate data discussions in relevant therapeutic areas

Provide scientific presentations to individual physicians or groups of physicians, e.g. scientific seminars, round table, journal clubs

Source and brief international and local speakers for national and state meetings according to internal process

Act as a liaison between investigators and Biogen, reactively gather clinician driven ideas for data generation activities (IITs, SRAs)

2. Internal collaboration

Work with relevant commercial counterparts to address specific regional needs from a medical perspective in alignment with both medical and commercial brand plans

Record all healthcare professional (HCP) interactions and track MSL activity in the CRM database

Participate in respective integrated brand team meetings to provide in-field medical updates, trends, insights and competitor intelligence

Contribute to in-field medical training of SSSs and be available as a medical resource for the Sales team

 Support Medical Manager in the coordination of advisory board meetings/steering committees, including speaker briefings

Collaborate with relevant medical and commercial team/s to develop strategy and execute tactics on communication of complex scientific information to relevant healthcare professionals

Support Medical Managers with respect to clinical trial execution e. g. site identification, Site Initiation visits

Regularly (at least monthly) liaise with other medical and commercial team/s to ensure consistency and alignment in strategy/tactics

3.Scientific Data Knowledge and communication

Collaborate with Medical Managers to generate high quality approved medical and scientific presentations aligned to medical strategy

Keep abreast of relevant medical literature. Review Biogen literature alerts and work with Product Managers and SFE responsible for education of SSSs on relevant literature alerts

Discuss, analyze and educate on appropriate medical and scientific publications and clinical study findings in collaboration with Medical Manager

As per requested attend national and international conferences and provide a medical summary of these conferences to internal stakeholders

Provide scientific presentations to individual physicians or groups of physicians, e.g. scientific seminars, round table, journal clubs

4.Compliance

Ensure speaker briefings, contracts and slide review processes adhere to SOP

Maintain compliance within the Japan and Biogen frameworks and codes of conduct

Maintain 100% training compliance on all allocated courses and internal SOPs

Collaborate in a compliant manner with Biogen stakeholders

Have a strong understanding of industry rules, legal guidance and a desire to follow a compliance and ethical pathway

Have the clarity and depth of understanding around compliance guardrails which allows for compliance empowered interactions. Be able to make the right judgement calls at the moment.

Minimum Education Requirements

Life science background

Sufficient command of English to perform the job

Minimum Experience Requirements

3 years of working experience in the pharmaceutical industry preferred

Medical affairs experience preferred; MSL experience best

SMA experience desired

Therapeutic area: specialty care preferred; neuroscience best

Knowledge & Skills Requirements 

Strong functional & technical skills

Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex data to different audiences

Strong Team player and collaborator 

Customer focused both internal and external

Strong Interpersonal skills
