About This Role 

This is an outstanding opportunity to join a dynamic neurology team as the Head of Neuromuscular Research. Reporting to the Head of Neurology Research, you will be responsible for defining and leading the research strategy across established and emerging neuromuscular disease areas. This includes supporting our established franchises in spinal muscular atrophy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

A key objective will be to maintain strong momentum in existing research programs, while strategically integrating external innovation to enrich and sustain a high-value discovery pipeline. In this pivotal leadership role, you will collaborate across Biogen’s global organization and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with enterprise priorities and deliver impactful outcomes. You will also take leadership of a highly talented and engaged team of scientists, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

 

What You’ll Do 

Inspire, develop, and lead a team of talented and committed scientists. Foster a high-performing, collaborative culture that values creativity, scientific rigor, and operational excellence.

Define and execute a strong, forward-thinking, and cross-functionally aligned neuromuscular research strategy, ensuring alignment with Biogen’s broader neurology research vision and organizational goals.

Deliver a high value neuromuscular research programs into clinical studies, prioritizing resources to address unmet medical needs and accelerate the advancement of differentiated therapies.

Drive integration of promising innovation into a sustainable neuromuscular discovery pipeline through research efforts and external partnerships, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and scientific advances.

Act as a strategic stakeholder, collaborating with cross-functional leaders, for the neuromuscular franchise.

Contribute to the leadership of a world class neurology team and pipeline, contributing to overall organizational strategy and decision-making.

Represent Biogen as a thought leader in neuromuscular research, engaging with external collaborators, and academic institutions, and industry partners to advance innovation and establish Biogen as a thought global leader in neuromuscular disease research.

Who You Are 

You are a dynamic, visionary, and agile leader with a proven track record of driving innovation and delivering transformative solutions in neuromuscular research. You are an inspiring communicator who thrives at the intersection of science and strategy, and you excel at building relationships, aligning teams, and making data-driven decisions. You are committed to the pursuit of innovative science to deliver breakthrough medicines, whilst fostering a culture of excellence and resilience within your team.

 

Required Skills:

Strong scientific expertise and background. PhD in neuroscience or neuromuscular biology, or related life sciences field with 15+ years of experience.

Proven track record of leading scientific teams (minimum of 5+ years), with demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain top tier talent.

Deep experience in biopharma environment/industry (minimum of 10+ years). 

Open and direct communication style/demonstrable speaker experience and thought leader at both internal and external forums.

Experience establishing and managing external collaborations and partnerships, including licensing and innovation initiatives.

About This Role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of U.S. Market Access Value Strategy to lead and execute market access strategy, marketing, and operational initiatives for a new medication for the treatment of Post-Partum Depression (PPD). This role is instrumental in ensuring optimal patient access, reimbursement, and continuity of care from prescription to dose. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of U.S. market access dynamics and has hands-on experience navigating the complexities of specialty distribution and patient access programs.

This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of bringing innovative therapies to patients while shaping access strategies from the ground up. You will join a purpose-driven team that values innovation, collaboration, and patient-centric thinking

.

What You’ll Do:
Strategic Leadership

Develop and execute comprehensive market access strategies to support the neuropsychology brands across commercial and government payer segments.

Lead cross-functional planning and execution across payer, provider, and patient access channels to optimize the brand’s uptake and adherence.

Define and drive the contracting strategy in collaboration with pricing, legal, and finance to align with market dynamics and brand goals.

Market Access Marketing

Lead the development and oversight of market access marketing tools and payer value propositions tailored to key customer segments (e.g., payers, PBMs, and specialty pharmacies).

Partner with brand marketing to ensure access-related messaging is integrated across HCP and patient campaigns.

Oversee the creation of payer education materials, value decks, and reimbursement support tools.

Monitor evolving reimbursement and policy landscapes and integrate insights into access strategies.

Operational Excellence

Work closely with Trade & Distribution to ensure distribution models support optimal patient access and minimize disruptions.

Collaborate with the Patient Access and Distribution teams to streamline the Rx to Dose journey, identifying and removing friction points in the access process.

Partner with all field teams to monitor performance, resolve escalations, and enhance real-time support models.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the primary market access lead in cross-functional brand teams, ensuring access considerations are integrated into launch and lifecycle plans.

Collaborate closely with Insights & Analytics to track access KPIs, understand patient journeys, and inform strategic decisions.

Support the development and execution of training for internal stakeholders and field teams regarding access strategy, tools, and messaging.

Who You Are 
The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in payer marketing, pricing, trade & distribution, and pharmacy benefit models, with a proven ability to drive results through collaboration and broad commercial strategic thinking. This role requires a hands-on leader who can operate both strategically and tactically to deliver impact across the full market access spectrum.

Skills You Will Need

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MPH, PharmD) strongly preferred.

Minimum of 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical market access, pricing, reimbursement, or related commercial functions.

Proven experience leading access strategy for specialty products brands, preferably with complex fulfillment models.

Deep understanding of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, including payers, PBMs, and specialty distribution.

Strong leadership, collaboration, and communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence across all levels of the organization.

Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging insights to shape strategy and improve outcomes.

Preferred Attributes

Experience launching or managing products with complex Rx to dose pathways.

Strategic thinker who can operate both at the tactical and enterprise level.

High level of comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Experience with controlled substances

About this role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented apprentice to join our Biogen Quality Control team in Solothurn. In this role, you will learn to perform analytical tests, support product quality assessments, and ensure compliance with industry standards. You’ll gain hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, chemical analysis techniques, and data recording while working alongside experienced chemists. This apprenticeship offers a fantastic opportunity to develop technical skills, understand quality control processes, and build a strong foundation for a career in the chemical and pharmaceutical industry.

What you will do and learn

Sample management: ordering consumables, prepare and handle laboratory samples

Plan, execute and document laboratory experiments

Sampling and testing of raw materials according to GMP specifications

Chemistry: drug product testing with basic chemistry methods and chromatography

Environmental monitoring: Testing samples for total organic content and conductivity

Lab support: preparation/review of chemical products and solutions, lab support, safety

Who you are

You are curious about how things work, enjoys science experiments, and loves solving problems. You have a strong interest in chemistry and paying close attention to details. You are a hands-on learner, excited by practical activities in labs. Safety-conscious and eager to follow procedures, you thrive in structured environments. Motivated and inquisitive, you aim to explore the real-world applications of science.

What we offer

Training dispensed by certified SBFI trainers

You will work with state-of-the-art laboratory equipment

Opportunity to collaborate with multiple teams in the QC organization (sample management, raw materials, biochemistry, environmental monitoring)

Attractive compensation and 30 days holidays (6 weeks vacations, 2nd class SBB travel pass, free accommodations during school training with aprentas Basel, work computer, accident insurance)

Required skills

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Capacity to interpret experimental data, identify anomalies, and troubleshoot issues. Critical thinking to analyze results and propose improvements to procedures.

About this role

BlackRock’s business is investing on behalf of our clients, from large institutions to parents and grandparents, doctors and teachers who entrust their savings to us. We are committed to our client - period. Our promise is to offer them the clearest thinking about what to do with their money and the products and services they need to secure a better financial future. 

That is why investors of all kinds have made us the world’s largest asset manager, entrusting us with trillions of dollars, and this is why companies, institutions and global governments come to us for help with meeting their biggest financial challenges. 

About Aladdin & Aladdin Accounting 

BlackRock runs on Aladdin, a unified investment management platform integrating risk analytics, portfolio management, trading, operations, and accounting for informed decisions. 

 
Aladdin Accounting extends this capability, delivering a single front-to-back platform with comprehensive investment accounting, Performance book of records (Shadow accounting) and multi-basis accounting for thousands of global users. 
We are advancing our accounting operating platform and expanding asset class coverage, requiring strong implementation expertise and deep accounting knowledge to support continued growth.

The BlackRock Global Markets – APAC ETF Markets team is responsible for growing and protecting the trading of the iShares product suite. We are passionate about leading all aspects of primary and secondary market ETF trading! We seek to identify and mitigate trading frictions that could impact the market quality of our products. In addition, we work alongside ETF market participants, such as liquidity providers, exchanges and regulators to strengthen and advance the ETF trading ecosystem.

Your Role and Impact

As a member of the ETF Capital Markets team in APAC, you will be responsible for overseeing a wide array of functions that encompass both the primary and secondary market activities, as well as spearheading the transformation of the ETF ecosystem and driving industry standards across the region.

Primary Market Oversight and Risk Management

You will manage the daily order taking and implement robust risk management practices for ETF Primary Markets throughout APAC. Acting as a crucial link, you will facilitate communication and coordination between external trading firms, market infrastructure entities, and the portfolio management team. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders are essential to perform this role successfully.

Technical Analysis and Market Quality Improvement

Your responsibilities will include analyzing and comprehending the technical nuances of ETF trading, covering all asset classes. The ultimate objective is to enhance the overall quality of the ETF market while maintaining stringent investor protection, ensuring the interests of our clients are always safeguarded.

Coordination and Collaboration with Partners

You will work closely with external partners, such as ETF liquidity providers and exchanges, to proactively identify and mitigate any trading risks that clients may encounter. Collaboration will also extend to internal teams across BlackRock when launching new products, managing stressed market events, and conducting due diligence to assess the trading efficiency of our existing ETF offerings.

Advancing Key Initiatives and Enhancing the ETF Ecosystem

In this capacity, you will collaborate with internal partner teams and engage with external ETF liquidity providers to drive forward key initiatives. Your efforts will focus on identifying and resolving trading frictions, seeking opportunities to increase participation, and reinforcing the robustness and efficiency of the ETF ecosystem in APAC.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the primary contact for broker dealers, market makers, stock exchanges, service providers and teams internally for all aspects of primary trading of iShares ETFs.

Perform and oversight primary market activities (creations/redemptions) between APs, Portfolio Management, Trading, Exchange & ETF Service Providers

Be an ETF trading subject matter expert and demonstrate in-depth product knowledge to promote efficient ETF trading and differentiate BlackRock ETFs from competitor funds and other investment vehicles.

Monitor BlackRock ETF trading daily, identify and raise client and business risks and coordinate with the business, external market makers and equity exchanges on resolution.

Be a risk manager, ensuring our ETFs and their shareholders are protected

Conduct quantitative data analysis to facilitate business decision making and build data sets from multiple sources to produce insights for management, sales teams, and clients.

Collaborate with external market makers and exchanges and collectively drive strategies which can improve ETF trading efficiency.

Partner with internal stakeholders including product development teams and portfolio managers to implement product design and trading process improvements.

Monitor articles, white papers, and blogs that highlight potential issues with ETFs and help to coordinate a thoughtful response, ensuring consistency with our global message

Manage a broad range of market events and disruptions, requiring the ability to operate and show sound judgement whilst under pressure and a strong understanding of risks across the business to effectively drive solutions.

You Have

3-5 years industry experience with an understanding of trading and market infrastructure

Risk management mentality, able to identify downstream implications and proactively call out vulnerabilities

Have a high level of motivation, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to function well under time pressure

High degree of professional discretion, accountability, and judgment. Critical that person is adaptable, flexible and thrives in a team environment

Confirmed relationship-building abilities, particularly influencing, and listening to people across different functions and seniorities

Strong oral and written communication skills—the ability to clearly and accurately communicate information to a wide group of internal and external stakeholders is critical to this function

Prior ETF industry and experience in Digital Assets, Tokenization, and Derivatives products are desirable

Coding experience and familiarity with leveraging AI preferred

Business Overview

The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks. About this role

BlackRock Fundamental Equities:

Fundamental Equities investment professionals manage portfolios from offices in New York, Princeton, Boston, London, Edinburgh, Hong Kong, Melbourne, Tokyo, Taipei, Singapore, Sydney, and Shanghai. The firm is looking to expand investment research capabilities in Mumbai.

Our portfolio managers employ multiple investment philosophies to manage their portfolios across a number of different styles, geographies, and capitalization ranges. We believe that the best performance is delivered by tightly knit, focused, and accountable teams, and that the best investment decisions result from integrating research with portfolio management. We believe that there are inefficiencies in stock markets which can be identified and exploited by proprietary fundamental research, and that quantitative analytics enable risk-efficient portfolio construction.

Job Overview: 

BlackRock’s Fundamental Equities Emerging Market and Asia team is seeking a Research Analyst with primary responsibility of conducting independent North Asia consumer staples and discretionary (including discretionary IT) research. The job holder will be based in Hong Kong and will attend company meetings, trade shows, and conferences as required.

The position is a compelling opportunity for a research analyst with demonstrable skills for fundamental research, financial analysis and knowledge of corporate business models. The analyst we seek will have an appreciation of investing with a strong focus on fundamentally driven returns. Working closely with other members of the team and the wider firm, this individual will conduct detailed fundamental research, make recommendations for inclusion of stocks into multiple strategies, as well as closely monitoring those companies while they are held in the funds.

The successful candidate will also be able to leverage a well-respected and successful global asset management network within BlackRock and access world-class technology systems, support, and risk management capabilities.

Responsibilities:

Identify potential investment in North Asia, collaborate with portfolio managers to evaluate investment theses, provide effective challenge where appropriate, ensuring they are backed by thorough research and data

Carry out independent industry research, including monitoring macroeconomic trends, technological innovations, regulatory changes, and geopolitical factors that could impact the portfolio

Attend industry conferences, earnings calls, and investor meetings to gather qualitative insights and assess company strategies, adjusting investment recommendations as necessary

Prepare detailed research reports and presentations to summarize key findings, updates and strategy’s performance, incl. semi-annual review with clients, sustainability thesis, etc.

Stay current with market news, interpret news impact on stocks, and understand industry dynamics

Contribute to the team’s discussions of individual ideas, setting conviction within the wider research group and hence impacting portfolio strategies.

The Director of Digital Asset Operations and Platform Enablement will own and evolve the U.S. post‑trade operating model for digital assets. This role is accountable for designing scalable, resilient, and compliant end‑to‑end processes that support institutional‑grade crypto and tokenized product offerings. The Director will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and external market infrastructure to translate operating requirements into robust platform capabilities, while ensuring strong controls, audit readiness, and operational excellence as the digital asset ecosystem continues to mature.

Job Description

Own the U.S. post‑trade operating model for digital assets, setting the vision and ensuring end‑to‑end processes are designed for scale, regulatory compliance, resiliency, and ongoing market and infrastructure evolution.

Champion process optimization and technology adoption across digital asset operations, driving efficiency, STP, and control enhancement while positioning Tech & Ops as a leader in institutional‑grade digital asset servicing.

Support continued commercial product rollouts for crypto, including introducing new product features, enhancing security and compliance capabilities, and driving the launch of innovative funds to meet evolving market demand.

Partner with Aladdin Product and Engineering to translate digital asset operating requirements into scalable platform capabilities, ensuring Aladdin remains the system of record for positions, cash, collateral, risk, and operational transparency.

Stand up asset‑servicing for digital assets and tokenized securities, including corporate actions and payments for tokenized ETFs; oversee onboarding/documentation with market infrastructure and ensure operational readiness across Tech & Ops.

Build collateral & settlement workflows for tokenized assets, partnering with post‑trade infrastructure to integrate pledge/ownership‑change instructions and real‑time statuses back into Aladdin.

Own the control environment and audit readiness for digital asset operations, partnering with internal and external auditors to maintain design/operating effectiveness and timely evidence support.

Lead digital operational readiness and partner management, overseeing custodians, exchanges, and market infrastructure partners to mitigate risk, enhance resiliency, and enable scalable product growth through strategic partnerships.

Align roadmap, data, and KPIs with Tech & Ops strategy; instrument dashboards for settlement timeliness, reconciliation health, wallet balances/utilization, and risk/compliance metrics; feed insights into the enterprise Tech & Ops roadmap.

Lead custody & wallet operational governance, allocation and sweeping policies; ensure continuous compliance with exchange/venue obligations and orchestrate time‑bound digital wallet transfers with crypto custodians per agreed SLAs.

Experience

Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment through organization and adaptability.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with demonstrated success in high-performance or high-demand environments.

Initiative and a willingness to contribute beyond the scope of the role to achieve team and firm objectives.

About this role

Business Overview 

PMGTech is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group (PMG), integrating investment research with advanced engineering, AI, and alternative data to make technology a direct driver of alpha. It operates as one global team across three verticals – Platform Strategy, Research Solutions (DS&S), and Platform Change (IPT) – partnering closely with the BlackRock Aladdin ecosystem and PMG investment leadership. This integrated model delivers a coherent tech strategy, strengthens the research community, and scales capabilities across regions, asset classes (Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-asset), and investment styles (discretionary and systematic). 

PMGTech leads PMG’s AI strategy by building an AI-ready research environment, unified data layer, agentic orchestration networks, and an investment-focused application layer to deploy AI-powered research solutions into production. As part of PMGTech, you will work directly with investment researchers and portfolio managers to build and scale capabilities in data engineering, GenAI, and platform tooling that streamlines research workflows and enables differentiated alpha-generative investment insights across PMG’s investment pillars. 

 

Job Purpose / Background 

The Research Engineer supports investors and research teams by building data workflows, research tools, analytics pipelines, and AI-assisted capabilities that help transform investor hypotheses into actionable insights. Embedded within DS&S research pods - asset-class focused sub-teams - this role requires collaboration with investors/researchers, AI Leads, and core engineering team to deliver high-quality data assets, exploratory analyses and research-enabling components. 

This role requires that the engineer understand the business context and hypothesis of investors and translate the requirement into functional data solutions. This requires expertise in building and operating data intensive research solutions using Python and SQL, workflow orchestration, Cloud Big Data technologies such as BigQuery/Snowflake/GCS, visualization tools such as Tableau/Power BI and experience in data quality, CI/CD pipelines, and data operations. 

Key Responsibilities 

Build and maintain web harvesting and data pipelines, transformations, and workflows to support research hypotheses and data analyses. 

Develop new capabilities to source high-quality data and create scalable and maintainable data solutions. 

Develop research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, or exploratory tools as needed by the pod for insight generation or research workflows. 

Engage with investors and researchers to understand research workflows and translate requirements into data solutions. 

Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data extraction and management tools and technologies to accelerate investor research. 

Collaborate with AI leads to source data and build AI applications to supplement investor research with AI-assisted solutions. 

Skills & Experience 

Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. 

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills 

Knowledge/curiosity about investment research workflows or similar domains. 

Prior experience in data engineering or data analytics, or data intensive applications. 

Proven ability to work collaboratively across engineering and business teams. 

Qualifications 

3+ years hands-on experience in Data Engineering/Analytics 

B.S. / M.S. college degree in Computer Science, Data Science/Engineering, or related subject area. 

 

Nice to Have 

Prior experience web harvesting tools and techniques (Scrapy) 

Experience with cloud data tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, GCP). 

Exposure to AI/ML tooling, LLM experimentation, or AI applications such as RAG, Summarization and Q&A (Open AI, Vertex, Anthropic). 

Experience creating dashboards, notebooks, or lightweight research tools (Streamlit, Flask, Tableau, Power BI). 

Familiarity with workflow orchestration or automation tools (Kubernetes/Airflow).

Strong knowledge of investment accounting principles and practices

Well-organized with the ability to manage priorities effectively

Client-focused with a passion for providing high-quality service

Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly to clients, fostering commitment, team motivation, and acceptance of new ideas or actions

Business Overview 

Understanding and managing risk is the cornerstone of BlackRock’s approach to responsible investing. The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks. Our mission is to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenges to drive better business and investment outcomes. RQA promotes BlackRock as a leader in risk management by providing independent top-down and bottom-up oversight to help identify investment, counterparty, operational, regulatory, technology, and third-party risks. 

 

RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase both individual enablement and a strong collaborative environment. As a global group located all around the world, our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages teamwork, innovation, diversity, and the development of our future leaders. We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strengths connect with our purpose. 

 

Role Description: 

 

Core Risk Governance responsible for delivering firm‑wide risk oversight, governance, and control effectiveness across investment strategies and asset classes. The team plays a central role in ensuring the integrity of risk frameworks, portfolio setup controls, and governance processes by leveraging data, advanced analytics, automation, and AI‑enabled solutions at scale. 

 

The function focuses on centralising risk governance activities, strengthening preventive controls, and embedding technology‑driven oversight across the investment lifecycle. By building standardized data frameworks, deploying AI‑ and analytics‑based controls, and delivering transparent, timely reporting, Core Risk Governance enables consistent decision‑making and robust escalation across the platform. 

 

The team partners closely with Investment Risk, Technology, Data, Compliance, and Control functions to modernise risk governance—moving from manual, fragmented processes to systematic, scalable, and explainable AI‑enabled solutions that enhance risk visibility, control effectiveness, and operational resilience across Core RM. 

 

Key Job Responsibilities: 

 

Architect, build, and scale AI driven solutions—from ideation and proof of concept to production deployment—to transform risk and data processes through advanced automation, intelligent exception management, and predictive insights. 

Write production grade code in Python to build data pipelines, automation frameworks, analytics libraries, and AI/ML components; ensure solutions are maintainable, tested, and deployable. 

Design, build, and maintain resilient data pipelines (batch and streaming) with strong engineering controls, including SLAs, dependency management, backfills, replay/re ingest capabilities, and automated alerting.. 

Define and enforce data persistence, schema standardization, lineage, and metadata management, ensuring traceability, auditability, and long term reliability of analytical outputs. 

Implement data quality and control frameworks, including automated validation checks, reconciliation to source, threshold based monitoring, and structured exception queues with clear escalation path. 

Develop scalable analytics and reporting solutions, translating complex datasets into clear, explainable, and decision ready outputs for senior stakeholders. 

Partner closely with cross functional teams (technology, data, risk, compliance) to embed governance, controls, and resilience directly into technical and AI enabled solutions 

Continuously drive automation, process efficiency, and platform resilience, reducing manual intervention while improving accuracy, timeliness, and scalability. 

 

Experience, Skills and Qualification: 

 

Bachelor’s/Masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. 

3–6 years of hands‑on experience in Python‑based analytics and AI/ML, including building data pipelines, developing models/LLM/agent workflows, and integrating outputs into business processes. 

Strong data engineering and data governance foundations, including data quality controls, lineage, metadata management, and control frameworks.. 

Proficiency in advanced analytics, with experience with tech platforms 

Ability to design and implement reporting solutions for portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and regulatory compliance. 

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to collaborate across investment, technology, and compliance teams. 

Experience in automation and process optimization for reporting and analytics workflows.

Model Validation team in Model Risk Management 

The Model Validation team is an integral part of the global Model Risk Management Team. The Global Model Risk Management function within the Enterprise Risk team is responsible for developing the firm-wide Model Risk Management framework and the implementation of the framework across BlackRock.

Key responsibility of the Model Validation team is performing independent reviews of models, primarily focusing on the models produced and owned by the Aladdin Financial Engineering (AFE) group. Responsibilities:

Evaluate conceptual soundness of models by assessing the model theory (incl. model assumptions, limitations), model construction and model testing in relation to the known model use cases.

Review adequacy of testing performed by model owners and design and execute efficient independent model testing both standardized and tailored to specifics of the model’s type, implementation and usage.

Document validation approach, observations, findings and conclusions in comprehensive validation reports.

Communicate results of model validation tests and observations within the team and to relevant stakeholders, where appropriate.

Advanced Degree (BS, MS) in a quantitative discipline, with strong Mathematics, Statistics and Analytical skills.

4-7 years of experience in quantitative model development or validation in the areas is an advantage, in particular, practical knowledge in one of following types of models: derivatives analytics; structured products analytics; portfolio risk factor models; private/alt asset class modelling; liquidity modelling. 

Strong technical background and practical application of one (or more) of programming languages is required (for example: Python; R; C++; Java; SQL; Hadoop; Linux applications; Advanced Excel modelling / VBA etc.). Experience in using AI for analytical work is an advantage.

Broad market and finance knowledge in certain asset class areas is an advantage (for example: Equity; FI; Beta; Derivatives; A(M)BS; Credit; Private; LDI; other).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including ability to explain sophisticated technical concepts in clear way is required.

Detail oriented paying attention to details. 

Enthusiasm and energy combined with a clear sense of how to “make it happen” through teamwork, engagement and commitment.

Fluent in spoken and written English.

About this role

We’re looking for an SRE with strong Kafka experience and a deep understanding of SRE best practices. You’ll combine hands‑on technical improvements with the ability to delegate work effectively to EventBus developers.

You’ll collaborate closely with the EventBus, Kafka, Telemetry, and Incident Response teams, while also working independently to improve monitoring, reduce noise, strengthen alerting, and track remediation progress.

This role sits at the centre of a global platform used by hundreds of developers and joins a fast‑growing, experienced SRE group based in Edinburgh.

About the Team

The Aladdin EventBus is built on Kafka and enables teams to publish and subscribe to distributed events in near real time. As part of the Aladdin Graph group—a core Platform Engineering function—the EventBus team supports developers across the firm in designing, building, and operating event‑driven and API‑based systems.

EventBus is now a critical dependency for key applications, including our release system and API infrastructure. This drives a high bar for availability, incident responsiveness, and operational excellence. The SRE function supports this by improving observability, streamlining incident processes, and identifying gaps that meaningfully improve platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

As the SRE for EventBus, you will drive stability, resiliency, and observability through:

Staying informed on all EventBus incidents, including impact, root cause, detection, and ongoing remediation

Responding to incidents calmly and efficiently, communicating clearly with reporters and partner teams, and recommending remediations based on urgency and impact

Proposing improvements informed by prior incidents, potential risks, and industry standards—e.g., new metrics, SLOs, fallback mechanisms

Leading incident retrospectives and sharing insights with the wider team

Creating and distributing postmortems for high‑impact operational events

Collaborating with developers to write, maintain, and promote runbooks and playbooks

Improving alert quality and reducing alert fatigue by tuning signal‑to‑noise ratios

Designing and implementing automated recovery solutions for known issues

Building a roadmap toward 24/7 availability, rapid failover recovery, self‑detection, and automated resolution of common issues

Helping EventBus users diagnose issues with their own producers and consumers

Requirements

3+ years in an SRE role, including experience with defining and managing SLOs

Strong understanding of SRE principles (Golden Signals, error budgets, synthetic monitoring, signal‑to‑noise optimisation)

Extensive hands‑on experience with Kafka

Experience using monitoring tools (Grafana and Splunk preferred), including building dashboards, alerts, and reports

Suggested Requirements

Java Developer Experience: Experience with Java or another object‑oriented language

CI/CD & Release Management: Experience managing pipelines using Azure DevOps or other Git‑based tools

Cloud Experience: Practical experience with at least one public cloud provider, preferably Azure or AWS

Agile Development: Familiarity with agile ways of working, sprint ceremonies, and backlog planning

Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python or Golang for automating operational tasks

Monitoring & Observability: Strong understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability practices, including writing integration scripts

Collaboration & Communication: Strong cross‑team collaboration skills and excellent written and verbal communication

About this role

When BlackRock started in 1988, its founders envisioned a company that combined the best of financial services with innovative technology. They imagined a business that would provide financial services to clients as well as technology services to other financial firms. The result of their vision is Aladdin, our industry leading, end-to-end investment management platform. With assets valued over USD $10 trillion managed on Aladdin by BlackRock alone, and over 150 other investment managers and asset owners using Aladdin, our technology empowers millions of investors to save for retirement, pay for college, buy a home and improve their financial wellbeing.

About Aladdin Data (AD)

Data is at the heart of Aladdin and increasingly the ability to acquire, store, analyze and gain insight from data has become a key component of what differentiates us. The Aladdin Data (AD) team is responsible for the data ecosystem within BlackRock. Our goal is to build and maintain a groundbreaking Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) that provides highly available, consistent data of the highest quality for all users of the platform, notably investors, operations teams and data analysts internally and at investment management firms around the world.

EDP supports four outcomes that, together, enable BlackRock’s data strategy:

1. Provide high quality, reliable data and services to power the core investment processes for Aladdin clients

2. Enable Aladdin clients to reduce operational overhead and improve client service by offering both Aladdin data and BlackRock-generated premium content through a commercial data platform, Aladdin Data Cloud (ADC)

3. Acquire, process, and deliver well-governed data for internal AI agents and the teams building and using AI

4. Provide a general-purpose Data Platform as a Service (DPaaS) to enable teams across BlackRock to focus on extracting value form their data

Members of the AD team get to experience working at one of the most recognized financial companies in the world, building a powerful data platform to automate data acquisition, ingestion, transformation, and distribution. Our product managers and engineers design and build data systems to solve some of the most complex technical and business data management problems in the industry, and they partner with data and analytics experts to deliver high quality analytical and derived data to our internal and external customers.

About this role

BlackRock’s Post Trade & Accounting group is seeking a Vice President-level engineering leader to advance our enterprise Client Reporting platform. You will lead development of core platform capabilities across distributed services and data systems, shaping long-term architecture for a mission-critical platform where scale, accuracy, resiliency, and auditability are essential. You will also partner across product and operations to drive modernization, automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
 

About the Team

The Client Reporting team delivers and manages BlackRock’s enterprise Client Reporting platform, providing end-to-end reporting solutions for a diverse global base of accounting and institutional clients. Architect high-throughput data systems integrating SQL/NoSQL, streaming, and caching technologies

Drive performance, resiliency, observability, and production excellence

Provide full-stack technical leadership across backend and frontend (Angular/React)

Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and executable roadmaps

Manage stakeholders and lead global teams to deliver against strategic milestones

Lead adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices (Copilot, Claude, Windsurf, etc.)

Guide teams in translating ambiguous problems into structured, AI-augmentable execution plans
 

What You’ll Bring

B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

7+ years of progressive software engineering experience with proven leadership of teams or major platforms

Strong expertise in Java, Python, and distributed systems architecture

Experience designing highly available, real-time enterprise systems

Deep understanding of APIs, microservices, data modeling, and scalability patterns

Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, Redis)

Exposure to cloud-native and DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)

Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills

Demonstrated experience integrating AI into engineering workflows and production platforms

Nice to Have

About this role

BlackRock is one of the world’s leading asset management firms and Aladdin® is the firm’s an end-to-end operating system for investment professionals to see their whole portfolio, understand risk exposure, and act with precision. Aladdin is the central nervous system powering the investment decisions of both the firm and its clients; a $1bn technology business that has significant growth aspirations over the next five years. 

The Aladdin Platform team is responsible for engineering and operating the core service layer that powers Aladdin. We sit at the center of enabling the delivery of products and features in Aladdin for BlackRock and the largest financial institutions in the world. As the pace of growth of Aladdin accelerates, the Platform Team is laser focused on the speed of product delivery, execution predictability and quality. The Platform team is responsible for a suite of foundational and modern products including our Developer Platform, Core Infrastructure and our Mission Control Platform. The Platform product management office helps to catalyze our engineering community, delivering well-defined Platform products that have clear outcome-oriented roadmaps and efficient and predictable delivery. 

We are seeking a passionate, technically fluent Product Manager to lead our internal AI enablement initiatives for software development teams. In this role, you will focus exclusively on developing, maintaining, and evolving AI-driven tools that empower our engineers and technologists throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You’ll define and drive the product strategy for how AI is integrated into developer workflows – from intelligent coding assistants and automated code reviews to AI-enhanced testing and deployment processes. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in developer-centric environments, understands how software is built and delivered, and is excited about leveraging artificial intelligence to transform those processes. You will ensure our development environment remains cutting-edge, efficient, and tailored to the needs of our engineers. Success in this role hinges on your ability to listen to developers’ needs, anticipate how AI can address their pain points, and collaborate effectively to deliver innovative solutions. As a trusted product leader, you will own the AI toolchain roadmap and guide the delivery of features that fundamentally improve developer productivity and software quality. 

You Are: 

Passionate about AI in developer tools: You have a deep interest in the potential of artificial intelligence and machine learning to improve engineering workflows. You stay informed about new AI technologies and are eager to apply them in practical ways to help developers. 

Deeply user-focused: You care about the daily life of software developers and have empathy for their challenges. You’re driven to make their jobs easier by providing tools that solve real problems and enhance productivity. 

Technically savvy: You have a solid grasp of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), version control, continuous integration, and deployment practices. 

A strategic thinker and executor: You can zoom out to define a compelling vision for AI-enabled developer platforms, and then zoom in to work out the execution details. You blend big-picture perspective with meticulous planning, ensuring that long-term goals inform day-to-day implementation. 

A self-starter and problem-solver: You take initiative and handle ambiguity well. When faced with a complex problem you proactively research options, rally the right people, and drive toward a solution. 

Collaborative and influential: You excel in cross-functional teams, working closely with engineers, investment researchers, UX designers, and stakeholders. You communicate clearly, build trust easily, and can influence without direct authority. Colleagues see you as an advocate for both the developers’ needs and the business’s goals. 

Adaptable and curious: You quickly learn new domains and technologies. You’re not afraid to step outside your comfort zone to make informed product decisions. 

Outcome-oriented: You care about results. You define success metrics up front and push for measurable impact. You hold yourself and the team accountable to delivering value, not just features. 

Key Responsibilities 

Product Vision & Strategy: Define and continually refine the product vision for AI enablement in our developer platform. Develop a clear strategy and multi-phase roadmap for introducing AI-powered solutions that align with both engineering needs and broader business objectives. Ensure this vision stays aligned with the latest advancements in AI/ML and the evolving needs of our internal development community. 

Use Case Discovery & Requirements Gathering: Engage with engineers, tech leads, and architect stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases where AI can improve developer productivity. 

Product Specifications & Documentation: Translate insights and requirements into clear product artifacts. Continuously update documentation to reflect changes and new learning. 

Integrate AI into Developer Workflows: Guide the integration of AI solutions seamlessly into existing developer workflows and tools. Work with pilot users to test new AI features in their daily work and iterate based on feedback. 

Platform Reliability & Governance: Oversee the non-functional aspects of delivering AI capabilities on our developer platform. Partner with infrastructure and DevOps teams to ensure the AI tools and services are scalable, performant, and secure. 

User Adoption & Training: Drive high adoption and satisfaction of the AI tools you deliver. Develop onboarding programs or tutorials that help engineers quickly learn how to use new AI features. Be the internal evangelist for these AI tools, highlighting success stories and best practices to encourage wider usage. 

Feedback Collection & Iteration: Establish feedback loops with users and stakeholders to gather qualitative feedback and observe how teams interact with the AI tooling. Maintain a continuous improvement mindset, releasing enhancements frequently to steadily increase the tools’ value. 

Stakeholder Management & Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for all things related to AI developer enablement. Regularly update senior leadership and relevant stakeholders on progress, roadblocks, and future plans. Influence and secure buy-in from cross-functional stakeholders by clearly articulating how AI-driven improvements support the company’s engineering excellence and business objectives. 

Industry Awareness & Innovation: Stay abreast of the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape, especially as it pertains to software engineering. Keep an eye on industry trends, emerging tools, and best practices from other companies. Evaluate relevant new technologies or services and make build vs. buy recommendations. 

Required Skills & Experience 

Product Management Experience: 4+ years of product management experience in a technical software environment, with a total of 6–8 years of professional experience in technology. 

AI/ML Familiarity: Strong familiarity with artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts. You don’t need to be a data scientist, but you should understand key AI/ML fundamentals and trends. 

Understanding of Developer Workflows & SDLC: A solid understanding of how software developers work and the tools they use. You should be well-versed in the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and common practices like version control (Git), code review processes, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), automated testing, and DevOps culture. 

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to decision making. You can dig into usage data or operational metrics to identify trends and root causes. 

Communication & Documentation: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can convey complex ideas and technical concepts in a clear, concise manner, tailoring your message to the audience (engineers, non-technical stakeholders, executives, etc.). 

Collaboration & Leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence and work collaboratively. You have experience managing a product backlog and coordinating work across multiple teams or departments. 

Education: Bachelor’s degree (required) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications 

AI/ML Product Experience: Direct experience bringing an AI or ML-powered product to market (or to internal users) is highly desirable. A demonstrated track record of delivering AI solutions from concept to production with tangible impact will set you apart. 

Deep Technical Knowledge: Deeper familiarity with modern AI/ML tools, frameworks, and architectures. 

Cloud & Scalable Systems: Experience with cloud platforms and scalable infrastructure for AI. Knowledge of services across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud for building AI-driven applications is a plus. 

Developer Platform/Tools Background: Prior experience working on products for developers – such as IDEs, SDKs, CI/CD systems, monitoring tools, or collaboration platforms – is advantageous. 

Strategic Vision and Execution: Ability to define long-term product roadmaps that intersect with emerging technology trends. 

Advanced Education: A Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field can be a positive differentiator. 

This Product Manager – AI Developer Enablement role is pivotal to how our engineering teams will build the next generation of software. You will have the opportunity to shape a platform that leverages AI to make development faster, smarter, and more intuitive. If you are excited about empowering developers with AI-driven tools, love solving complex technical problems, and can balance vision with execution, we’d love to hear from you.

About this role

BlackRock is one of the world’s preeminent asset management firms and a premier provider of global investment management, risk management and advisory services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors around the world. BlackRock offers a range of solutions — from meticulous fundamental and quantitative active management approaches aimed at maximizing outperformance to highly efficient indexing strategies designed to gain broad exposure to the world’s capital markets. Our clients can access our investment solutions through a variety of product structures, including individual and institutional separate accounts, mutual funds and other pooled investment vehicles, and the industry-leading iShares® ETFs. Business Unit Overview

 

BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM) brings together BlackRock’s Index Investments, Cash Management, Global Trading, ETF Markets, Securities Lending, and Financing & Financial Resource Management businesses. Together, we provide clients with superior market access and index investment outcomes through: 

World class talent, operating at the intersection of investment insight, markets expertise, risk management and process design 

Technology at the heart of our processes, with in-business tech teams that create cutting-edge IP, providing an advantage in quality, scale, and risk control 

A focus on transforming markets, driving and advocating for more accessible, resilient, and transparent markets to deliver more choice and lower costs for investors 

 

Job Purpose/Background: 

 

The Index Fixed Income (IFI) team has responsibility for managing Blackrock’s Index Fixed Income portfolios, including Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), mutual funds, & segregated mandates. The IFI team liaises closely with many areas of Fixed Income and is responsible for ensuring that Fixed Income portfolios are managed efficiently and in a consistent and risk-controlled manner.

BlackRock’s IFI business is the leading index investment group in the world. We help investors build better portfolios with the industry’s leading suite of index investment tools. We manage over $1.5 trillion in global index fixed income assets across Developed and Emerging Markets. Our clients include corporate and public pension plans, central banks, sovereign wealth funds and retail investors.

The PM Architecture team are designing and developing portfolio construction algorithms to significantly increase automation and productivity across IFI globally. They are also partnering with Technology teams to develop the core platform with which to deploy algorithms robustly at scale. Algorithms have already been successfully deployed which are event-based and automatically propose order lists that rebalance funds back to target. A key focus is developing algorithms and analytics to support the rapid growth of Fixed Income ETFs.

A successful candidate will be familiar with management of a wide range of Fixed Income investment styles and have strong technology skills, allowing them to develop both prototypes which make immediate improvements to the PM process and then refine them into production solutions that scale. They will also have the communication skills and enthusiasm to partner with PM, Trading, and Technology teams to guide the integration of these algorithms into the investment process and leverage core BlackRock technology.

Key Responsibilities:

Design efficient algorithms and optimizers to automate key portfolio construction processes

Develop both prototypes and production tools

Partner closely with PMs to integrate these tools into daily processes and continually refine them

On occasion, undertake portfolio management activities to develop a deeper understanding of specific investment processes (research and investment management)

Partner with BlackRock Technology teams to design and develop the core “Algo Platform”

Develop other desk tools to support the PM investment process.

Partner with BlackRock Technology teams to ensure existing applications continue to evolve to support PM needs

Develop reporting methods & analytics on new tools to ensure improvements can be measured

Knowledge/Experience/Qualifications:

Strong quantitative background (at least BA/BS in Math/Science/Engineering/related discipline).

Strong programming skills in at least two of the following: Python, Visual Basic, R, MATLAB, Java, C++

Working knowledge and demonstrated interest in Fixed Income markets

Familiarity across a range of funds and investment styles (index/active, fundamental/quantitative)

Experience of working as Portfolio Manager, either directly or alongside

Excellent problem-solving skills and process-oriented approach

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Knowledge of BlackRock Aladdin tools beneficial

About this role

If you are a seasoned Java Engineer passionate about building world-class trading systems, we would love to hear from you! You should be eager to collaborate with a team that values innovation and quality.

In the role of Senior Java Developer at BlackRock's Aladdin core, you will develop the platform supporting our and our clients’ investment and trading. You will invent, build, and support scalable and high-performance applications every day. You will collaborate with trading professionals, product leads, and engineers to specify requirements and provide impactful solutions.

Your role will involve solving technical challenges, optimizing services and data pipelines, and continuously exploring new technologies to improve system performance. Guiding less experienced engineers and contributing to team culture will help maintain the reliability, security, and efficiency of critical trading systems in a dynamic environment.

About the role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and backend services to support trading operations.

Collaborate with multi-functional teams including traders, product managers, and other engineers to define requirements and deliver solutions.

Implement and optimize high-performance APIs, microservices, and data processing pipelines.

Ensure guidelines in code quality, testing, deployment, and security.

Solve and resolve technical issues across the full stack prioritizing reliability and efficiency.

Continuously research and adopt new technologies to improve team productivity and system performance.

Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a positive, innovative team culture.

About you

Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Minimum 7 years’ proven experience working as an end-to-end development engineer, preferably in trading, finance, or similarly sophisticated environments.

Proven experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java 17+

Solid understanding of Data Structures, Object Oriented Programming concepts and design patterns.

Expertise in designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and GraphQL is a plus.

Background in handling databases SQL and NoSQL (Cassandra, Ignite).

Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

Strong understanding of software creation process, agile methodologies, and best engineering practices.

Deep comprehension of build patterns in an enterprise environment.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to details.

Track record building quality software with design-focused and careful testing approaches.

Experience taking emotional ownership of the design and development of a significant application, system, or key component. Ability to form positive relationships with partnering teams, sponsors, and user groups in a distributed team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience working in trading or financial services technology teams.

Knowledge of trading protocols, and low-latency systems.

Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools.

Experience working with Spring Framework and Spring Boot web services.

Experience in modern web frameworks (such as React, Angular).

Fostering a collaborative environment and driving projects to successful completion.

Strong leadership and mentorship skills are crucial to guide team members and support their professional growth.

Experience leading and managing a team of engineers.

What We Offer

The chance to create a real impact across worldwide trading operations. A collaborative, inclusive team with a focus on professional growth and outstanding technical quality. Opportunities to work with pioneering technologies and sophisticated problem domains. Support for ongoing training, certification, and career progression.

What is Aladdin and Trading Engineering?

You will be working on BlackRock's investment operating system called Aladdin. Aladdin is used both internally within BlackRock and externally by many financial institutions. Aladdin combines sophisticated risk analytics with comprehensive portfolio management, trading, and operations tools on a single platform to power informed decision-making and create a connective tissue for thousands of users investing worldwide.

Our trading engineering team is a highly skilled, collaborative group of technology professionals dedicated to building robust solutions that empower our trading business. We operate at the intersection of finance and technology, designing systems that ensure reliability, speed, and scalability in a global trading environment.

The team is known for its innovative perspective, problem-solving abilities, and passion for delivering high-quality software that drives real business outcomes. We foster a culture of continuous learning, open dialogue, and technical excellence, making us a hub for daring engineers eager to make a tangible impact!

About this role

As an independent, fiduciary asset manager, BlackRock is committed to acting at all times in the best long-term interests of our clients. BlackRock Investment Stewardship serves as a link between our clients and the companies they invest in. 

 

We take a long-term approach to stewardship, focused on engaging with company boards and executive leadership to understand the drivers of risk and financial value creation in companies’ business models. 

The work of BlackRock’s BIS team is an investment function. The team operates in nine offices across three regions – the Americas (New York, San Francisco, Wilmington, and Washington DC); Europe, Middle East and Africa (London); and Asia-Pacific (Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore and Sydney) – and undertakes engagement with and proxy voting at portfolio companies on behalf of clients globally. 

 

For clients who authorize us to vote on their behalf, we use voting to formally communicate our support for or concerns about how companies are serving the financial interests of our clients as long-term investors. 

 

Role description: 

The BIS Vice President will work as part of a team focused on Japan. The role reports to the Head of BIS APAC and is based in Tokyo. The intention is for the person in this role to specialize in corporate governance, environmental and social issues as an investment theme or risk. The successful candidate will cover several sectors in Japan, for voting and engagement purposes, and facilitate the overall development of team capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Serve as an expert in their local market for BlackRock's Investment Stewardship team, including for key audiences internally and externally. The individual will conduct research on portfolio companies to support the assessment of corporate governance practices and material sustainability-related risks and opportunities from an investment perspective; 

Implement BIS corporate governance policies for sectors and the key markets in the region through engagement with investee companies, including voting at shareholder meetings; 

Engage with Board Chairs, CEO(s) and other senior representatives of the companies in which BlackRock invests to address a range of issues including industry trends, strategy and performance in addition to corporate governance; 

Monitor various corporate governance standards and best practices in the market and contribute to internal guidelines refreshment; 

Initiate, lead, and/or participate in internal research projects as required. This could also include contributing to key public policy debates and responding to policy consultations; 

Engage in public speaking opportunities to disseminate our approach on stewardship to wider constituencies; 

Contribute to regular updates of our publicly available documents, including voting guidelines, ensuring their relevance and timeliness; 

Collaborate with BlackRock’s client-facing group and with clients directly to ensure client reporting and client presentations meet expectations, and that client queries on stewardship are responded to promptly and to the satisfaction of the client; 

Contribute to the continual review of the BIS team’s output and working practices to ensure risks are minimised and performance optimised. 

The person in this role will be/will have: 

 

An undergraduate degree in finance, economics, accounting, business, communications, or relevant fields. 

4-9 years of experience in a financial service focused role, ideally with a demonstrated strong understanding of financial statements and corporate finance. 

Investment management, investment banking, corporate finance, investor relations, consulting and/or legal experience is an advantage. 

Excellent analytical skills with very strong attention to detail. 

The ability to build and maintain successful relationships with colleagues across the firm and with external parties. 

The ability to analyse and resolve complex problems under time pressure. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with agile critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. 

Ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical personnel. 

Detail focused and persistent to see things through to completion whilst managing multiple tasks and changing priorities. 

Organized, self-reliant, and self-motivated. 

Extensive knowledge of Excel and strong knowledge of the entire MS Office suite. 

Experience in data analysis, consolidation and creating detailed reports; creativity with clear charts and tables a strong plus. 

Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, including the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with senior colleagues, investee company representatives, and the public. 

Proficiency in Japanese and English.

About this role

About Global Product Solutions (GPS) Global Product Solutions (“GPS”) was formed with the mission to innovate, curate and commercialise the full breadth of our investment platform for what our clients need, wherever they are. The function is responsible for driving commercial investment priorities across the platform, innovating the next wave of products and solutions, and helping clients build better portfolios via actionable market and portfolio insights.

About the Role

Within the GPS organisation, the Strategy team plays a pivotal role in shaping BlackRock's strategic direction and driving initiatives that enhance our competitive position and growth. This role is an Associate-level hire for the APAC GPS Strategy team, based in Hong Kong.

The role involves partnering with other teams across GPS and the broader organisation to anticipate where our clients, and the people they serve, are going and how BlackRock can best deliver on their needs. With an emphasis on critical thinking, problem-solving and a core strategy mindset, members on the team works closely with the APAC GPS leadership to set the long-term direction as well as the short-medium term priorities for the business. The role offers an excellent platform for impact by working on our most pressing questions at the heart of the GPS business, providing you the opportunity to challenge the business and help us set its direction. You’ll be part of a high-performing and deeply collaborative team, in a role that is both highly strategic and fast-paced, making it an excellent opportunity for someone with a dynamic and enterprising mindset. We are seeking an individual who can operate across strategy development, executive communication and execution coordination, helping ensure that APAC GPS priorities are well-articulated, well-sequenced, and effectively delivered. The role offers significant exposure to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Development & Business Analytics

• Support the development of APAC GPS strategic priorities across iShares, Active, Private Markets and product commercialization capabilities, in alignment with Global GPS and BLK APAC objectives.

• Conduct market, competitor, and client segment analysis to inform product strategy, commercialization priorities, and resource allocation.

• Build clear, data-backed business cases for new initiatives.

• Translate ambiguous strategic questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

Market Intelligence & Insights 

• Conduct market, competitor, and performance analysis to identify and track trends and opportunities.

• Curate and effectively synthesize industry and competitive intelligence for senior leadership.

• Navigate complex datasets to extract insights that support strategic decision-making.

Leadership Enablement & Communication

• Support effective execution of strategic priorities and provide leverage to the Head of APAC GPS and the APAC GPS Leadership Team.

• Prepare executive-level materials (Executive Committee materials, leadership talking points, strategy memos, briefing notes) for internal and global forums.

• Support agenda-setting and follow-through for key leadership meetings, offsites and discussions, ensuring decisions translate into action.

• Support internal communications to senior APAC and Global stakeholders, ensuring consistency of messaging and clarity of priorities.

Required Skills / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with a strong academic track record.

• 3–6 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business management, or a related role within financial services or asset management.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights.

• Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and produce executive-level written and presentation materials.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate objectives, synthesize complex topics, and produce concise, executive-ready briefings and deliverables; confident, concise, and structured.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in parallel.

• Ability to anticipate and react quickly to shifting demands or priorities. Able to “zoom in” and “zoom out” as needed – rolling up sleeves while also operating at the strategic level where required.

• Be ready and willing to read and react to the needs of the business with short notice.

• Be a student of the markets: fascinated by how innovative firms can help their clients invest in their financial futures.

• The role will suit someone who thrives on collaboration and has both exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

Support global Payments and Cash Management processes within Oracle Cloud, ensuring accurate, timely, and controlled payment execution + statement import and reconciliation.

Payments & Cash Management 

3-7 years’ experience in international payments, cash management, or treasury operations. 

Strong understanding of global payment types, including (but not limited to): 

Wires 

ACH 

BACS 

Experience working with country specific payment requirements and market practices. 

Working knowledge of modern payment standards, particularly ISO 20022. 

Technology & Integration 

Experience supporting or operating ERP to bank-to-ERP connectivity, including: 

Host to Host integrations 

SFTP based file transmissions 

Proven ability to troubleshoot payment issues, including linking payment outcomes back to source data for root cause analysis. 

Exposure to Oracle Cloud (Cash Management or Payments modules) is beneficial but not required. 

Communication & Collaboration 

Strong communicator, comfortable engaging with a wide range of stakeholders, including: 

Finance and Treasury users 

Technology teams 

External banks and vendors 

Ability to explain complex payment or data issues clearly and concisely. 

Comfortable operating in a global, fast paced, and change driven environment. 

 

Desirable (Nice to Have)

Exposure to controls, audit, or regulatory considerations in payments. 

Prior involvement in platform migrations or payment standard transformations.

Work on globally critical payment and cash platforms with real business impact. 

Gain exposure to complex, cross border payments and regulatory change.

Opportunity to deepen platform expertise while building a strong payments specialism.

About this role

Data is at the heart of Aladdin and increasingly the ability to acquire, store, analyse and gain insight from data has become a key component of what differentiates us. The Aladdin Data (AD) team is responsible for the data ecosystem within BlackRock. Our goal is to build and maintain a groundbreaking Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) that provides highly available, consistent data of the highest quality for all users of the platform, notably investors, operations teams and data analysts internally and at investment management firms around the world. 

EDP supports four outcomes that, together, enable BlackRock’s data strategy: 

Provide high quality, reliable data and services to power the core investment processes for Aladdin clients 

Enable Aladdin clients to reduce operational overhead and improve client service by offering both Aladdin data and BlackRock-generated premium content through a commercial data platform, Aladdin Data Cloud (ADC) 

Acquire, process, and deliver well-governed data for internal AI agents and the teams building and using AI 

Provide a general-purpose Data Platform as a Service (DPaaS) to enable teams across BlackRock to focus on extracting value form their data 

 

Members of the AD team get to experience working at one of the most recognized financial companies in the world, building a powerful data platform to automate data acquisition, ingestion, transformation, and distribution. Our product managers and engineers design and build data systems to solve some of the most complex technical and business data management problems in the industry, and they partner with data and analytics experts to deliver high quality analytical and derived data to our internal and external customers.

We are seeking a Vice President of Product to help deliver and grow the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP). About this role

We are seeking a Director, Product to lead strategy and execution for a key product domain supporting private‑markets investors. This role is central to advancing our platform’s data, insights, and workflow capabilities for customers across the alternatives ecosystem.

As a Director, you will define long‑term product direction, shape multi‑year roadmaps, and drive cross‑functional execution across engineering, design, research, marketing, sales, and customer success. You will ensure that our products directly enable investors, deal teams, and market participants to operate with deeper insight, greater efficiency, and better outcomes. This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives in cross‑functional, platform‑building environments and is motivated by the opportunity to influence the next generation of private‑markets capabilities.
 

Key Responsibilities:

Define and own the product strategy for your domain, ensuring it aligns with customer needs, market insights, and commercial priorities.

Drive the full product lifecycle, from early‑stage discovery through launch, iteration, and scaled adoption.

Engage deeply with private‑markets customers, translating deal‑team workflows and data needs into actionable product requirements.

Work cross‑functionally with engineering, design, research, and go‑to‑market teams to deliver high‑quality, timely product outcomes.

Mentor and develop Product Managers, elevating product craft, delivery quality, and cross‑functional collaboration.

Champion data‑driven decisions, using analytics, market intelligence, customer feedback, and platform usage data to refine priorities.

Communicate strategy and progress to senior stakeholders clearly and without ambiguity.

Required Skills & Experience:

Strong customer empathy with the ability to convert complex workflows into intuitive product solutions.

Commercial acumen with a demonstrated ability to identify and prioritize high‑impact opportunities.

Proven track record of delivering products in iterative, discovery‑driven environments.

Experience leading Product Managers and shaping high‑performing product teams.

Analytical, structured, and comfortable using data to guide decisions.

High ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and end‑to‑end accountability.

Strongly Preferred Experience:

Experience of private‑markets deal teams – whether as a deal‑team member or as a data or software provider supporting sourcing, diligence, or portfolio monitoring – is strongly preferred.

This includes familiarity with workflows and information needs of:

Private equity / credit or venture capital investment teams

Deal sourcing and origination platforms

Diligence, research, or valuation tools

PortCo monitoring, analytics, and reporting environments

This domain expertise materially enhances success in shaping the product direction.

Values & Working Style:

You will operate within a culture characterized by:

Customer focus and problem‑solving

Evidence‑based, objective decision‑making

Collaborative working across global teams

Innovation and continuous improvement

Professional development, ownership, and transparency
